Job Responsibilities:
Facilitate in establishing Safety and Health requirements at workplace.
Ensure implementation of EHS Management system/Harsco s Global Harsco Operating Standards.
Guide EHS policy, performance standards and criteria in consultation with management
Monitor and report EHS performance
Develop, implement and support HSE improvement strategies
Provide professional support and expert advice in relevant areas
Conduct/arrange EHS educational, training and support programs
Conduct EHS inspections/Audit and report to Management.
Identify, analyse and report potential HSE difficulties to management
Maintain an excellent information resource in EHS and produce effective statistical information
EHS performance reporting - internal and external
Ensure incident reporting and investigation of incidents
Conduct Risk Assessment for activities undertaken at site.
Monitor compliance of EHS legal requirements and advise management.
Advise on and plan for changes to legislation and external standards
Organize EHS promotional activities to promote EHS culture.
Qualifications
Bachelor of Engineering
Full time 1 year Advance Diploma in Industrial Safety from Govt of India Recognised Institute,
NEBOSH IGC
Knowledge of ISO 9001, 14001 45001

Install, maintain, and repair mechanical equipment and machinery.

Conduct regular inspections to ensure proper functioning of equipment and machinery.

Collaborate with other maintenance staff to resolve issues and improve efficiency.

Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize downtime.

Troubleshoot and diagnose mechanical problems using various tools and techniques.

Job Requirements


Strong knowledge of mechanical systems and principles.

Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Good communication and teamwork skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.

Familiarity with quality control measures and procedures.

Description:
Position Overview
The/Nudge is working with the Government of Arunachal Pradesh and The Arunachal State Rural Livelihoods Mission (ArSRLM), to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting ultra poor and most vulnerable households. The Arunachal Pradesh Economic Inclusion Program (ArEIP) is a targeted poverty alleviation initiative aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of rural households experiencing extreme vulnerability in Arunachal Pradesh. The program primarily focuses on distressed single and young mothers, along with other poorest-of-the-poor households, with a strong emphasis on strengthening women s economic and social inclusion. The initiative seeks to support approximately 20,000 vulnerable households across selected blocks and districts of the state.


What will you do
Own the implementation and outcomes of the program
Provide leadership and managerial support to the field team, mainly to the District and Block professionals for effective and timely implementation of SAY
Manage District and Block professionals to ensure quality implementation on the ground through regular meetings and field visits
Develop process and system for onboarding and capacity building of District and Block professionals
Develop process and system for regular monitoring and feedback
Work closely with The/Nudge s financial unit to develop budgets and ensure timely and effective of such budget
Work closely with the ArSRLM in developing the annual budget and preparing financial plans
Support ArSRLM in the research and development of a strategy and program design to target the ultra-poor through the graduation approach built on top of community institutions enabled by the NRLM
Support ArSRLM in the implementation of action research of the graduation approach through a special project based on the strategy and design developed in consultation with key stakeholders
Enable convergence of various state initiatives (social security, livelihood promotion, financial inclusion, social empowerment) and programs towards the end goal of graduating women and their households living in ultra-poverty out of it
Support ArSRLM to review the progress of the program periodically in order to iterate and scale
Support the mission on the use of data and technology to ensure continuous flow of data from the field
Build relationships with key government stakeholders in Jharkhand such that the special project is successful
Build relationships with key government departments and support the successful adoption of strategies targeting the ultra-poor.


Who are we looking for in this role
About 8-10 years of experience and is a Postgraduate.
Have experienced in Program Implementation and leading teams
Demonstrated a growth mindset - learning/improving constantly
Demonstrated success in starting and leading initiatives, working under uncertainty able to articulate vision and secure buy-in from stakeholders
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills. Fluent in English local language
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Has the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholder groups/ State Officials in a fast-paced environment
Set aside personal bias to do what is right for the community
Experience in designing/managing multi-stakeholder development sector programs designed around (or with) SHGs, Community Institutions and ArSRLM
An openness to travel extensively as per the needs of the program s goals
A passion for serving those in need with humility sensitivity

Collaborate with other technicians to meet production targets and ensure quality standards are met.

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during the assembly process.

Maintain a clean and organized workspace, adhering to safety protocols and regulations.

Strong understanding of automotive assembly processes and procedures.

Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Good communication and teamwork skills.

Ability to lift heavy objects and stand for long periods.

Familiarity with quality control measures and safety protocols.

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long term
engagement.
Understand customer needs and assist in finding the right tenant or property with tailored
solutions.
Manage inbound and outbound calls, negotiate with leads, and provide regular updates
on account progress.
Utilize internal tools and adhere to company guidelines to deliver efficient and high-
quality service.
Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer
satisfaction.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.

Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.

all employees.

numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.

Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.

At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.

Job Title: Inside Sales Executive(Inside)
Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bangalore
Salary Range: CTC of 4,56,072 LPA (2,76,072 lacs fixed + 1.80 lacs variable, few employees are able to earn even 25,000 as monthly variable)
About Us:NoBroker.com is the world's largest C2C online real estate marketplace, with 8.5 million customers and a 10x growth in the past year. Backed by $151 million in funding from investors like General Atlantic, Tiger Global, and SAIF Partners, it is headquartered in Bangalore and employs over 4,000 people.

Inside Sales Executive - Role and Responsibilities:
Identify business opportunities and prospects.
Build relationships, recommend solutions, and close sales.
Make outbound calls using lead generation and secondary data.
Follow up on older and new leads daily.
Ensure quality service by adhering to company standards.
Be energetic, well-spoken, and focused on closing deals and generating revenue
Qualification / Education and Requirements:
Education: Any Undergraduate or Post Graduate (MBA, BBA, B.Tech, B.A., etc.)
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Languages: English & Hindi or Kannada (mandatory); Tamil/Telugu (optional).
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Flexible for a 9-hour shift between 10 AM - 7 PM.
Comfortable working 6 days a week with a weekday off.
Employee Value Proposition:
Health insurance of Rs 1 lakh per year, with the premium covered by the company.
Monthly rewards and recognition for top performers.
Promotions every year based on performance.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Business Analyst Director’s Office | Muthoot Finance Limited
We are seeking a freshly qualified Chartered Accountant to join as a Business Analyst in the Director’s Office at Muthoot Finance Limited.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Support and Analysis
Analyze and synthesize approval notes and strategic decisions to provide concise summaries and actionable insights.
Assist the Executive Director in business reviews and discussions by preparing relevant data and reports.
Conduct financial and operational analysis to support decision-making processes.
2. Stakeholder Coordination
Follow up with stakeholders across businesses and functions to ensure timely actions and progress updates.
Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to facilitate smooth communication and collaboration.
Prepare meeting agendas and ensure all necessary documentation is available.
3. Project Management
Oversee and manage special projects as assigned by the Executive Director.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and deliverables, providing regular updates to the Executive Director.
Identify potential risks and propose mitigation strategies to ensure project success.
4. Administrative Support
Prepare and review correspondence, presentations, and other documents on behalf of the Executive Director.
Maintain confidential files and records, ensuring data security and integrity.
5. Research and Reporting
Research industry trends, market conditions, and the competitive landscape to inform strategic planning.
Prepare detailed reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Assist in preparing board meeting materials and other high-level communications.
6. Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities for process improvements within the Executive Director’s Office.
Implement best practices to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of office operations.
Support the development and implementation of new initiatives to drive business growth and performance.

The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5443+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.

The Company offer 30+ Staff Welfare Measures ranging from Fast Track Promotions, Career Development Programs, National Pension Scheme, Foreign Trips, five types of Annual Incentives/Bonuses, Cash Rewards, Contests with prizes, Maternity Benefits, Medical benefits, Employee Insurance etc. to name a few.
Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.

SUMMARY
About the client:

Join the Mumbai-based technology hub of a global insurance powerhouse, where innovation meets the stability of a leading international group. German Language Expert
Location: Mumbai (or Willingness to Relocate)
Experience: 0 - 1 Year
Employment Type: Full - Time




Requirements
We are seeking a detail-oriented and fluent German Language Specialist / Translator to join our team. Translation & Localization: Translate technical documents, business correspondence, contracts, user guides, and training manuals between German and English.

Interpretation Support: Provide real-time bilingual/multilingual interpretation during stakeholder meetings, client calls, or internal syncs when needed.
Glossary & Asset Management: Maintain consistent language terminology glossaries, style guides, and translation memory banks across projects.
Cross-Functional Support: Collaborate with operational and technical teams to resolve linguistic queries and adapt content for German-speaking markets.

Language Proficiency:
B2 - B4 proficiency level in German with Goethe-Institut certification (or equivalent recognized framework certification).

Strong bilingual/multilingual communication skills (German & English).

Description:
- Identify and develop new business opportunities for Cytogenetic and Molecular Genetic diagnostic services.

- Conduct regular field visits to hospitals, clinics, gynaecologists, oncologists, paediatricians, geneticists, infertility specialists and other relevant healthcare professionals to promote diagnostic services.

- Establish and maintain professional relationships with doctors, consultants, referral centres and healthcare institutions.

- Promote Cytogenetic investigations, including:
- Karyotyping
- FISH (Fluorescence In Situ Hybridisation)
- Prenatal Cytogenetic Testing
- Cancer Cytogenetic Studies
- Other specialised chromosomal investigations.

- Promote Molecular Genetic investigations, including:
- PCR and Real-Time PCR (qPCR)
- DNA/RNA-based Molecular Diagnostics
- Sanger Sequencing and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)
- Genetic Disorder and Carrier Screening
- Prenatal Genetic Testing
- Hereditary Cancer Testing
- Pharmacogenetic Testing
- Infectious Disease Molecular Diagnostics
- Other specialised molecular investigations.

- Communicate test indications, clinical applications, methodologies, sample requirements and laboratory facilities to healthcare professionals.

- Coordinate with laboratory and sample collection teams to ensure appropriate sample collection, handling, transportation and processing.

- Generate referrals, develop new referral centres and achieve assigned business development and revenue targets.

- Maintain regular field visit reports, referral records and follow-up activities.

- Monitor market trends and competitor activities, gather feedback and identify business expansion opportunities.

- Coordinate with laboratory teams for timely communication and resolution of client queries.

- Participate in medical awareness programmes, CME activities, conferences and promotional events.

- Create awareness among healthcare professionals about advancements and clinical applications in Cytogenetics and Molecular Genetics.

Description:
Position: Chartered Accountant Controllership, MIS & Financial Planning
Department: Finance & Accounts
Reporting To: Finance Controller / CFO
Location: Bangalore

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) to manage controllership activities, financial reporting, MIS preparation, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. The candidate will play a key role in driving financial discipline, management reporting, business analysis, and supporting strategic decision-making through accurate financial insights.

Key Responsibilities
Preparation and finalization of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Preparation and review of Management Information System (MIS) reports for senior management.
Preparation of budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial projections.
Variance analysis between actuals, budgets, and forecasts with actionable insights.
Monitoring financial performance and key business KPIs.
Support business planning and strategic financial decision-making.
Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards including Ind AS.
Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, and tax consultants.
Review general ledger balances, reconciliations, and financial controls.
Preparation of cash flow forecasts and working capital analysis.
Support in consolidation of financial statements and group reporting.
Develop and improve reporting automation and financial dashboards.
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial data within ERP systems.
Assist management in cost optimization and profitability analysis.
Support during board meetings and preparation of financial presentations.

Required Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and Ind AS.
Excellent analytical and financial modeling skills.
Hands-on experience in MIS reporting and financial planning & analysis (FP&A).
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or D365.
Ability to prepare business forecasts and management presentations.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Attention to detail and ability to meet strict deadlines.
Good understanding of budgeting, cash flows, and business performance analysis.

Educational Qualification
Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).
Experience
03 years of relevant experience in controllership, MIS reporting, financial planning, forecasting, and financial statement preparation.
Preferred Industry Exposure
Real Estate, Infrastructure, Manufacturing or any large corporate environment.
Key Deliverables
Timely and accurate financial reporting.
High-quality MIS and management presentations.
Reliable budgeting and forecasting models.
Improved financial controls and reporting efficiency.
Actionable financial insights for business growth.

Description:
Role & Company Aviator Training Academy
Location Hyderabad, Telangana | On-site
Incentives Performance-based, linked to confirmed admissions
Role overview
Aviator Training Academy is hiring an Admissions Counsellor to manage prospective students from the first call through enrolment. The role combines outbound cold calling, in-person counselling at the academy, and consistent follow-up to meet monthly admissions targets.
Key responsibilities
Make outbound cold calls and follow up with leads from Meta ads, the academy website, referrals, and walk-ins.
Qualify prospective students by understanding their educational background, career goals, budget, and preferred start date.
Schedule academy visits and conduct one-on-one counselling sessions with students and parents.
Explain DGCA ground school, commercial pilot training pathways, and available flight training options in India and abroad.
Clearly communicate eligibility, fees, payment schedules, estimated timelines, and programme inclusions using academy-approved information.
Address questions and objections, agree on next steps, and follow up by phone, WhatsApp, or email to convert qualified enquiries into admissions.
Coordinate application forms, required documents, and fee confirmation with the admissions team.
Maintain accurate records of calls, counselling sessions, follow-up dates, and admission status in Google Sheets or the academys CRM.
Meet agreed targets for calls, academy visits, counselling sessions, and confirmed admissions. Report progress and common reasons prospects do not enrol.
Admission incentives
Incentives are earned on eligible confirmed admissions credited to the counsellor. An admission qualifies once the student completes the required enrolment formalities and the academy verifies the qualifying fee payment. Incentive rates, targets, payout timelines, and rules for cancellations or refunds will be shared before joining.
Candidate requirements
Strong communication skills and confidence in cold calling and face-to-face counselling.
Ability to explain training options and fees clearly to students and parents.
Strong follow-up skills and willingness to work toward monthly admission targets.
Basic proficiency in Google Sheets, Excel, or a CRM.
Good spoken English. Telugu or Hindi is an advantage.
Experience in admissions, student counselling, telecalling, or education sales is preferred. Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in sales may also apply.
Familiarity with aviation or pilot training is an advantage.
AboutCompany:
Aviator Training Academy (ATA) is a pilot training and aviation career guidance academy established in 2017 in Hyderabad. We offer DGCA ground school, cadet pilot programme preparation, and airline interview preparation. We also help aspiring pilots explore commercial flight training options through partner flight schools in India and abroad.
Our team works with students and their families to explain training pathways, entry requirements, costs, and timelines so they can make informed decisions. We support students from their first enquiry through enrolment, ground training, and the transition to flight training.

QI Spine Clinic is a specialised healthcare organisation focused on providing advanced, non-surgical treatment for spine and orthopaedic conditions. Job Locations
Mumbai: Marine Lines, Borivali, Vashi, Powai, Ghatkopar and Andheri

Conduct detailed patient consultations and assess spine-related conditions.

Perform hands-on therapeutic techniques and supervise corrective exercises.
Track patient progress and ensure effective treatment outcomes.
Educate patients on posture correction, lifestyle modifications and home exercise routines.
Maintain accurate patient records and coordinate with the clinical team.

Training & Development
1 month of structured Spine Specialist training.
2 months of clinical mentorship and on-the-job guidance.
Opportunity to develop specialised expertise in spine rehabilitation.
Compensation & Work Schedule
Salary: 24,000 38,000 per month + performance-based incentives.
Salary will depend on qualifications, experience and last drawn salary.
Working Days: 6 days a week, with 1 weekly off.
Shift: Any 8.5-hour shift between 7:00 AM and 9:00 PM.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates interested in specialised spine care and clinical rehabilitation.
*Mandatory: 1.5-year employment bond*

Interested in Joining Us?
If you are passionate about physiotherapy and want to build your career in specialised spine care, we'd love to connect!

Please share your updated resume, preferred work location and contact number.

Phone: 8291125762

Be a part of QI Spine Clinic and contribute towards making quality spine care accessible to more patients!

Let's talk spine - because most of India doesn't.

Founded when surgery was the only mainstream solution to back pain, QI Spine emerged with a simple idea: non-surgical recovery should be the first option, not the last resort. Since then, we've built India's only spine-focused medical system - combining the expertise of 250+ specialists with cutting-edge AI tools like Doctor QI, our proprietary diagnostic engine. With 22 clinics across major cities, we've:
Consulted over 2.5 lakh patients
Prevented 15,000+ unnecessary spine surgeries
Achieved a 93% recovery rate - among the best in the world
Our mission?
To redefine spine care by blending clinical excellence, intelligent systems, and strong operational discipline.

Preferred

Role & responsibilities
**Role: Inside Sales Executive**
**Department: Sales**
**Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru**
**Employment Type: Full-Time**

### Roles & Responsibilities

* Connect with potential customers through **outbound calls** and understand their requirements.
* Handle and follow up on **sales leads** to convert prospects into customers.
* Build strong customer relationships by understanding their needs and explaining relevant products/services.
* Effectively communicate the **value proposition** and assist customers in making informed decisions.
* Address customer queries and challenges by providing **suitable and timely solutions**.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with leads throughout the sales cycle.
* Work towards achieving **individual sales, conversion and revenue targets**.
* Maintain high standards of customer service and ensure a positive customer experience.
* Update and manage lead/customer information accurately.
* Collaborate with the team to achieve overall business and sales objectives.
*

### Incentives & Benefits

* **Performance-Based Incentives** Earn attractive incentives based on your sales performance.
* **Monthly Rewards & Recognition** – Top performers are recognized and rewarded every month.
* **Fast Career Growth** – Performance-driven employees can progress to higher responsibilities.
* **Promotion Opportunities** – Regular performance reviews with opportunities for promotion.
* **1 Lakh Health Insurance** – Health insurance fully covered by the company.
* **Team Activities & Celebrations** – Regular team engagement activities, team parties and annual outings.
* **Learning & Growth** – Opportunity to develop your sales, communication, negotiation and customer-handling skills.
*

Preferred candidate profile
Speak kannda, english, hindi, or telgu, tamil .
Comfortable working 6 days a week, with one weeday off.
Candidates with 12th pass, graduation.

The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Job Title: Sales Counsellor
Company: QI Spine Clinic
Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore
Experience: 0-3years

About QI Spine Clinic
QI Spine Clinic is India's first chain of medical centres dedicated to the accurate diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of back and neck pain. Founded in 2011, QI Spine operates 22 clinics across 5 cities Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Bangalore and Hyderabad.
With a team of over 200 spine specialists and leading orthopaedic experts, QI Spine focuses on advanced diagnosis, technology-driven treatment and non-surgical recovery. The clinic has achieved a 91% success rate and helped over 13,000 patients recover without surgery.

Job Overview
We are looking for a confident, empathetic and sales-oriented Patient Counsellor who can guide patients through their treatment journey.
The role involves counselling first-time patients about doctor-recommended treatment plans, explaining treatment packages, addressing patient concerns and converting consultations into treatment enrolments while ensuring an excellent patient experience.

Key Responsibilities
Welcome patients and ensure a comfortable and positive clinic experience.
Assist patients with consultation forms and collect relevant medical history and concerns.
Explain doctor-recommended treatment plans, procedures, benefits, timelines and packages in simple language.
Educate patients about treatment options, pricing and expected outcomes.
Counsel patients and recommend suitable treatment packages based on doctors' advice and patient requirements.
Address patient queries, concerns and objections with empathy and professionalism.
Drive treatment package conversions and achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.
Follow up with prospective and existing patients to improve conversions and retention.
Build strong patient relationships to encourage repeat visits and referrals.
Coordinate with doctors, clinic operations and support teams to ensure a smooth patient journey.
Maintain accurate patient records, counselling reports and documentation.
Coordinate with the finance team for billing, invoicing and discount approvals.

Eligibility Criteria
HSC pass candidates with at least 6 months of relevant work experience.
Graduates/Freshers can also be considered, provided they have excellent communication skills.
Candidates with experience in sales, customer service, counselling or healthcare will be preferred.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation and objection-handling abilities.
Basic proficiency in MS Excel and computer operations.
Well-groomed, presentable and professional personality.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.

Shift & Working Details
Shift Duration: 8.5 hours.
Weekly Off: 1 Rotational Off
Shift Timings: Any shift between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM.
Candidates must be flexible with shift timings.
Work Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore.

Interested Candidates
Please apply only if you are comfortable with the work location (Indiranagar, Bangalore) and flexible shift timings.

Share your updated resume via:
WhatsApp: +91 82911 25762
Email: alisha.shaikh@qispine.com
AboutCompany:
Let's talk spine - because most of India doesn't.

Founded when surgery was the only mainstream solution to back pain, QI Spine emerged with a simple idea: non-surgical recovery should be the first option, not the last resort. Since then, we've built India's only spine-focused medical system - combining the expertise of 250+ specialists with cutting-edge AI tools like Doctor QI, our proprietary diagnostic engine. With 22 clinics across major cities, we've:
Consulted over 2.5 lakh patients
Prevented 15,000+ unnecessary spine surgeries
Achieved a 93% recovery rate - among the best in the world
Our mission?
To redefine spine care by blending clinical excellence, intelligent systems, and strong operational discipline.

Energetic and target-driven mindset.

Working Days: 6 days per week (with 1 rotational day off)
Competitive salary + Performance based incentives.

Job Summary We are looking for a high-performing Client Support & Stakeholder Management professional with extensive experience in the Banking and Insurance domains. Collaborate with technical and product teams to deploy system enhancements for clients.

Experience: 4 to 10 years of core experience in client relationship management, stakeholder governance, or high-tier operations within the Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance (BFSI) sectors.
Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of banking workflows, financial regulatory landscapes, or insurance life-cycles.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven track record of influencing senior leadership.
Problem Solving: Data-driven mindset with advanced analytical capabilities to handle volatile escalations.
Education: Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.

Competitive compensation up to 10 LPA (commensurate with experience and expertise).

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
BTL Sales & Marketing Executive
Company: QI Spine Clinic
Department: Sales & Marketing
Job Location: Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-Time

About QI Spine
QI Spine is a leading spine rehabilitation clinic in India, specializing in the non-surgical treatment of back pain, neck pain, and joint pain. With a patient-first approach, advanced diagnostic technology, and evidence-based treatment, we aim to help patients recover without unnecessary surgery. At QI Spine, we believe in accurate diagnosis,
non-surgical excellence, and making quality spine care accessible to more people.

Role Overview
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented BTL Sales & Marketing Executive to drive local marketing initiatives, generate leads, and increase patient footfall across QI Spine clinics. The role involves executing
on-ground promotional activities, building local partnerships, conducting awareness campaigns, and converting marketing opportunities into business leads.
Key Responsibilities
BTL Marketing Activities: Plan and execute on-ground marketing activities, including health camps, corporate wellness programs, society activations, community outreach, and local promotional events.
Lead Generation: Identify potential customers and generate qualified leads through field marketing, referrals, local events, and direct engagement.
Corporate Tie-ups: Build and maintain relationships with corporates, residential societies, gyms, fitness centres, sports clubs, pharmacies, and other relevant partners.
Sales & Patient Acquisition: Promote QI Spine's services, educate potential patients about non-surgical spine care, and drive consultations and clinic visits.
Local Market Development: Identify business opportunities within the clinic's catchment area and implement location-specific marketing strategies.
Campaign Execution: Coordinate promotional campaigns, distribute marketing collaterals, manage stalls and events, and ensure effective brand visibility.
Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with referral partners, corporate HR teams, community representatives, and local businesses.
Performance Tracking: Monitor leads generated, consultations booked, patient conversions, campaign performance, and return on marketing investment.
Coordination: Work closely with clinic teams, sales teams, and central marketing to ensure timely follow-ups and effective execution of campaigns.
Reporting: Maintain records of field activities, lead databases, partnerships, expenses, and campaign outcomes.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, Sales, or a related field.
13 years of experience in BTL marketing, field sales, lead generation, or business development.
Experience in healthcare, wellness, diagnostics, fitness, or service-based industries will be an advantage.
Strong communication, negotiation, networking, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to conduct field activities, build local partnerships, and achieve lead generation targets.

Target-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable working in a field-based role.
Proficiency in maintaining reports, tracking leads, and analysing campaign performance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Number of qualified leads generated.
Consultations booked and patient footfall generated.
Lead-to-consultation and consultation-to-conversion ratios.
Number of corporate tie-ups and active referral partnerships.
Number of BTL activities and campaigns executed.
Cost per lead and campaign effectiveness.
Achievement of assigned sales and marketing targets.

What We Offer
Opportunity to work with a growing healthcare organisation.
Exposure to healthcare marketing, business development, and patient acquisition.
A performance-driven work environment with opportunities for professional growth.

If you enjoy field marketing, building relationships, and driving business growth, we would love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Let's talk spine - because most of India doesn't.

Founded when surgery was the only mainstream solution to back pain, QI Spine emerged with a simple idea: non-surgical recovery should be the first option, not the last resort. Since then, we've built India's only spine-focused medical system - combining the expertise of 250+ specialists with cutting-edge AI tools like Doctor QI, our proprietary diagnostic engine. With 22 clinics across major cities, we've:
Consulted over 2.5 lakh patients
Prevented 15,000+ unnecessary spine surgeries
Achieved a 93% recovery rate - among the best in the world
Our mission?
To redefine spine care by blending clinical excellence, intelligent systems, and strong operational discipline.

Description:
HIRING: RELATIONSHIP MANAGER
Start Your Career with NoBroker.com!
Company: NoBroker.com
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Experience: Freshers Welcome
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: Work From Office

About NoBroker
NoBroker.com is India's leading brokerage-free property platform, connecting property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers directly. We aim to simplify real estate transactions by providing convenient, transparent, and technology-driven property solutions
Job Overview
We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and target-oriented individuals to join our team as Customer Relationship Managers. The role involves interacting with customers, understanding their requirements, explaining relevant NoBroker services, managing leads, and driving sales conversions through effective communication.

Key Responsibilities
Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.
Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication.
Identify and assess customers' needs to effectively upsell or cross-sell relevant products or services.
Service customer in finding the right tenant / house as per the requirement of the customer.
Dial outbound and attend inbound calls of customers and leads.
Use internal tools and methods to provide the best possible service to the customer.
Negotiate with leads on behalf of customers. Keep customers up-to-date on the progress of his account.
Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Go extra mile to provide excellent customer service
Eligibility Criteria
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of regional languages is an advantage.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a customer-focused mindset.
Ability to work in a target-driven sales environment.
Freshers and recent graduates are welcome to apply
Working Schedule & Job Details
Shift Timing: 10:00 AM 7:00 PM
Login Time: 9 hours per day
Daily Talk-Time Target: 4 hours
Working Days: 6 days per week
Weekly Off: 1 rotational day off per week
Work Mode: Work From Office
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a detail-oriented and enthusiastic QA Tester (Fresher) to join our technical team. You will test our software applications, identify bugs, verify functionality, and help ensure the quality and reliability of our products, particularly in the Telecom and Cloud Communication industry.

Key Responsibilities
- Perform manual testing of web applications, software platforms, and dashboards.
- Understand project requirements and prepare test cases and test scenarios.
- Identify, report, and track bugs, errors, and software issues.
- Perform functional, regression, integration, and UI testing.
- Verify application functionality across different browsers and devices.
- Test user registration, login, payment workflows, dashboards, and other features.
- Work closely with developers to identify and resolve technical issues.
- Maintain proper documentation of test cases, test results, and bug reports.
- Ensure applications meet quality standards before deployment.
- Learn and perform API testing and basic database testing.

Required Skills
- Basic understanding of Software Testing and QA concepts.
- Knowledge of Manual Testing and SDLC/STLC.
- Understanding of test cases, test scenarios, and bug life cycle.
- Basic knowledge of web applications and browser testing.
- Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Postman, or similar tools is an advantage.
- Basic knowledge of SQL and API testing is preferred.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication skills and willingness to learn.

Educational Qualification
B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science, IT), BCA / MCA, B.Sc / M.Sc (Computer Science or IT), or any relevant technical qualification.

Experience
Freshers are welcome (0-1 year of experience in Software Testing or QA). Candidates with academic projects or internship experience in software testing will be preferred.

What We Offer
- Opportunity to work on real-world telecom and cloud communication products.
- Hands-on experience with software testing methodologies.
- Learning opportunities in API testing and automation testing.
- Collaborative and supportive technical environment.
- Career growth opportunities in Quality Assurance.
AboutCompany:
About Us
We are part of an established telecom group with many years of experience in global communications. We sell UCaaS (Unified Communications as a Service) and CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service) to businesses in India and around the world.
Our team works with major Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) worldwide. We help enterprises with cloud telephony, voice, SMS, messaging APIs, video, and collaboration tools. Our customers range from fast-growing startups to large enterprises and carriers, and we help them communicate better across every channel.
As part of our team, youll get global exposure and work closely with leading telecom operators and enterprise clients. This is a great opportunity to grow your career in one of the fastest-growing areas of the telecom industry.

Description:
Title
Our imaging services are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, office-based ECHO (Echocardiographer or Sonographer) to join our team in Mumbai, India. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the opportunity for you.
Overview
Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.
Responsibilities
Perform quality assurance checks on echocardiographic/ultrasound imaging data to ensure protocol specific requirements are met;
Perform established image processing techniques (converting imaging formats, performing preliminary measurements and volumes) on ECHO and U/S images using proprietary software as well as other third party software;
Compile and maintain project-specific status reports and project timelines associated with imaging studies;
Provide technical expertise to the project team related to ECHO and U/S imaging as needed; and
Track study status including subject status, scan status, timelines, etc.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree;
At least 2 years’ experience in Echocardiology and/or Sonography;
Excellent communication, organizational, and prioritization skills;
Knowledge of Microsoft Office;
Great attention to detail and excellent oral and written communication skills;
Experience with both general ultrasound and echocardiography is preferred; and
Experience working with clinical trials or within the pharmaceutical environment is preferred.
When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.
 Purpose-Driven Work
Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence
 Collaborative Culture
Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
 Continuous Growth & Development
Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly
 Other Employee Benefits
Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events 
 Please note benefits may vary based on country. 
  What to Expect Next
A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
AboutCompany: Medpace’s dedicated teams serve as an extension of your team – we engage quickly and provide strategic thinking – ensuring start-up times are met, superior quality, and the most efficient delivery of every phase of your clinical trial. Our therapeutic and regulatory experts are committed to streamlining your path to approval so every partnership is designed to create research solutions focused on your critical needs.

Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, SalesBusiness DevelopmentPresalesJLPT N1JLPT N2, Enterprise SalesHR ConsultingPartnershipsEnterprise BusinessCorporate Business Development, About company, UPRN Private Limited is an Indo-German healthcare workforce mobility company working to connect skilled Indian healthcare professionals with opportunities in Germany. Description:
UPRN Private Limited • Onsite, Bengaluru • Contractual • Freshers welcome

You've cleared JLPT N1 or N2. Now use your Japanese to build real relationships in Japan.

Want to use Japanese beyond the classroom? Interested in talking with native Japanese speakers, understanding a new industry and building something from the ground up? This could be your next step.

At UPRN, we connect Japanese hospitals, nursing homes and caregiving (Kaigo) facilities with trained Indian caregivers and healthcare professionals. We're a young team building an ethical recruitment business, and we need someone who can help us find new partners in Japan and start meaningful conversations with them.

You don't need prior sales experience. You need good Japanese, curiosity and the willingness to make things happen.

What you'll actually do
Find the right people. Research Japanese hospitals, nursing homes, care operators and staffing partners that could benefit from working with UPRN. Build organised lists of potential partners and identify the right contacts.
Start conversations in Japanese. Write emails, reach out on LinkedIn and other channels, and introduce UPRN to potential partners. Follow up politely and keep conversations moving.
Get on calls. Join conversations with Japanese partners, learn how business discussions work in Japan and gradually take on more responsibility.
Keep things organised. Track outreach, responses, follow-ups and next steps so no promising lead gets lost.
Bring back insights. Share what you learn about Japanese employers, their hiring needs and the challenges they face.
Help build the business. We're a small team, so the role won't be limited to a fixed checklist. You'll have the chance to contribute ideas, solve problems and take on new responsibilities as we grow.

You might be a good fit if...
You hold JLPT N1 or N2 and can communicate confidently in written and spoken Japanese.
You understand, or are keen to learn, Japanese business etiquette and Keigo.
You write clear, professional English.
You enjoy researching, finding information and connecting the dots.
You can write emails that sound natural, not robotic.
You're organised, persistent and comfortable following up.
You're curious about business and willing to learn by doing.

Freshers are welcome. You don't need an MBA, a sales background or years of corporate experience. We're interested in your language skills, communication, initiative and willingness to learn.

It's a bonus if you're interested in healthcare, caregiving or international recruitment, have spent time in Japan, or know about Japan's Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) programme.

What's in it for you?
Use Japanese every day. Put your language skills to work in real professional situations.
Interact with native Japanese speakers. Build confidence beyond textbooks, exams and classroom exercises.
Learn international business firsthand. Understand how partnerships are built across countries and cultures.
Work closely with the leadership team. Learn directly, ask questions and see how decisions are made.
Build skills that travel. Gain practical experience in B2B communication, research, lead generation and relationship management.
Grow with the company. As you gain experience, take ownership of partner relationships and more complex business conversations.
Make a visible contribution. In a small, growing team, your work has a direct impact on how the business develops.

A little about us
UPRN Private Limited is an international healthcare workforce mobility company connecting skilled Indian healthcare professionals with opportunities in Germany and Japan. We're building our business around ethical recruitment and long-term partnerships.

Company: Zylog Elastocomp Pvt. Ltd.

Job Title: Injection Moulding / Extrusion / Thermoforming Operator
Location: Tamil Nadu / Pune / Nashik
Contact: k.chaudhari@zylogelastocomp.com +91 85307 44457
Educational Qualification
CIPET / ITI (PPO) / Diploma in Plastics Engineering
OR relevant experience in Plastic Injection Moulding, Extrusion, or Thermoforming operations
Roles & Responsibilities
Production Activities
Take charge from the previous Trainee/Officer, including production activities related to grade, color, process parameters, and product specifications.
Check the number of batches weighed and verify the weight as per the compounding memo. Record the same in the Production Report.
Process materials as per the Process Specification Control Sheet (PSCS).
Maintain product quality and prevent any type of contamination.
Pack Finished Goods (FG) material as per the compounding memo.
Print FG identification labels as per PSCS requirements.
Ensure proper FG bag weight and stitching/sealing.
Report any abnormalities immediately to the Production Officer.
Ensure proper identification of Finished Goods (FG) and Work-in-Progress (WIP) materials.
Minimize start-up scrap generation.
Be responsible for shift-wise production, scrap generation, and WIP consumption.
Operate machines strictly as per SOPs, PSCS, and work instructions.
Train casual workers on process requirements and safety practices.
Coordinate with the Quality Officer to ensure smooth production flow.
Grind and consume daily generated start-up scrap in the respective grades on a shift-wise basis.
Production Record Maintenance
Maintain Production Cum Inspection Records and Daily Packing Details.
Maintain Weighing Scale Verification Records.
Make all production-related entries in the SAP system.
Maintain the Input vs. Output ratio.
Record the exact quantity of scrap in the Production Report.
Housekeeping, 5S, Safety & Other Responsibilities
Clean all machines and associated equipment.
Maintain 5S standards and actively participate in Kaizen activities.
Guide non-technical workers regarding shop-floor safety practices.
Follow all safety guidelines and use the required PPE at all times.
Maintain cleanliness and discipline in the work area.
Maintain personal hygiene and safe working practices.

Description:
Job description:
Deore Designs is an architectural and interior design studio delivering turnkey projects, from concept to execution, for homes and offices. Were looking for an Architect who can take a residential project from concept design through working drawings to rendered 3D views on their own.

Role & responsibilities
Develop concept designs, site planning and floor plans for residential buildings (bungalows, row houses and apartment buildings)
Prepare complete working drawings in AutoCAD: plans, elevations, sections, staircase, door/window schedules and construction details
Prepare municipal submission drawings in line with UDCPR and local authority (PMC/PMRDA) norms
Build accurate 3D models in SketchUp and produce photorealistic renders and walkthroughs in Lumion or V-Ray
Coordinate with structural, MEP and interior teams to integrate designs
Develop space planning and furniture layouts for residential and commercial (office) interiors
Prepare detailed 2D drawings in AutoCAD: layouts, elevations, ceiling, electrical, flooring and joinery/furniture details
Build accurate 3D models in SketchUp from the approved 2D drawings
Produce high-quality photorealistic renders and walkthroughs in D5 Render
Coordinate with site teams and contractors during execution, and resolve design queries

Preferred candidate profile
B.Arch with 4 to 5 years of experience in residential architecture and interiors
Strong command of AutoCAD, SketchUp and Lumion/V-Ray (essential)
Ability to independently prepare working drawings and rendered 3D views
A portfolio showing completed residential projects, including drawings and renders
Working knowledge of UDCPR, building bye-laws and construction practices
Ability to work independently and meet project timelines
Clear communication with clients, consultants and contractors

Perks and benefits
Flexible timing
Work from home and remote work option available

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Purpose

The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:

Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications:
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
Executive Indirect Taxation (Bhiwadi & Bangalore location)

The Executive Indirect Taxation will support the tax function by ensuring accurate GST compliance, audit readiness, strategic liaison and effective stakeholder communication within a dynamic environment. This role focuses on the timely filing of returns, accurate reconciliation of tax ledgers, data analysis, process Improvement and supporting the teams during statutory audits and assessments.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and file periodic GST returns ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conduct GST audit activities, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Interpret and apply GST rules, acts, and notifications to business transactions.
Timely coordinate with internal stakeholders and external tax authorities for dispute resolution and clarifications.
Generate management information system (MIS) reports to aid decisionmaking and highlight compliance risks.
Communicate tax implications and solutions to crossfunctional teams, facilitating problem identification and resolution.

Required Skills & Experience
58 years of handson experience in indirect taxation, predominantly GST, within the manufacturing sector who has handle huge volumes of data.
Proven ability to file GST returns and perform GST audits with minimal supervision.
Strong knowledge of GST Acts, rules, and recent amendments.
Excellent liaisoning and networking skills to interact with tax authorities, auditors, and internal departments.
Proficient in tax compliance software and advanced Excel, Power Point for MIS reporting.
Effective written and verbal communication, have ability to understand and act quickly, hard-working, proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
Professional certification such as B.Com, CMA (Inter) or CA (Inter),
Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for tax data extraction.
AboutCompany:
Fosroc is a leading global manufacturer of construction chemicals and performance solutions for the construction industry. Established in 1934 in the UK, the company has built a strong international presence across India, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and Africa.
Fosroc is known not just for products, but for providing complete technical solutions including site support, product specification guidance, testing, and application expertise.

Surface Treatments & Flooring Solutions

Brushbond (Waterproofing)
Renderoc (Repair mortars)
Nitoseal (Sealants)
Global Presence
Operations in around 20+ manufacturing facilities globally
Presence in 70+ countries
Strong market leadership in India and the Middle East
Approximately 3,000 employees worldwide

Description:
STARTEK is looking for Executive - Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

An Executive - Operations is responsible for overseeing the day - to - day operations of a company to ensure efficiency, profitability, and growth. Some of the key responsibilities for this role include : 1. Developing and implementing operational strategies. 2. Monitoring and analyzing operational metrics to identify areas for improvement and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 3. Express their operations strategies & objectives to make sure that the company which they are working for reaches its target and operates effectively. 4. Strong leadership and problem - solving skills, as well as the ability to analyze data and make informed decisions, are essential for success in this role.

Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Account ManagementField Sales, Key Client ManagementKey Account ManagementLarge Account ManagementB2B Sales, About company, Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their, respective base locations.
Description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their
respective base locations.
About the Team -
Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its
partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to
augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore
restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and
offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a
mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the
experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant
partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using
the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
Role Summary -
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned
Responsibilities -
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with
internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.
to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers
and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,
conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.



Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and
explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations
(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
"We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for
employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic
protected by the law."

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 0-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Skill required: Record To Report - Record To Report (R2R)

Designation: Record to Report Ops Analyst

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:3 to 5 years
About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world-s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?
You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data, reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions.
The Record to Report team helps clients and organizations in their operational efficiency and balance sheet integrity, cuts time to close and safeguards compliance with regulatory requirements.
The areas where this teams expertise lies is in Preparing and posting journal entries, preparing balance sheet reconciliations, supporting month end closing, preparing reports and supports in audits, perform variance analysis and provide comments for month over month movement in Trial Balance, perform reporting activities, perform intercompany related activities, FA and Lease related activities.
The Account Reconciliation team focuses on general ledger accounting which contains a summary of sub-ledger accounts. The role requires a good understanding of P&L accounts, bookkeeping, journal entries, voucher entry, trial balance, and month-end reporting.
The role may also need expertise around intercompany reconciliations, cut-off policies, transfer pricing policies, formal confirmation policy & procedure.

What are we looking for?
Adaptable and flexible
Ability to perform under pressure
Problem-solving skills
Detail orientation
Ability to establish strong client relationship
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders


Roles and Responsibilities:
Process asset additions, transfers, disposals, write-offs, and adjustments in ERP (SAP FI-AA,Oracle).
Execute monthly depreciation runs and post required accruals,reversals for CIP,AUC.
Prepare and reconcile fixed asset schedules with GL; complete roll-forward and statutory reports.
In this role, you are required to analyze and solve lower-complexity problems
Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
Your day to day interaction is with peers within Accenture before updating supervisors
You may have limited exposure with clients and Accenture management
You will be given moderate level instructions on daily work tasks and detailed instructions on new assignments
You will need to be well versed with basic Accounting and terms involved in the day to day business and use it while discussing with stakeholders
You will be expected to constantly be on the lookout for ways to enhance value for your respective stakeholders, clients
The decisions you make impact your work and may impact the work of others
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a focused scope of work.
Please note this role may require you to work in rotational shifts.
