Description:
Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development.
Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process
- Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
- Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
- Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
- Networks with local organizations (eg, Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
- Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.
- Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.
Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits
- Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
- Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.
- Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.
Assisting in Managing Employee Development
- Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
- Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
- Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations
- Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (eg, develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
- Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
- Utilizes an open door policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
- Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
- Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices
- Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
- Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
- Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
- Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
- Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
- Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (eg, property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc
- Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
- Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

Description:
Location: Udaipur, Rajasthan
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)
Experience: 0-3 Years (Freshly Qualified CAs may also apply)

About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic and analytical Chartered Accountant to join our Finance Excellence team. The role focuses on financial analysis, MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting, business performance reporting, cost and management accounting, and driving process excellence through data analytics and AI-enabled tools.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare and analyze monthly MIS reports, dashboards, and business performance reports.
Perform financial analysis to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Assist in annual budgeting, financial planning, and forecasting activities.
Conduct variance analysis and provide actionable insights to management.
Support cost accounting and management accounting processes.
Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and automate reports using Advanced Excel and AI tools.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams for data collection, validation, and reporting.
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely submission of financial reports.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization within the finance function.

Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of Financial Reporting, Budgeting, Forecasting, Costing, and MIS.
Proficiency in Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Dashboards, Advanced Formulas).
Good understanding of Financial Analysis and Business Reporting.
Exposure to AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Meta AI, etc.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and presentation skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory.
Strong academic background and analytical mindset.
Proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to learn new technologies.
Experience in manufacturing or corporate finance environment will be an added advantage.

Description:
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations.
Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions.
Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the ficial performance in all areas of responsibility.
Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced.
Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports.
Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (eg, banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (eg, dish room and purchasing).
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Leads kitchen management team.
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Title: Treasury ops - Nostro Management Operations
Corporate Title: NCT
Location: Jaipur, India


Role Description
Margin Treasury Operations (MTO) comprises two primary functions: Collateral Management Valuations (CMV) and Treasury Operations. Collateral Management is a First Line of Defence function responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. CMV is responsible for the management of bank's counterparty credit by issuing and processing margin calls on a daily basis. This function provides margin processing support for bilateral and cleared OTC derivatives, LD, Repo margin, CCP Margin, Portfolio reconciliations and Dispute Investigation and Valuation Client Services. Treasury Operations is responsible for funding all of bank's Nostro Accounts and ensuring optimal utilization of bank's funds across 8000+ agent bank accounts.
The Nostro Management team is responsible for the management of the unsecured funding of Deutsche Bank. The aim of the area is to ensure that the balances on the bank's main Commercial, Securities and Equities Nostro accounts are kept to a minimum and therefore the costs from overdrafts and lost opportunity are low. The tasks are performed using the strategic Global Nostro Management System (GCMS).


Your key responsibilities
Preparation Monitoring of various MIS reports and thereafter perform Root Cause Analysis for long/short nostro balances.
Regular follow-ups and interaction with different funding owners/trader/operations managers and group treasury.
Management of CIB Nostro accounts on behalf of Global Market Finance.
Responsible for all activities performed within the Nostro management. Functions broadly cover Funding, Reconciliations and Interest Allocation.
Ensuring the accurate forecasting of cash positions, thus reducing the economic cost.
Perform analysis of funding requirements.
Perform trend analysis on balances and liquidity.
Production of data for the allocation of Nostro Interest to responsible business areas.
Manage specific portfolio with the overall objective of minimizing RTB costs.
Providing appropriate Management Information to Nostro Funding and Business Line managers.
Continually looking for opportunities to challenge, standardize and improve processes both within Nostro Funding Ops and the Business Lines that we work with.
Providing appropriate Management Information to Business Line managers.
Continually looking for opportunities to challenge, standardize and improve processes
Ensure adherence to all cut-off times and quality of processing as maintained in SLA.
Fails management.
Support Risk and Control initiatives and facilitate ongoing monitoring
Keep all operational guidelines updated and ensure adherence to standards, procedures and also identify plan to mitigate risks where-ever there is a control issue
Ability to interface/ partner with the onshore
Ensure regular review and update of documents form the Business Contingency Management Perspective


Your skills and experience
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Multifunction Business/Product Knowledge
Banking and Securities Experience
At least 2 Years experience in a Nostro Management environment
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, strong Word and Excel skills required
Proficiency in automotive industry tools is beneficial.


Your personal skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates analytical thinking, accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions, think outside the box and connect with global stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment. An outstanding team spirit and flexibility are key.
Must be able to work to tight deadlines
Responsible for preparing and maintaining a comprehensive training plan for every employee in the team
Ensure cross training is practiced to enable manage resourcing effectively
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Skill required: Procure to Pay - Accounts Payable Processing

Designation: Procure to Pay Operations New Associate

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:0 to 1 years

What would you do? The Invoice Processing Team ensures accurate and timely processing of invoices, verifying them against purchase orders and receipts in compliance with company policies and tax regulations. The team maintains efficient financial operations, resolves discrepancies, and contributes to process improvements, supporting smooth accounts payable functions and strong vendor relationships.
Procure to Pay is the process of managing the entire purchasing cycle from ordering goods and services to making the final payment. It includes steps like requisitioning, purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and payment processing. The goal is to ensure efficient and accurate procurement and payment activities. This process helps in maintaining good supplier relationships and controlling costs. Effective Procure to Pay systems streamline operations and improve financial management. keyword includes:- ("Invoice Processing", "PO & Non PO","Vendor Payament","Master Data Managemet", "Vendor Management", "Accounts Payable")
Design, implement, manage and support accounts payable activities for an organization by applying the relevant processes, policies and applications.

What are we looking for?
? Bachelor??s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
? Knowledge in invoice processing, accounts payable, or finance-related roles.
? Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain a high degree of accuracy.
? Basic knowledge of accounting principles and financial documentation.
? Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software (SAP, Oracle,)

? Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
? Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
? Possesses exceptional business acumen to effectively guide the reporting team
Working Conditions
Moderate to no travel depending on project involvement.
Work hours at night.
Overtime and On-Call may be required.
Client holidays are observed instead of work location / regions

Roles and Responsibilities:
? Invoice Processing & Validation
? Process vendor invoices and credit notes within agreed timelines, including urgent invoices requiring priority handling.
? Validate invoice details for accuracy and completeness; identify non-compliant invoices and route them to the appropriate stakeholders for correction.
? Process both PO-based invoices using 2-way/3-way matching and non-PO invoices following required approval workflows.
? Ensure invoice data is correctly captured in the ERP/workflow system.
? Apply basic accounting knowledge to assess impacts on supplier ledgers, including invoices, credit memos, and discounts.
? Ensure adherence to country-specific tax and VAT requirements by reviewing invoice information carefully.
? Conduct quality checks for invoices and credit notes to ensure accuracy and compliance with internal rules.
? Maintain updated documentation and support periodic audits with required records.

? Issue Resolution /Handling exceptions
? Raise queries with internal business partners or suppliers when parking invoices, ensuring the correct reason codes are used.
? Perform multiple follow-ups via email or phone to resolve held, parked, or stuck invoices in accordance with business guidelines.
? Manage exceptions, GR/IR balances, vendor debit balances, direct debits, and invoices on hold, ensuring timely resolution.

Description:
Job Title - HCM Business Partner CB, IB Operations Controls, AVP
Location - Bangalore, Jaipur (India)
Role Description
About Human Resources
As a team, we partner with the business to drive an inclusive and sustainable performance culture. We take fair and transparent people decisions that are in the banks best interest. Our advice and products are focused, fact-based, relevant and improve employee experience in moments that matter. We shape Deutsche Banks working environment to enable our people to be the best they can be for our clients, the bank and society.
Overview
As the HR Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the people strategy for Corporate Bank (CB) and Investment Bank (IB) Operations Controls divisions in India, and drive HR initiatives to support business objectives. You will partner closely with senior leadership to provide both strategic and operational HR leadership for the identified divisions in the country.
Core expectations of this role are:
Functional leadership and partnership across HR
Governance, controls, and culture of excellence
Business partnership, ownership and accountability
Team / People leadership
Your key responsibilities
Implementation of HR s people strategy in partnership with Global, Divisional and Regional HR leadership
Provide HR functional leadership by fostering strong partnership, collaboration and engagement with the broader HR function, including regional and global stakeholders across business partner, product, country teams and process owners to deliver relevant HR solutions
Establish strong HR business partnerships by building trusted advisor relationships with regional and local stakeholders, providing independent HR guidance and advice, and taking ownership and accountability for all HR delivery and activities in India
Strengthen leadership effectiveness and build a robust talent pipeline for key senior roles in India
Create a positive and inclusive workplace culture that promotes employee engagement and retention
Drive global HR processes such as year-end compensation and promotion cycles and talent management, ensuring fair and consistent decisions with appropriate business management governance and ownership
Use key qualitative and quantitative metrics to inform decision-making and HR strategies
Implement diversity initiatives to raise awareness and improve gender diversity and inclusion
Participate in senior leadership team meetings, consulting on HR topics including leadership, policies and practices, diversity and inclusion, and talent management
Provide people leadership by fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning and feedback, sharing best practices, and actively supporting the development of the HR team
Your skills and experience
MBA (HR) with a minimum of 10+ years of HR domain experience, including strong knowledge of HR policies, products and processes
At least 3 5 years of experience within the Banking sector
Excellent stakeholder management, relationship-building and communication skills
Experience working in a complex, multicultural, matrix organisation
Ability to operate independently and objectively to achieve the right people outcomes for the franchise
Solutions-oriented with an innovative mindset

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Expert, AVP
Location: Bangalore, India
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements and facilitate exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA and US regions.
Your key responsibilities
Be a central point of contact for external clients on valuations and responding / resolving their queries / disputes in a timely and professional manner and having to build strong working relationships with various front and back offices departments globally
Coordinate with such areas as Trading, Sales, Product control and Middle Office to resolve escalated customer inquiries and disputes
Close interaction with regional and global teams to ensure consistency in procedures and policy and to stay aware of organizational objectives
Keep Management informed of the exceptional occurrences, to enable appropriate action
Manage risks relating to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and guidelines
Re-engineering the current process to meet the changing needs of the business. Leading/contributing to various projects which are kicked off in the department to increase efficiency in the process.
Manage operational risk by checking strength of existing controls and recommend/implement new or improved controls
Expected to monitor KPIs and KRIs of the process.
Lead and contribute to Global initiatives that could be strategic and tactical in nature
Knowledge of TriResolve, Acadiasoft is must
Knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and other self-service analytical and data interpretation tools will be an advantage
Your skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Ability to connect with people as well as desire to learn process flows. Dedication to servicing a demanding internal and external client base.
Ability to mentor and coach the new joiners. Professional skills
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Experience working in a global, cross matrix reporting organization
Should have detailed understating of Derivatives, Trade Life Cycle, UnCleared Margin Rules, reconciliations and settlements processes
Microsoft Excel skills to a good standard.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Manager / Senior Manager Sub Broker Channel Sales
(Fixed Income Products)
Locations

About the Role
We are looking for dynamic and relationship-driven professionals to expand our distribution
and sub-broker network for fixed income investment products. The role involves onboarding,
managing, and activating financial distributors, wealth partners, IFAs, MFDs, PMS/AIF
distributors, and other intermediary channels.
The candidate should have strong connections with distributors actively selling financial
products, including Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, P2P products, insurance, structured products,
or alternative investments. Prior fixed income experience is preferred but not mandatory.

Build and manage a strong network of:
IFAs
MFDs
Wealth Managers
Sub Brokers
PMS/AIF Distributors
Family Office Relationship Managers
Financial Product Distributors
Drive sales and distribution of:
Private NCDs
PTCs
Credit AIFs
Structured Debt Products
Other fixed income and yield-based investment opportunities
Source and activate new distribution partners across assigned geographies
Conduct product presentations, training sessions, and partner engagement meetings
Support distributors in client acquisition, transaction execution, and closures
Coordinate with internal teams for onboarding, documentation, compliance, and
execution
Maintain strong relationships with active partners and increase wallet share
Track distributor activity, investor appetite, and market opportunities
Desired Candidate Profile
2–10 years of experience in channel sales / distribution partnerships within financial
services
Strong network with distributors actively selling:
Mutual Funds
PMS
AIFs
P2P products
Bonds
Insurance
Alternative investment products
Candidates from AMCs managing the MFD / IFA channel are highly preferred
Experience in fixed income products is preferred but not mandatory
Strong relationship management and business development skills
Good understanding of investment products and financial markets
Self-driven, target-oriented, and entrepreneurial mindset
Preferred Background
Candidates from the following organizations/platforms may be relevant:
Asset Management Companies (AMC sales / MFD channel teams)
Wealth management firms
Bond distribution platforms
PMS/AIF distribution firms
NBFCs
Fintech distribution businesses
Broking houses
Financial advisory firms
Compensation
Fixed salary + attractive performance-linked incentives
Fast-growth opportunity in institutional and fixed income distribution

Description:
About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

An IP Pre Sales Consultant supports sales teams with product, service, and solution offerings. Identifies business opportunities, understands customer needs, provides technical expertise, and supports customer decisions through customised solutions and presentations. provides specialised technical and solution expertise to support sales. Identifies new business opportunities, presents and demonstrates Nokia solutions, and develops customer-focused strategies using a consultative selling approach.
HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
Master Nokia's IP Portfolio: Develop comprehensive expertise in Nokia's Internet Protocol (IP) networking solutions-including the 7750 Service Router (SR) family, 7250 Interconnect Router (IXR), 7705 Service Aggregation Router (SAR), 7210 Service Access Switch (SAS), and Network Services Platform (NSP)-and confidently present their capabilities to customers, partners, and stakeholders.

Market Intelligence: Monitor IP industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to inform sales strategy.
Competitive Positioning: Articulate differentiators against competing IP platforms or advisory firms using ROI models and use-case narratives.
Technical Discovery: Conduct discovery sessions with prospects to understand their IP workflows, portfolio size, budget, and integration needs.
Training & Enablement: Train partners and internal teams on IP solutions, protocols, and integration best practices.
Qualifications
You Have
Bachelor degree with 10-15 years of relevant experience.
Delivers short-term impact through individual and team contributions within the assigned function or subject area.
Works autonomously as a subject matter expert, analysing and implementing concepts and solutions.
Provides measurable input to new products, processes, standards, and operational plans.
It would be nice if you also had:
Makes decisions, prioritises work, and executes plans to meet business and customer needs.
Leads people and oversees processes where applicable, ensuring effective execution of plans and policies.
Handles complex and changing situations, applying specialised knowledge to develop practical solutions.
Communicates effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, vendors, and senior leaders

Job Description of Lady Security Guard
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergency situations, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to Supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorized person
Write appropriate reports as required

Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves

Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from employer and 12% from Employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits

Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Our jobs arent just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Operations Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services across all front-of-house activities that guide guests through their entire stay.
Their role takes ownership of the guest experience in the main areas of the hotel with a guest first mindset.
They are empowered to move about their space across, front desk, food & beverage, housekeeping and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, delivering quality meals, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Operations Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Manage Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest and YouTube accounts.
Plan and schedule daily posts, reels, stories and other content.

Hands-on experience managing Instagram and other social platforms.
Good understanding of reels, content strategy, hashtags and social media trends.
Strong Hindi and English writing skills.
Knowledge of Canva and basic video editing is an advantage.
Ability to analyse insights and improve content performance.
Experience with photography, wedding or luxury brands is preferred.
A portfolio or links to previously managed social media accounts are required.
What We Offer
Opportunity to work with a premium wedding photography brand.
Creative freedom to develop engaging wedding content.
A collaborative and creative working environment.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Designation - Assistant Manager HR (Area HR) - Warehouse
Education - Diploma/Degree , MBA
Age - Up to 38 ( Only Male Candidate )
Experience - 10 to 15 years
Job Description -
1 Talent Acquisition and Onboarding
Manage hiring for all on-roll and contractual roles as per the approved manpower plan.
Coordinate with contractors for daily/weekly manpower availability and ensure the same.
Drive joining formalities, documentation, ID creation, induction and plant orientation.
2. Employee Life Cycle Management (End-to-End)
Maintain employee records, personal files, contract staff muster, shift rosters.
Ensure timely confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments, and separations.
Drive exit formalities, full & final settlement coordination, and attrition control.
3. HR Operations & Payroll Coordination
Ensure accurate inputs for attendance, incentives, weekly off etc.
Verify contractor bills and ensure compliance with MW and Payment of wages & PF/ESIC etc.
Coordinate with the payroll team for timely disbursal and issue resolutions if any.
4. Contract Labour Management
Oversee onboarding, attendance, wage compliance and statutory records for all off-roll employees.
Conduct monthly contractor audits: PF/ESIC challans, wage slips, muster, bonus, leave etc
Ensure CLRA license, RC, and documentation are valid.
5. Statutory Compliance & Audits
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and other state-specific regulations.
Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for inspections.
Support external audits: FSSAI etc
6. Industrial Relations & Discipline
Handle shop floor discipline issues, grievances, counselling, and issue of notices/charge sheets where needed.
Support healthy employee relations in close coordination with the Factory Manager and Area HR Head.
Maintain harmonious relations between staff, operators, contract workforce, and contractors.
7. Training & Capability Building
Identify unit-level training needs (food safety, GMP, safety, HR policy awareness).
Conduct daily/weekly briefing talks or coordinate functional training.
Maintain training records and skill-matrix for operators.
8. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive engagement calendar: festivals, R&R, skip-levels, suggestion programs.
Ensure availability of welfare facilities: drinking water, rest area, washrooms, PPE, first-aid, canteen.
Monitor hygiene, safety and morale on the shopfloor.
9. HR MIS, Analytics & Reporting
Prepare and maintain monthly HR dashboards:
Attendance, attrition, overtime, contractor compliance score, open positions, training records, statutory status.
Share daily/weekly MIS with Factory Manager & Area HR Head.
10. Support to Business & Operations
Partner with production, quality and shift leads to ensure manpower efficiency.
Support productivity, food safety and operational performance through timely HR interventions.
Drive culture of discipline, safety, responsibility and performance.

Job Location - Bangalore,Mumbai{Kalyan , Bhiwandi (padgha)} Maharashtra,Hyderabad

Description:
position: Mainframe Test Engineer / Senior Mainframe Test Analyst
Experience: 410 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Pune (as applicable)
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Mainframe Testing Professional with 410 years of experience in testing Mainframe applications. The candidate should have strong expertise in Mainframe technologies, testing methodologies, defect management, and automation exposure. Experience in Banking, Insurance, Retail, or Healthcare domains will be an added advantage.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical design documents.
Create and execute test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts.
Perform Functional Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, and Regression Testing.
Validate Mainframe batch and online transactions.
Review JCLs, COBOL programs, VSAM files, and DB2 data for testing purposes.
Execute batch jobs and analyze job failures.
Perform data validation using DB2, SQL, File-AID, and SPUFI.
Log, track, and manage defects using defect tracking tools.
Coordinate with Developers, Business Analysts, and Project Stakeholders.
Participate in test planning, estimation, and status reporting.
Support UAT and production validation activities.
Must-Have Skills
Mainframe Testing
COBOL
JCL (Job Control Language)
DB2
VSAM
CICS
File-AID
TSO/ISPF
Endevor or Changeman
SDLC & STLC
Defect Management Tools (JIRA, ALM, QC)
Good-to-Have Skills
Mainframe Automation Testing
REXX Scripting
Selenium/Test Automation exposure
API Testing
Agile/Scrum methodology
BFSI domain experience (Banking/Insurance)

Description:
Responsibilities
General Sourcing / Procurement: Spend Analysis, Category savings assessment, Procurement Diagnostics, Operating Model Design, Procurement Process Design, end-to-end Procurement Transformation & Modernization, Design and execution of Strategic Sourcing initiatives including RFI / RFP (Request for
Information / Request for Proposal) design, development and analysis, Negotiation strategy, Supplier
Management, Third Party Lifecycle Management, Supplier Risk Management, Contract Management, M&A -
Procurement Synergy Assessments, Source-to-Pay Assessment, Design & Implementation, Category management with knowledge of various Direct & Indirect Categories. Candidates with experience in setting up large scale procurement COE for clients would be plus.
Experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba / Fieldglass, GEP, Celonis and/or
Ivalua as an implementer and administrator; ERP knowledge SAP / PeopleSoft / ORACLE or others is
preferred.
Preferable to have an active Coupa platform certification; Additional specialization certifications within Coupa
would be a bonus.
Understanding of fundamental principles of P2P including spend and commodity taxonomies, requisitioning, PO
generation, receiving and invoice processing
- Supporting client engagements across industry verticals with a focus on operations transformation
- Managing strategic sourcing initiatives, including RFI/RFP design and supplier negotiations
- Implementing and administering Procure-to-Pay platforms such as Coupa, enhancing procurement processes
- Conducting spend analysis and category savings assessments to optimize procurement strategies
- Designing procurement operating models and transformation plans for client organizations
- Collaborating with clients to develop procurement diagnostics and modernization strategies
- Utilizing knowledge of eInvoicing and AP automation to streamline invoice processing and supplier networks
- Leading procurement process improvement initiatives to drive efficiency and cost savings
- Monitoring contractual compliance and supplier relationship management to mitigate risks
- Analyzing supply chain data to inform strategic decisions and improve operational performance
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Active Coupa platform certification
- Experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platforms
- Experience in Coupa implementation
- Understanding of fundamental P2P principles
- Experience with AP automation and eInvoicing
- Knowledge of eInvoicing submittals including EDI, CSV, XML
- Demonstrating analytical thinking in complex procurement scenarios
- Excelling in supplier relationship management and negotiation

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for energetic and target-driven Seller Business Development Associates (BDA) to join our Field Sales team.

Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.

Onboard property owners and promote premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring a positive customer experience.

Eligibility:
PUC or Graduation is mandatory.
Smart Freshers can apply.
Candidates with up to 1 years of Field Sales experience can apply.
Candidates should have strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Two-wheeler/Bike and valid Driving Licence.
Smartphone.
Comfortable communicating in English along with at least one required regional language.

Experience: 4 to 8 years preferred
Job Location: Gurugram, Hyderabad, Bangalore
Primary Skills: BMC Remedy, BMC Helix ITSM, Workflow Customization, Automation, DWP, Innovation Studio
Role Summary:
We are looking for an experienced BMC Remedy / Helix Developer with strong hands-on expertise in developing, customizing, and automating BMC Remedy/Helix solutions. The candidate should have experience with Helix migration, Digital Workplace (DWP) Catalogs, and BMC Innovation Studio. Exposure to HelixGPT / Generative AI capabilities will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and customize BMC Remedy / BMC Helix ITSM applications based on business requirements.
Design, develop, and maintain Remedy workflows, including Forms, Active Links, Filters, Escalations, Guides, Menus, and related objects.
Build workflow automation to improve ITSM processes and reduce manual activities.
Customize key ITSM modules such as Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Asset, and Service Request Management.
Support BMC Remedy to BMC Helix migration, including application/workflow migration, configuration, data migration, validation, and post-migration stabilization.
Develop and customize BMC Digital Workplace (DWP) Catalogs, service requests, questionnaires, approvals, and fulfillment workflows.
Build and enhance applications and workflows using BMC Helix Innovation Studio.
Develop integrations between BMC Helix and enterprise systems using REST APIs, web services, and integration frameworks.
Troubleshoot workflow, customization, integration, and performance issues across Remedy/Helix environments.
Follow development standards, perform unit testing, maintain technical documentation, and support production deployments.
Work closely with functional teams, architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Data Governance Consultant to join the Data & Analytics consulting practice, leading data governance engagements for clients in India and outside India. This is a client-facing, hands-on role: the engagement lead on the ground, responsible for assessing data management maturity, designing and implementing governance operating models, data ownership and stewardship, and enabling the supporting data catalogue and data quality capabilities.
The role requires someone who can run an engagement end to end, from scoping and workshops through implementation and adoption, while remaining hands-on in the work. It works with client stakeholders across business and technology, up to CDO and head-of-function level.
Not a pure people management role, a purely advisory governance role, or a coding-heavy data engineering role, though familiarity with data engineering concepts is useful.
Key Responsibilities
Lead data governance engagements end to end: scope the work, plan delivery, manage client expectations, and act as the primary point of contact for client business and technology stakeholders.
Lead data maturity assessments (DCAM or similar); identify gaps, define remediation roadmaps and secure client agreement on priorities.
Design and implement the client's data governance operating model: data domains, ownership, stewardship roles, governance forums, RACI and decision rights.
Author and drive adoption of the client's governance framework: policies, standards, procedures, data quality rules and stewardship guidelines.
Implement data quality capabilities: critical data element identification, rule definition, measurement and issue management.
Enable the client's data catalogue (OpenMetadata, Collibra, Alation, Informatica or similar) as part of the governance rollout: business glossary, ownership, classification, lineage and metadata onboarding of priority sources.
Translate governance policies and standards into executable workflows, SOPs and operating processes, and track governance KPIs such as ownership coverage, glossary completeness, stewardship participation and adoption progress.
Run client workshops and steering updates; prepare executive-level communication; lead the governance content of proposals and pitch material; guide and review the work of junior consultants on the engagement.
What We're Looking For
Must have
9 to 12 years of experience in data governance, data management or related consulting roles, preferably in financial services, banking or enterprise data environments.
Has led at least two data governance engagements end to end as the primary client contact, with implementation responsibility and not only assessment or advisory.
Strong understanding of data governance principles, frameworks and practices: DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM, data ownership and stewardship, data quality and metadata management.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing governance operating models, ownership and stewardship, and policy and standards adoption at a client or in-house.
Practical experience with at least one data catalogue or metadata platform in a governance capacity: glossary, ownership, classification, lineage.
Experience drafting data governance policy, standards and operating model documents.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior client stakeholders, manage expectations and explain governance concepts to non-technical audiences.
Experience contributing to proposals, pitches and engagement scoping.
Good to have
Experience with clients outside India, including the Middle East.
DCAM or CDMP certification.
Hands-on implementation or configuration of any enterprise data catalogue tool (OpenMetadata, Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Atlan, Purview, Unity Catalog or similar).
MDM programme experience.
Regulatory data governance context (RBI, BCBS 239, CBUAE or similar).
Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management or a related field. Certifications such as CDMP or DCAM are a plus.
Requisition Fields
Requisition title: Senior Data Governance Consultant
Minimum years of experience: 9
Maximum years of experience: 12
Mandatory skills: Data Governance, Data Management, Data Stewardship, Data Quality Management, Client Engagement, Engagement Leadership, Communication Skills, Data Catalog, Business Glossary, Metadata, Data Lineage, Data Classification, Critical Thinking
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Mode of work: Hybrid
Type of hire: Lateral

Leads client engagements end to end as primary client contact, with hands-on implementation of governance operating models, ownership and stewardship, data quality and catalogue capabilities. Strong understanding of DAMA-DMBOK and DCAM.

Experience: 4 to 10 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Financials certification.
At least 1 year or full implementation of Workday Financials along with end to end support on Accounting Center/Prism.
At least 3 years of relevant Workday experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Subject Matter Expertise on Accounting Center Processes and reports while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Functional experience in several Workday Finance modules like Financial Accounting, Common Financial Management, Customers, Customer Accounts, Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Projects.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various Finance modules and hands on experience configuring FDM structure and business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.

In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Preferred Skills:
Good to have Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Reporting, FDM and other certifications related to Workday Finance functional areas.
Knowledge on using Customer Central for configuration and migration.
Demonstrates thorough abilities and/or a proven record of success working in a collaborative environment to collect and refine business requirements along with the associated development activities to deliver the appropriate reporting solutions within Workday Accounting Center;
Demonstrates competencies in verbal and written communication skills via experience in leading business requirements gathering and design sessions;
Demonstrates thorough abilities in data profiling and governance principles to ensure data integrity and quality throughout the development life cycle, and utilizes data modeling, design, and visualization tools and principles;
Demonstrates thorough knowledge of SQL, including database queries;
Serves as a subject matter expert regarding Workday Accounting Center; and
Demonstrates critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
