Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. MLOps/LLMOps Pipeline Design
Design and implement end-to-end CI/CD/CT pipelines for traditional ML models and LLM-based applications.
Build reproducible workflows for data preparation, training, fine-tuning, validation, packaging, and deployment.
Use MLflow for experiment tracking, model versioning, and lifecycle management.
Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Databricks Asset Bundles) and Git-based deployment practices.
Define promotion strategies (dev staging prod) with automated quality gates.
2. LLM Serving & Inference Optimization
Deploy and manage LLMs (open-source and proprietary) using Databricks Model Serving / Mosaic AI, vLLM, TGI, or similar frameworks.
Optimize inference latency, throughput, and cost through quantization, batching, KV-cache optimization, model distillation, and GPU utilization tuning.
Configure autoscaling, provisioned throughput, rate limiting, and failover strategies.
Manage AI Gateway configurations, API endpoints, and multi-model routing.
3. Automated LLM Evaluation Pipelines
Build automated evaluation frameworks for LLM and RAG applications using MLflow LLM Evaluate, Mosaic AI Agent Evaluation, RAGAS, DeepEval, or similar tools.
Implement LLM-as-a-judge, golden datasets, regression testing, and human-in-the-loop feedback loops.
Track metrics such as groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, toxicity, hallucination rate, latency, and cost per query.
Integrate evaluation as a mandatory gate in CI/CD before production releases.
4. Observability & Drift Detection
Implement monitoring for model performance, data drift, concept drift, and prediction quality using Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring and inference tables.
Build LLM observability: tracing, token usage, latency, error rates, and prompt/response logging (MLflow Tracing, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or OpenTelemetry).
Set up dashboards and alerts (Grafana, Prometheus, Databricks SQL dashboards) with defined SLAs/SLOs.
Drive root-cause analysis and automated retraining or rollback triggers.
5. Model & Prompt Governance (Unity Catalog)
Govern models, prompts, features, vector indexes, and datasets using Unity Catalog.
Implement prompt versioning, prompt registries, and model lineage tracking.
Enforce access control, audit logging, PII handling, and responsible AI guardrails.
Ensure compliance with internal security policies and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, EU AI Act where applicable).
6. Databricks Workflows & Airflow
Orchestrate ML and LLM pipelines using Databricks Workflows (Jobs) and Apache Airflow.
Design robust DAGs with dependency management, retries, alerting, and SLA monitoring.
Integrate orchestration with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
7. RAG Pipeline Operations
Operationalize Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and generation.
Manage vector databases (Databricks Vector Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.) including index sync, refresh, and scaling.
Monitor and improve retrieval quality (recall@k, MRR, context precision) and embedding freshness.
Optimize chunking strategies, hybrid search, re-ranking, and caching for performance and cos

Description:
Position: Business Analyst -Senior Techno-Functional Payment Application Designer with knowledge of domestic (NACHA, FedWire) and cross-border (SWIFT) payment schemes.
Experience: 7-20 years
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Mumbai

A talented, versatile, and hands-on **Functional Payments Expert** responsible for devising and delivering cutting-edge, innovative payment solutions. The ideal candidate is a **self-motivated individual** with strong awareness of payments industry trends, bank processing models, payment security, and end-to-end transaction lifecycles with understanding of Technology to design a solution.
Strong **business acumen**, positive work ethics, and a **collaborative mindset** are key to success in this role. The candidate will work closely with **cross-functional teams** including business, product, analytics, UX, and engineering, requiring excellent **articulation, negotiation, and influencing skills** due to high stakeholder visibility.
This role acts as a **bridge between business, product, and implementation teams**, translating business needs into scalable, high-performance payment solutions. The individual is expected to be an **effective leader, mentor, and thought leader**, contributing to future-ready payment architectures and strategies.
The role combines **functional design leadership, solution selling, and client-facing engagement**, requiring deep working knowledge of payments and modern distributed system architectures.
Your future duties and responsibilities
ead techno-functional design and solution definition for complex payment systems, translating business requirements into scalable and resilient solutions
Act as a bridge between business, product, and engineering teams, ensuring alignment across requirements, design, and implementation
Drive requirement elicitation, analysis, and documentation, including BRDs, functional specifications, process flows, data/message mappings, and user stories
Own end-to-end functional design for payment flows, including initiation, validation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
Define and review functional decomposition aligned to microservices and domain-driven design principles
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure functional designs align with technical architecture (such as microservices, MQ or Kafka-based event flows, database modelling, UI design etc.).
Validate functional designs against non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, resiliency, security, and regulatory compliance
Support Development, FAT, UAT and implementation phases, including scenario definition, validation support, and issue analysis.
Provide functional guidance during production issue analysis and root cause investigations, especially for payment failures and reconciliation breaks.
Engage directly with clients and senior stakeholders, presenting designs, explaining solution options, and influencing design decisions
Contribute to solution selling and pre-sales activities, including proposal support, solution walkthroughs, and client discussions.
Mentor junior designers and analysts, promoting best practices and thought leadership in payments design.
Contribute to future-state architecture and product roadmap discussions, incorporating industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies.
Ensure all functional artifacts are accurate, complete, and audit-ready, supporting operational and compliance needs.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and cross-team design reviews.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must-Have Skills:
General / Functional Skills
* Proven experience in **product development** with strong focus on **techno-functional design, decomposition, and solution definition**
* Strong **UML modeling skills**, preferably using **Sparx Enterprise Architect**
* Ability to understand, analyze, and document **business requirements** from diverse stakeholders
* Expertise in **Business Analysis**, **Requirement Elicitation**, **Gap & Impact Analysis**, **Message/Data Mapping**, and **FAT validation**
* Experience producing **BRDs, Functional Specifications, Process Flow Diagrams, User Stories, Backlogs**, and related artifacts
* Excellent **written and verbal communication skills**
* Strong **client-facing experience**, including interaction with senior executives (internal and external)
* Solid understanding of **technical aspects of software products**, including:
* Interfaces & APIs
* Connectivity & integration patterns
* Databases
* Application servers & middleware
* SOA and distributed systems
* Data warehousing, archival, and purge strategies
* Hands-on experience across the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
* Strong working knowledge of **Agile delivery models**
Payments Domain Expertise
* Extensive experience in **payments-related software development projects or products**
* Strong proficiency in **SWIFT**, **SWIFT GPI**, **NACHA**, **CHAPS**
* Hands-on experience with **Clearing & Settlement Systems** across **Europe, Canada, and the US**
* Experience working with **at least two clearing systems in different countries**
* Proven track record of **product or project implementation** in **medium to large-scale banks**
Architecture & Technology (Key Additions)
* Strong **working knowledge of Microservices Architecture**, including:
* Service decomposition and domain-driven design concepts
* API-driven integration and service orchestration
* Working knowledge of designing interfaces.
* Resilience, scalability, and fault-tolerance considerations in payment systems
* Performance optimization and high availability considerations
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams to ensure **functional designs align with scalable, performant system architectures**
Good-to-Have Skills:
* Experience with **SWIFT Service Bureau** implementations
* Exposure to **product roadmap planning** and **DevOps strategies**
* Site implementation experience with leading payment products such as **Fundtech** or **Clear2Pay**
* Experience representing organizations in **external forums, industry panels, or conferences**
* Strong understanding of **CI/CD pipelines and operational readiness for payment platforms**

Description:
Role: Devops and Cloud L3 & Architect
Exp: 7yrs to 18yrs
Location Flex: Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Shift: Rotational
Mode of Working: Hybrid

Mandatory Skill to Apply: Devops + Multi Cloud( Any 2- AWS/Azure/GCP) + CI/CD or Jenkins + Git + IAC (Terraform or Automation or Ansible)

Core / Must-Have Skills:-

Strong CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps
Strong hands-on Terraform
Docker & Kubernetes
At least one managed Kubernetes platform: EKS / AKS / GKE
Helm and/or Argo CD
Python and/or Shell/Bash scripting
Practical experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
DevSecOps pipeline integration
Monitoring/observability experience
Git and modern branching/deployment strategies
Strong troubleshooting skills across application delivery and cloud environments

Detailed JD:

The Multi-Cloud DevOps, DevSecOps & Platform Engineer will design, build, automate and support modern software delivery and cloud platform solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role requires strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud platforms, observability and automation. The engineer will collaborate with application, cloud, security and operations teams to build secure, scalable and reusable deployment solutions while improving release reliability and engineering efficiency.
Candidates should have strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to additional cloud platforms and multi-cloud environments is preferred.
1. CI/CD & DevOps Engineering
Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and/or Jenkins.
Implement Git-based workflows, reusable pipeline templates, artifact management, environment promotion, approvals and rollback mechanisms.
Implement GitOps deployment practices using Argo CD and Helm for Kubernetes workloads.
Integrate automated testing, code-quality checks and security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures and improve build and release efficiency.
Build reusable pipeline components and automation to support consistent software delivery.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Build reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, versions, variables and environment configurations.
Implement IaC validation, testing and configuration/drift-management practices.
Use Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation where required.
Develop Python and Shell/Bash automation for infrastructure provisioning, API integration and Day-2 operational activities.
Automate repeatable infrastructure and platform activities to reduce manual intervention.
3. DevSecOps & Security Automation
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, container/image scanning and secrets detection.
Implement secure artifact, container image and dependency-management practices.
Integrate secrets-management and key-management solutions with pipelines and application deployments.
Apply appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles for pipeline and runtime identities.
Work with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Support automated security and compliance validation within the software delivery lifecycle.
4. Multi-Cloud & PaaS Engineering
Implement DevOps and deployment solutions across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Work with relevant PaaS and serverless services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions.
Support application teams with standardized approaches for build, deployment, configuration, secrets, networking and monitoring.
Leverage cloud-native services while maintaining reusable and consistent DevOps practices.
Support hybrid and multi-cloud deployment requirements where applicable.
5. Containers, Kubernetes & GitOps
Build, deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Implement Kubernetes application packaging and deployments using Helm and Argo CD.
Configure deployments, autoscaling, ingress, secrets, configuration and application upgrade strategies.
Integrate container/image scanning and Kubernetes security controls into CI/CD processes.
Troubleshoot application deployment, container and Kubernetes platform issues across environments.
6. Observability & SRE Practices
Implement monitoring and observability across applications, infrastructure and Kubernetes using Datadog, Dynatrace and/or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Configure and manage metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts.
Support SLI/SLO-based monitoring, incident management and operational runbooks.
Automate common operational, monitoring and remediation activities.
Analyze telemetry to improve application reliability, deployment stability and platform performance.
Participate in incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous reliability improvements.

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP-BODS-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, asking questions, and using these moments as opportunities to grow. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS to provide advisory services, design data migration solutions, and support data cleansing activities.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration needs and challenges
- Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
- Managing data migration processes, including building, testing, and executing migrations with SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing requirements
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs based on migration experience and programming knowledge
- Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools like Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration from source systems to S/4 HANA
- Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and address their data management needs
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Description:
Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Program Manager- DevOps-Cloud Platform Engineering
Experience: 12+Years
Shift: General Shift (Flexibility required for global stakeholder engagements)
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Pune/Mumbai
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
Technical Program Manager accountable for delivering the CCOE transformation program: an Operations Control Plane, The role is AI-first by mandate: the TPM is expected to design, prove, and scale AI-assisted operations across the program. It combines hands-on technical credibility someone who still builds, prototypes, and reviews code with large-scale program leadership across engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders, and a demonstrated bias for speed and measurable outcomes.
Your future duties and responsibilities
• Plan and run PI cadences: scope, dependencies, capacity, exit criteria, and transparent re-planning across all CCOE workstreams.
• Drive wave-based rollouts (e.g., observability across multi-tenant AKS estates) within client change windows and government compliance constraints.
• Build funding and business cases spanning multiple internal organizations; force decisions through steering with stated cost of delay.
• Referee build-vs-buy and competing-architecture decisions against written criteria; time-box debates and document decisions with revisit conditions.
• Lead vendor evaluation and enterprise contract negotiation for platform tooling — pricing, support SLAs, security and compliance terms.
• Report program outcomes without spin: MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage, and SLA adherence.
• Partner with operations leadership on workforce transition: reskilling, redeployment, and adoption of new tooling and workflows — including AI literacy and safe, governed use of AI tooling.
• Own the AI roadmap for operations: LLM-assisted triage, RAG over runbooks, tickets, and telemetry, agentic remediation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows — from prototype through production with evaluation, guardrails, and cost controls.
• Define AI governance with security and compliance: data residency, PII handling, prompt and output logging, human-in-the-loop gates, and model/version change control for government clients.
• Drive urgency through time-boxed delivery: bias to 2–4 week proof points, kill or scale decisions on evidence, and visible burn-down of the riskiest unknowns first.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must to Have Skills:
• Azure platform depth (primary cloud): AKS at multi-tenant production scale, Azure networking (VNet, Private Link, Front Door, App Gateway), Entra ID, Azure Policy and landing-zone/Well-Architected design, autoscaling, tenancy isolation, and cost management (FinOps, reservations, tagging, chargeback).
• Azure services breadth: Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (KQL), Managed Grafana, Key Vault, Storage, API Management, Functions and Container Apps, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Azure SQL, and DevOps/GitHub integration. • Observability: Understanding of OpenTelemetry-based stacks (traces, logs, metrics), sampling and retention economics, and alert tuning at scale.
• CI/CD and GitOps: Understanding of GitHub Actions, Argo CD, incremental builds, and policy-as-code gates (OPA, Kyverno, Conftest) with container signing and scanning.
• Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management: Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible, and configuration-in Git with drift detection.
• Identity and security: Understanding of SSO, RBAC, and JIT access patterns (Entra ID, Keycloak); secrets and certificate lifecycle automation (Key Vault, cert-manager, ACME).
• AI and GenAI fundamentals: LLM capabilities and limits, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured output and function/tool calling, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs, token and inference cost management, and latency/quality trade-offs.
• RAG and knowledge systems: chunking and embedding strategies, vector and hybrid search (Azure AI Search, pgvector, or equivalent), re-ranking, grounding and citation, retrieval evaluation, and mitigation of hallucination and data leakage.
• Agentic and AI-assisted operations: multi-step agents and orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent), Model Context Protocol (MCP) style tool integration, and evaluation and observability of AI systems (eval harnesses, golden datasets, tracing, drift monitoring).
• Understanding of Azure AI stack: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model deployment and quota management, private networking for AI endpoints, content safety, and responsible-AI controls.
• Hands-on engineering ability: comfortable in Python (and/or Go or TypeScript), Git-based workflows, SQL/KQL, and shipping working prototypes without waiting for a team to be assigned.
• Program tooling fluency: PI and agile planning at scale, RICE or equivalent prioritization, and dependency and risk management.
Good-to-Have Skills:
• 12+ years in technology, including 5+ years running multi-team technical programs (8–15 initiatives) as a TechPM, program lead, or platform delivery lead.
• Operations transformation: moving support and operations organizations from reactive firefighting to problem management and SRE practices.
• FOSS-biased platform strategy with explicit commercial buy triggers; hands-on vendor MSA negotiation.
• Developer platform delivery (e.g., Backstage) and production delivery of AI-assisted operations — LLM assisted triage, RAG-backed knowledge and runbook assistants, and self-healing workflows with measured deflection.
• Azure certifications or equivalent demonstrated depth (e.g., AZ-305 Solutions Architect, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer, AI-102 Azure AI Engineer).
• Active hands-on builder — personal projects, open-source contributions, or side builds using AI tooling; genuinely passionate about development and fast iteration.
• Presenting to executive leadership: funding asks, program reviews, and candid at-risk status narratives.

Description:
SAP RAR Consultant - Operations Support (Offshore)

Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Pune / Chennai/Hyderabad/ Bangalore
Role Type: AMS / Production Support


Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP Revenue Accounting & Reporting (RAR).
Handle incident management, problem resolution, and service requests.
Support end-to-end revenue recognition processes aligned with ASC 606 and IFRS 15.
Monitor and resolve issues related to:
Revenue Contracts
Performance Obligations (POBs)
SSP Allocation
Contract Modifications
Revenue Postings
Perform month-end, quarter-end, and year-end revenue close activities.
Reconcile and validate revenue accounting results.
Support integration between SAP RAR and SAP S/4HANA modules (FI, CO, AR, GL).
Troubleshoot data, posting, and reconciliation issues.
Maintain RAR configurations including business rules, account determination, and revenue recognition settings.
Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Accounting, Business, and IT teams.
Support SIT, UAT, enhancements, defect fixes, and release activities.
Prepare operational documents, RCA reports, and knowledge articles.
Drive process improvements and automation initiatives.

Must-Have Skills
SAP S/4HANA RAR (Revenue Accounting & Reporting)
SAP FI Integration (GL, AR)
Revenue Recognition & Revenue Reconciliation
AMS / Production Support experience
L2/L3 Support expertise
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Stakeholder management and communication skills

Preferred Skills
ASC 606 and IFRS 15 knowledge
SAP BRIM integration experience
Subscription Billing / SaaS business exposure

Ideal Candidate Profile
5-10 years of SAP experience with strong SAP RAR support expertise.
Hands-on experience supporting revenue accounting processes in production environments.
Good understanding of finance accounting concepts and revenue recognition standards.
Experience working with global stakeholders and managing critical support incidents.
Ability to independently analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex RAR issues.

If your interested in the above job description, please share your updated CV to this mail ID - mohammed.k@techmahindra.com

CompanyAddress: SHARDA CENTRE,,SHARDA CENTRE,OFF KARVE ROAD,ERANDW, PUNE, Maharashtra, India

Description:
Job Summary
Role Overview: We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager - Apartment Sales to drive end-to-end sales across gated apartment societies. This is a field-intensive role focused on managing the complete sales funnel-from lead generation to closures-while ensuring strong execution, customer experience, and revenue achievement.
Purpose of the Role: To drive closures in gated apartment societies by managing a full-cycle apartment sales funnel. The role involves lead generation, executing activation campaigns, maintaining sales hygiene, and achieving revenue targets aligned with operational excellence.
Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Mumbai / Kolkata / Noida / Gurgaon / India / Hyderabad. Reporting To: City Head. Working Days: 6 Days (Weekends Working). Weekly Off: Fixed Wednesday. Shift Timings: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Travel Requirement: High (Field Role).
Key Responsibilities
Apartment Onboarding: Identify and engage with gated societies for product/service onboarding
Drive end-to-end closures from initial pitch to installation activation
Build strong relationships with RWAs, facility managers, and key decision-makers
Sales Funnel Management: Maintain a strong and active sales pipeline with daily activity tracking
Generate leads through field visits, networking, and activation campaigns
Drive conversions through structured follow-ups and consistent engagement
Meeting CRM Hygiene: Ensure accurate and timely data entry in CRM tools
Maintain daily logs of meetings, follow-ups, and outcomes
Track funnel movement and performance metrics rigorously
Collections Recovery Management: Ensure timely collection of payments from clients
Coordinate with operations team post-installation
Track outstanding payments and proactively escalate delays
Client Experience: Ensure seamless onboarding and service delivery
Minimize escalations during installation and go-live
Act as a single point of contact for client satisfaction
Candidate Profile - Skills & Competencies
Strong field sales experience with proven relationship-building skills
Expertise in consultative and solution-based selling
High discipline in CRM usage and reporting hygiene
Strong stakeholder management (RWAs, societies, internal teams)
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally for closures
Target-driven with high ownership mindset
Mandatory Requirements
B2B Sales Background is mandatory
Must have handled end-to-end sales cycle (lead generation to deal closure)
Experience in full-cycle sales ownership is essential
Candidates from B2C sales backgrounds will not be considered
Preferred Qualifications
3-6 years of experience in B2B field sales / real estate / apartment or gated community sales
Familiarity with residential societies and local networks
Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Excel
Strong communication and negotiation skills
Willingness to travel extensively and meet daily activity benchmarks
Eligibility Criteria
Educational Qualification: Graduate (Mandatory)
Age Limit: Up to 32 years

Job Overview
The Associate Director - Performance Marketing will lead the performance marketing strategy and execution for programs, driving learner acquisition, enrollment growth, and marketing ROI across India.
This senior leadership role combines strategic planning, digital marketing expertise, data-driven decision-making, and team leadership to scale demand generation efforts.
The role requires building a high-performing marketing function, optimizing the learner acquisition funnel, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize business impact.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute the national performance marketing strategy for programs, aligned with business objectives, enrollment goals, and revenue targets Own end-to-end digital acquisition efforts, including paid media, lead generation, campaign optimization, conversion tracking, and marketing performance management Drive qualified lead generation and maximize enrollment conversions through data-driven marketing initiatives Manage and optimize multi-channel campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, display networks, affiliates, and other digital platforms Lead, mentor, and guide a high-performing performance marketing team, including campaign managers, analysts, and agency partners Collaborate with Sales, Program, Product, and Content teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and learner engagement Analyze campaign performance, market trends, competitor activities, and learner behavior to continuously optimize acquisition strategies Ensure marketing excellence through robust analytics, attribution models, budget optimization, forecasting, and reporting for senior leadership Drive process improvements, marketing automation initiatives, standard operating procedures, and best practices within the performance marketing function Required Experience,
Skills, and Qualifications
Graduate with 15+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or demand generation, with at least 5 years in leadership roles within higher education, EdTech, or B2C learning programs (MBA preferred)
Prior experience in the EdTech industry required Proven track record of scaling digital acquisition, optimizing marketing spend, and driving significant enrollment growth Strong expertise in paid media, marketing analytics, attribution, and conversion optimization
Experience managing large marketing budgets and delivering measurable ROI Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, web analytics platforms, and marketing technology ecosystems

Description:
Gen AI | Infosys | 2-5yrs | Pan India

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to drive business transformation initiatives, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You will engage with executive stakeholders, delivering large-scale digital transformation programs that optimize revenue operations and support enterprise growth.

As a Senior Manager, you will guide cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to solve complex problems. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting impactful messages, validating outcomes with clients, and navigating challenging situations with composure. You will also contribute to practice development through thought leadership initiatives and capability building.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing Oracle lead management and customer experience solutions, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Your leadership in project management, delivery governance, and stakeholder communication will drive successful project milestones and enhance delivery efficiency.

Responsibilities

- Leading the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle
- Translating complex business requirements into scalable and secure Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry practices
- Managing end-to-end implementation programs, including project planning, solution design, configuration, development, and deployment
- Engaging with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and provide strategic recommendations
- Overseeing the development of integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Driving business transformation initiatives by leveraging functional, technical, and consulting skills
- Facilitating workshops and performing fit-gap analysis to develop scalable solution designs
- Contributing to practice development through pre-sales, capability building, and thought leadership initiatives
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, and revenue-related processes
- Validating solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle and managing project risks and dependencies
- Leading business discussions with customers to discover requirements and deliver technical solutions
- Confirming compliance with architectural standards and driving successful milestone execution through proactive communication

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer
Job Description and Summary
We are seeking a passionate and skilled SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer with 47 years of overall experience, including hands-on experience working with SAP environments and a minimum of 2 years in Generative AI (GenAI).
The ideal candidate will combine an understanding of SAP applications, data, integrations, and technical landscapes with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Python, and modern AI engineering frameworks.
The AI Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions and accelerators that address SAP transformation and delivery use cases.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for SAP and enterprise use cases, with a strong focus on production readiness.
Build and scale RAG-based solutions using SAP and enterprise data, documentation, technical artifacts, and knowledge repositories.
Develop AI-powered accelerators supporting SAP use cases such as:
SAP custom code analysis and modernization
Functional and technical specification analysis
SAP configuration and documentation analysis
Code generation, review, and validation
Test case generation and automation
Data mapping and data validation
SAP API and integration recommendations
Impact analysis and knowledge assistants
Integrate LLM solutions with SAP applications, APIs, services, and enterprise data sources.
Build and integrate graph-based memory, tool-using agents, and context-aware AI solutions.
Implement multi-agent orchestration and reasoning workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, or custom agent frameworks.
Develop clean, efficient, reusable, and scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Work with cloud-based LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Collaborate with SAP functional, technical, data, integration, and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
Implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, performance, and reliability of AI solutions.
Apply strong software engineering practices covering version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and maintainability.
Support deployment and operation of AI solutions in enterprise production environments.
Required Qualifications
4–7 years of overall experience in software engineering, SAP technology, AI/ML, or related technology areas.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions.
Prior experience working within SAP environments or on SAP transformation/implementation programs.
Understanding of the SAP ecosystem, SAP business applications, data structures, APIs, integrations, and technical artifacts.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI GPT models, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.
Strong hands-on knowledge of RAG architectures and Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
Strong proficiency in Python.

Description:
Regulatory, Risk & Forensic
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate
Identifying and implementing efficiencies and process improvements
Complete assigned activities in accordance with established processes and procedures under limited supervision
Actively participate in learning & development opportunities to ensure the use of best-in-class processes and procedures
Proven client-facing experience with strong relationship-building skills
Experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members
Developing clear and concise reporting to be shared with leadership
Assist in managing change to ensure an effective risk management program
The team: 
We are experts in :
Providing FinCrime Operate solutions to optimize cost, quality, and effectiveness of FinCrime operations, including transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, Know Your Customer, screening, and controls testing, leveraging GenAI, technology platforms, and data analytics.
Comprehensive Discovery and data analysis support, preservation, collection, processing, hosting, and production using advanced technologies and GenAI.
Industrialized testing and transformation of regulatory, risk, and compliance processes, driving efficiency with automation, GenAI, and technology.
Dynamic, cost-effective risk monitoring using expert resources and technology to quickly identify elevated risks and potential noncompliance.
Qualifications
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in in risk management (includes control testing, issue identification and validation, compliance, financial crimes, operational risk, internal audit, business process management)
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
Financial services knowledge: compliance, risk management, audit operations
Experience in testing procedures; evaluating policies, processes, controls; identifying compliance issues
Public accounting experience in audit or SOX advisory/consulting
Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
High responsibility, initiative, accountability
Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail
Ability to interact across organizational levels
Education: 
B. Com / BBA or similar 3 year graduate course
M.Com / MBA or similar post grad course (Tier 2/3 colleges)
Location:
Hyderabad , Bangalore, Chennai
The professionals are expected to work from Office all 5 days in a week.
Shift Timings: 
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements. Role & responsibilities

Job Description
HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Technical consultant Manager (10-15 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new Oracle cloud solutions; migrating applications to co-exist in the hybrid cloud (On-Premise and Cloud); deploying a global cloud application across multiple countries. Our teams have a diverse range of skills and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. Primary focus on developing custom solutions using BIP/ OTBI reports
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze reporting requirements from HR and business stakeholders
Design and develop reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher (BIP)
Build custom data models using SQL, and create RTF, Excel templates
Create and configure OTBI analyses, subject area queries, and dashboards
Develop reports for HCM areas such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot data and logic issues
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production issues
Prepare technical specifications, test cases, and user documentation
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP): data models, templates, bursting, and scheduling
Strong hands-on experience in OTBI: subject areas, analyses, and dashboards
Good knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM data model and tables
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts
Understanding of Fusion security, roles, and data access
Good communication and documentation skills
Good to have
Knowledge of Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Oracle Analytics
Knowledge on OCI, REST/SOAP APIs and APEX/ VBCS application would be added advantage
Exposure to multiple end-to-end Fusion HCM implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certification
Consulting Requirements
5-8 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator
Willingness to travel up in case of project requirement
Strong knowledge of software implementation best practices
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment and learn new concepts and software
Self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills
Passionate about building high-quality systems with software implementation
Professionalism and integrity
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
Ability to work in fast paced environment

BRIEF COMPANY DESCRIPTION
At PwC, we connect people with diverse backgrounds and skill sets to solve important problems together and lead with purposefor our clients, our communities and for the world at large. It is no surprise therefore that 429 of 500 Fortune global companies engage with PwC.
Acceleration Centers (ACs) are PwCs diverse, global talent hubs focused on enabling growth for the organization and value creation for our clients. The PwC Advisory Acceleration Center in Bangalore is part of our Advisory business in the US. The team is focused on developing a broader portfolio of solutions for Risk Consulting, Management Consulting, Technology Consulting, Strategy Consulting, Forensics as well as vertical specific solutions.
PwC's high-performance culture is based on passion for excellence with focus on diversity and inclusion. You will collaborate with and receive support from a network of people to achieve your goals. We will also provide you with global leadership development frameworks and the latest in digital technologies to learn and excel in your career. At the core of our firm's philosophy is a simple construct: We care for our people.
Globally PwC is ranked the 3rd most attractive employer according to Universum. Our commitment to Responsible Business Leadership, Diversity & Inclusion, work-life flexibility, career coaching and learning & development makes our firm one of the best places to work, learn and excel.
Apply to us if you believe PwC is the place to be. Now and in the future!
JOB OVERVIEW
PwC US ADVISORY MANAGEMENT CONSULTING
Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage. Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services with a focus on the most profitable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses that will deliver increased sustainable profits.
Our Management Consultants work with the client and project teams to support global engagements from India through activities that are driven towards delivering results- conduct analyses and develop insights, prepare excel models, analyze large sets of data, capture as-is processes, prepare work plans, design to-be processes, support project lead, work directly with client teams and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities.
COMPETENCY OVERVIEW: HEALTH TRANSFORMATION (HT)
The HT team works with clients across healthcare, supporting engagements in driving clients strategic vision and objectives, assessing market expansion and growth strategies, researching key market trends and its impact on key stakeholders, driving operational and process improvements, evaluating sustainable cost transformation alternatives and enabling technology driven business success.
Our consultants work to provide a range of client solutions across the following areas:
Pharma & Life Sciences: We help clients across R&D and commercial value chains. Our services span across R&D operations and innovation, product development, product lifecycle management, project management, clinical resource management, due diligence, regulatory and governance, risk and compliance, internal audit, product launch & commercial planning, go-to-market strategy, patient support services, digital health and portfolio optimization and management
Payor: We work with clients to bring operational and performance improvement in their core Payor functions with the help of our deep understanding of core functional areas. We help in designing the future operating model, payment model, growth strategy, and functional/technical transformation, Business transformation. Our services span operational performance improvement including benchmarking, process mapping and design, operating model design, project management, data and analytics strategy, technology effectiveness assessments and market strategy
Provider: We work with clients to develop, design, and implement organizational transformation to improve performance and generate lasting growth. Our services span operational performance improvement including labor and productivity assessments, benchmarking, process mapping and design, operating model design, project management, technology effectiveness assessments and market strategy

Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.
