Description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - SAP CO (Controlling) - SAP HANA
Location: [Mumbai ,pune,bangalore]
Department: IT / Finance /
Reports to: Director of ERP Solutions / Head of Finance Systems
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Active Directory PKI (AD CS):

- Manage Root CA, Issuing CA, and Offline CA models
- Troubleshoot PKI issues

- Configure claims-based authentication and relying party trusts
- Manage ADFS certificates for service communication, token-signing, and token-decrypting
- Troubleshoot authentication and federation issues
- Plan and perform ADFS upgrades and migrations
Certifications:
- SC-300 (Identity Access Administrator)
- AZ-104 / AZ-305
- Windows Server / Security certifications are preferred.

Description:
Job Description: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant (6 to 10 Years)
Position: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12Years
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gandhinagar
Interview Type: Face-to-Face
Date:10-OCTOBER-2026

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant with 4 to 10 years of SAP Sales and Distribution experience. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAP SD business processes, S/4HANA implementations, configuration, integrations, and support projects.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Configure SAP SD modules including:
Sales Order Processing
Pricing
Billing
Shipping & Transportation
Output Management
Credit Management
Returns & Rebate Processes
Participate in S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Work on integrations with MM, FI, WM/EWM, TM, and PP modules.
Conduct fit-gap analysis and prepare functional specifications.
Support testing activities including Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Go-Live.
Provide end-user training and post-go-live support.
Collaborate with technical teams for enhancements, reports, forms, interfaces, and workflows.
Required Skills
6 to 10 years of SAP SD consulting experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation project.
Strong configuration knowledge in:
Enterprise Structure
Sales Document Types
Item Categories
Schedule Lines
Pricing Procedures
Output Determination
Partner Determination
Copy Controls
Batch Management
Experience with S/4HANA SD simplifications and business processes.
Knowledge of APIs, IDOCs, EDI, and interfaces.
Strong understanding of OTC (Order-to-Cash) processes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with SAP Fiori applications.
Exposure to SAP EWM, TM, GTS, or SAP CAR.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in AMS support and global rollout projects.
SAP SD or S/4HANA certification is preferred

Description:
Job Description for Sales Coordinator at Axis Max Life Insurance:

As a Sales Coordinator at Axis Max Life Insurance, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the sales team to enhance efficiency and drive sales performance. You will be responsible for coordinating sales activities, managing administrative tasks, and providing support to the sales representatives. Your role will involve data management, reporting, and assisting in the development and implementation of sales strategies.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist in the preparation of sales reports, presentations, and other documentation to support the sales team.
- Coordinate sales activities, including scheduling meetings, managing calendars, and arranging travel plans for sales personnel.
- Maintain and update customer databases and sales records to ensure accuracy and accessibility of information.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to align sales efforts with promotional campaigns and initiatives.
- Respond to customer inquiries and provide information about products and services.
- Support the training of new sales staff by providing necessary resources and information.
- Monitor sales performance metrics and generate reports to analyze trends and identify areas for improvement.
- Facilitate communication between the sales team and other departments to ensure seamless operations.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
- Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software and sales tracking tools.
- Attention to detail and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong analytical skills to interpret sales data and generate actionable insights.
- Proven ability to work collaboratively within a team and foster positive relationships.
- Basic understanding of insurance products and the sales process is a plus.

If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and have a passion for sales support, we invite you to apply for the Sales Coordinator position at Axis Max Life Insurance. Join us in driving sales success and delivering exceptional customer service.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance Limited is a joint venture between Axis Bank and Max Life Insurance, focused on providing life insurance and financial protection solutions. The company offers a range of products including term plans, savings, retirement, and investment-linked policies. With a strong distribution network and customer-centric approach, Axis Max Life aims to deliver long-term value and security to individuals and families across India.

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.

Job Description

MES SME / Business Analyst / Product Owner (B2)
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you''ll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what''s possible. Join us in helping manufacturing organizations transform their operations through innovative MES and digital manufacturing solutions.
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) / Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong manufacturing domain expertise. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring successful delivery, implementation, and support of MES solutions.
Interview Process: 2 Rounds
Key Responsibilities
Act as the MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business and IT teams.
Collaborate closely with Development, Support, Deployment, and End Users for smooth project delivery and issue resolution.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and user stories.
Drive documentation activities including User Stories, Functional Design Documents (FDDs), PRE-ROM, Analyst Testing, UAT, and Release Planning.
Work with stakeholders to define functional requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Support testing, validation, and deployment activities.
Ensure alignment between manufacturing processes and MES solutions.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Required Skills
Strong MES functional experience with Business Analysis exposure.
Good understanding of manufacturing processes and workflows.
Knowledge of .NET application testing and debugging.
Experience with Web and Mobile Applications (Android).
Hands-on experience with Web Services, SOAP UI, and Postman.
Strong database knowledge with MySQL and Oracle SQL.
Good to Have
Knowledge of PLC, SCADA, and HMI integrations.
Understanding of ISA-95 standards.
Basic experience with Power BI or Tableau.
Knowledge of Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV).
Exposure to IIoT and Digital Manufacturing solutions.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Experience working as an MES SME, Business Analyst, or Product Owner.
Strong manufacturing domain expertise.
Ability to work with both business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in requirement gathering, UAT, and release planning activities.
What You''ll Love About Working Here
Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation programs.
Exposure to cutting-edge MES, IIoT, and digital manufacturing technologies.
About Us
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations accelerate their digital transformation journey through innovation, engineering excellence, and deep industry expertise. We empower businesses to unlock value through technology while fostering an inclusive and sustainable future.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis, is one of the world's leading multi-disciplinary consultancies. Our Clean Water Networks team is one of the longest established specialist teams of its kind, providing consultancy and field support services to clients for the operation, performance and management of clean water networks in UK. Due to our continuing expansion we currently have an opportunity for Lead Engineer for offshore executed projects from India.
The successful candidate will join a team of hydraullic modellers and civil engineers and play in its expansion and projects delivery. This is an ideal opportunity for individuals looking to lead the project teams with a world renowned consultant.
Your role
Work as part of AtkinsRealis' Clean Water (CW) team.
Lead the delivery of a range of projects relating to network modelling, water infrastructure design and planning from Bangalore office.
Lead day to day liaison with our UK PMs and engineers to ensure project deliverables are developed in accordance with client scope, budget, timescales and quality requirements.
Drive innovation and digital delivery culture to the next level.
Carryout check and review of the projects, assuring quality delivery right first time.
Support the technical development of Engineers, Technicians and Graduates.
Support the Team Leader with resource and other management duties.
Provide support to business development activates like bid preparations, presentations to potential clients etc.
About you
Bachelor or Master's Degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering from a recognized University.
Professional accreditation from ICE or CIWEM.
Minimum 10 years' experience, preferably based on delivering projects to the UK Water Industry.
Sufficient and appropriate experience of working within a technical environment (Water projects)
Able to independently work on data processing and analysis to a high standard.
The ability to develop innovative solutions to engineering problems.
Working knowledge of software such as InfoWorks, Epanet, SynerGee, Aquis and MapInfo.
Working knowledge of British Standards is desirable.
Computer literacy e.g. Word, Excel and Outlook.
Excellent English spoken and written skills within a business environment.
Working to defined timescales and following an approved methodology will be key features of the role.
Demonstrable track record of technical achievement and client satisfaction within the water industry.
Ability to apply technical knowledge in analysing problems and creating solutions.
Willingness to travel to the UK for short term assignments and training.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments.
Ability to build rapport with customers and colleagues.
Well-motivated and able to work as part of a team or on individual assignments when required.
Able to work and communicate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Flexible approach to work.
Ability to work on your own initiative.
Strong attention to detail and ability to make correct judgment.
Reward benefits
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Practice: TechnologyStrategy & Transformation, Global Network IAreas of Work: Lead, shape & StrategizeTechnology costs and cost profiles to identify new opportunities for clients ILevel: Consultant | Location: Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore | Years of Exp: 6-9
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
The Practiceis a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models.
We provide you with a great learning ground, where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. You would be working with senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology, and operations. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will drive:
Business problem assessment: Interact with client stakeholders to understand their problems, define a problem statement, understand the scope of the engagement, and drive projects to deliver value to the client
Analysis: Understand the technology costs and do a deep dive within individual cost items. Analyze the cost profile through multiple lenses such as business lens, technology lens, financial lens etc.
Deliver Value: Guide your team to suggest the right solutions to meet the needs of clients and help draw up practical implementation road maps that position them for long-term success
Understand and deploy the key value drivers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement
Ensure Continued Success: Mentor junior members of the team and groom them for more responsibility; contribute towards developing assets and accelerators to improve the Tech ROI offering, and lead GTM activities and support business development work
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
6-8 years of relevant experience in being part of large-scale Tech Value deals, sales & GTM strategy skills.
Having understanding of how organization's Tech finance operates and how it impacts overall value case & investment profile.
Must have been part of complex technology strategy projects focused on Technology value/cost optimization, IT Financial Management (Apptio and other TBM tools), AI Value Management, IT Budgeting, Investment Management, Cloud cost management and additional exposure technology strategy areas such as operating model design, enterprise architecture.
Quickly understand the key value drivers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement
Advanced presentation, public speaking skills and ability to drive C-suite/senior leadership level discussions
Ability to manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals
Create expert content and take part in professional forums
Maximize capacity to develop high impact thought leadership that articulates a forward-thinking view of the market and work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment.
Promote a culture of experimentation and innovation.

What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Job Description


Overview
Atkinsrealis is one of the largest engineering and design consultancy in the UK, the largest multidisciplinary consultancy in Europe and one of the largest design firms in the world.
This key post will be based out of Bangalore/Mumbai office and will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience and problem-solving skills whilst providing good opportunities.
We are seeking a motivated Landscape Irrigation Design Engineer to support the design and development of irrigation/ wet utility team. To perform this role successfully, the candidate will be responsible for but not limited to the following:


Your role
2-4 years of experience in the Landscape Irrigation.
Experience of working in the Irrigation / water Industry.
Positive Attitude and eagerness to learn and use new irrigation/ water related design software's, tools and processes for automation and digital efficiency as per the project and business requirement.
Familiarity with Middle East / BS or similar international Codes of Practice
Hands on experience of various software's - Revit, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Navisworks and WaterGEMS
Good ability to use Irrigation / water related design software's, tools and processes for automation and digital efficiency.
Good understanding of various design standards and its application in the Landscape and Irrigation industry.
Bachelor's degree/Master's degree in Engineering from an institute of repute.
Clear knowledge of work procedures, and ability to brief project team on them.
Good written and verbal English language communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with colleagues, seniors, team members and clients.
Experience of major Infrastructure projects at feasibility and detailed design stages.
A team player and work in collaboration.


About you
Perform flow calculations and water demand analysis for landscape irrigation systems.
Assist in preparing design reports and technical documentation.
Assist and develop irrigation specifications based on project requirements and standards.
Prepare and maintain valve schedules.
Support the creation and validation of hydraulic models for irrigation networks.
Plan and design irrigation network routing, including pipelines, valves, and control systems.
Coordinate with BIM team for design integration.
Ensure designs comply with local regulations, standards, and sustainability practices.
Develop Concept, Preliminary, Detailed design, related calculations and drawings.
Involve in clash analysis, resolution and work on federated 3Dmodels
Able to perform good self-checks. And support in team development, skill enhancement.
Apply Atkins Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


Rewards benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

As a Consultant in the Resources practice, you will work with leading organizations in the Chemicals, Metals, and Cement sectors to solve complex operational and business challenges and deliver measurable value.

Understand the client's business, operational priorities, and leadership agenda across the Chemicals, Metals, and Cement sectors.
Support opportunity origination by developing industry-relevant problem statements, value propositions, commercial pathways, and solution inputs.

Strong industry experience in at least one of the following sectors: Chemicals, Metals, or Cement, with an understanding of sector-specific value chains and operating environments.

Ability to structure ambiguous business problems, perform quantitative and qualitative analysis, and convert insights into implementable recommendations.
Experience in process mapping, requirements gathering, business case development, roadmap creation, and transformation implementation.
Strong project management skills, including workplan management, stakeholder coordination, issue resolution, and delivery tracking.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with client and internal teams.

Job Description


Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.
The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical BIM Designer with 8 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.


Your role
Key Responsibilities
Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.


About you
Technical Competencies
Essential
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.
Behavioural Competencies
Strong communication and report-writing skills.
Team-oriented with leadership potential.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
Proactive in career development and team contribution.
Assertive and responsive to client requirements.
Able to manage and motivate teams effectively.

Experience or exposure to B2B Sales transformation and Sales process improvement is preferred.
Experience supporting BD pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, or solutioning activities is an advantage.

Educational Qualification

MBA/PGDM (Preferred)
Job Summary
As a consultant - B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence, you will support clients in analyzing, redesigning, and transforming their end-to-end B2B Sales processes. You will work across key Sales process steps, from Lead Management and Qualification through Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations, helping identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, platform enablement, and AI-led transformation. You will conduct industry research, benchmarking, data analysis, and process assessments to develop insights that support transformation recommendations.
You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including research, solution development, process narratives, capability presentations, proposal content, and client-ready materials. The role will involve working with Sales platforms and enterprise applications, understanding how technology enables business processes, and supporting digital and platform transformation initiatives. You will use tools such as Microsoft Visio, Power BI, Tableau, and GenAI-enabled platforms to analyze, visualize, and communicate findings. Description:
AEL is DMarts ecommerce venture which is engaged in the business of online grocery retail under the brand name DMart Ready. AEL currently operates its business in select areas of Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat & is poised to launch its operations in Indore & Bhopal. AEL allows its customers to order a broad range of grocery and household products through its mobile app DMart online grocery shopping and through the website www.dmart.in. Customers can either 1) Self Pick Up: Order online from the app and pick up the order from the nearest DMart Ready Pick-Up point. 2) Home Delivery: Place your order online and get it delivered to home or office at a convenient date &time of choice.


Key Responsibilities
1. GST Compliance & Filings
Manage multi-state GST compliance frameworks across retail channels.
Oversee the timely filing of monthly, quarterly, and annual returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-8 (e-commerce), and GSTR-9/9C.
Execute 3-way reconciliations across Sales Registers vs. GSTR-1, Purchase Registers vs. GSTR-2B, and ERP ledger balances to optimize Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilization.
Monitor e-Way bill issuance, e-invoicing workflows, and GST rates.

2. Direct Tax & Regulatory Compliances
Oversee end-to-end Direct Tax, including monthly TDS/TCS deduction, deposit, quarterly return filings (Form 26Q/27Q), and annual Form 16/16A issuance.
Assist in annual Tax Audits (Form 3CD), corporate tax computations, advance tax forecasting, and tax provision reviews in coordination with statutory auditors.

3. Litigation & Dispute Resolution
Draft robust technical replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), audit inquiries, assessment orders, and notices from State/Central GST authorities.
Represent the company before tax officers, appellate authorities, and auditors during assessments, proceedings, and personal hearings.
Partner with external legal counsel, tax advisors, and consultants for high-stakes litigation, appeals, and legal opinions.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
Experience: Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in Indirect Taxation.
Technical Skills: Strong mastery of GST laws, legal drafting, ITC reconciliation methodologies, TDS/TCS provisions, and advanced Excel. Hands-on exposure to SAP is required.
Looking for CA Inter

Description:
SAP Project Manager S/4HANA Public Cloud
Location - Mumbai , Pune , Bangalore , Gandhinagar

Flexible / Hybrid / Remote

Experience
8-15 years in SAP Project Management with at least 2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
8+ years of SAP project management experience.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and Cloud ERP deployment models.
Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.
Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and vendor management.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification.
PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or Agile certifications.
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Signavio.
Knowledge of finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR business processes.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams

We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. Dear Aspirant,

Greetings from Heritage Foods Limited!!

*About Us:*

Heritage Foods Ltd. is known for being a premier provider of pure and fresh milk and value-added dairy products. The company has always been committed to its philosophy and Delighting Every Home with Fresh and Healthy Products and Empowering the Farmer.

We have openings for Sales Executives - Fresh Milk @ Mumbai, Pune at Heritage Foods Limited

Sales Executives - Graduate with 3 - 7 yrs of Dairy / FMCG Sales

Work Locations : Mumbai, (Thane, Navi Mumbai, Mulund to Kurla, Airoli to Panvel), Pune
JOB SUMMARY:
Responsible for promoting Milk & Milk Product Sales and expansion of distribution networks in the area of operations with an objective to achieve the budgeted business targets & customer satisfaction.

KEY RESULT AREAS:
1. Achieving the Sales Targets and expansion of distribution networks.
2. Regular Collection of sales realization and reconciliation of outstanding.
3. Ensure to organize the logistics and timely distribution of Milk & Milk Products.
4. Conduct Market Intelligence & Identify the gaps in marketing.
5. Promote & extend the model Parlors business in the area of operation.
6. Monitoring, Controlling & Collecting the Crates on time.
7. Effective control & minimize the leakages & damages.
8. Addressing customer complaints.
9. Implementation of ISO Standards and documentation.

*Benefits:*
Competitive salary
Yearly base increments
Sales incentives (Payout quarterly)
Health insurance
Paid Leaves
Training and development opportunities
AboutCompany:
Heritage Group, founded in 1992 by Mr. Nara Chandrababu Naidu, is a prominent and fast-growing public listed company in India. It operates through various divisions, including Dairy, Renewable Energy, and VetCa, all under its flagship company, Heritage Foods Limited (formerly known as Heritage Foods Limited). Heritage Foods limited is known for being a premier provider of pure and fresh milk and value-added dairy products. The company has always been committed to its philosophy and vision of delivering fresh & healthy products to every home.

As of the financial year 2022-23, Heritage Foods has achieved an impressive annual turnover of over Rs. 3,200 crores. The company's products, particularly its milk and milk-based items, have established a strong market presence in several regions across India. These areas include Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Odisha, and the National Capital Region (NCR) of Delhi. Heritage Foods' success can be attributed to its dedication to providing high-quality dairy products and its expansion into various regions of the country.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.

Total Exp - 6yrs to 20yrs
Location - Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Gandhinagar
Mandatory Skill set - SAP CAR , UDF,Implementation


Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions

Description:
As an Associate Agency Development Manager at Axis Max Life Insurance, you will play a crucial role in driving business growth by developing and managing a team of insurance agents. You will be responsible for recruiting, training, and mentoring new agents to build a high-performing sales team. Your goal will be to achieve sales targets and enhance the companys market presence in your assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new insurance agents to build a strong agency channel.
- Train and mentor agents on product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer service best practices.
- Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve individual and team sales targets.
- Monitor and evaluate the performance of agents and provide ongoing support to enhance their productivity.
- Conduct regular meetings and training sessions to keep the team motivated and updated on industry trends.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
- Collaborate with other departments to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Proven sales skills with a target-driven mindset.
- Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions.
- Problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
- Capacity to motivate and inspire others to achieve their goals.

Tools Required:
- Proficiency in CRM software for managing client relationships and sales tracking.
- Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and presentations.
- Understanding of insurance industry software and tools for policy management.
- Usage of data analysis tools to monitor sales performance and market trends.

If you are passionate about sales and have a drive for success, join Axis Max Life Insurance as an Associate Agency Development Manager and contribute to building a robust agency network.

SAP CAR UDF Functional Consultant
Experience
6 to 20 Years
Location
Mumbai / Pune / Bangalore / Gandhinagar
(Hybrid / Onsite as per project requirement )

If JD is matching to your profile kindly share updated resume on
gayatri.rajesh-gupta@capgemini.com


Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.
Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions.
Required Skills
Functional Skills
Strong experience in SAP CAR.
Hands-on experience with:
SAP UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning
Demand Forecasting
Replenishment Planning
Inventory Optimization
Retail Processes
Understanding of merchandise planning and supply chain processes.
Technical Knowledge
Knowledge of SAP HANA.
Experience with data modeling and data extraction.
Understanding of IDocs, APIs, SLT, and integration frameworks.
Basic ABAP debugging knowledge preferred.
Domain Expertise
Retail industry experience is highly preferred.
Understanding of:
Merchandise Management
Supply Chain Planning
Inventory Management
Omnichannel Retail Operations
Mandatory Qualifications
6-15 years of SAP experience.
Minimum 4+ years of SAP CAR experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP CAR implementation project.
Experience in UDF configuration and forecasting processes.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Description:
Data Engineer
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.
AboutCompany:

Description:
Experience: 6 - 15 Years
Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gandhinagar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Notice Period: Immediate to 90 Days Preferred

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.
Support supply chain process workstreams planning, order management, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing — and, where relevant experience exists, contribute to configuration, testing, and rollout activities on the Oracle Cloud platform.
Translate and localise functional specifications, process flows, test scripts, and training materials between Japanese and English, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved.
Facilitate real-time interpretation during design workshops, CRP demonstrations, and issue-resolution calls with Japanese business and IT stakeholders.
Support fit-gap analysis and solution design for Japan-specific statutory, tax, and reporting requirements within Oracle Cloud (e.g. consumption tax, Japan GAAP nuances, e-invoicing).
Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.
Contribute to test scenario validation, data migration reviews, and cutover planning for multi-country, multi-plant Oracle Cloud implementations in the automotive sector.
Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Required Qualifications
Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.
Oracle Cloud Knowledge (Good to have, not mandatory): Exposure to Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules — Supply Planning, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, Manufacturing, Product Hub/PLM — will be viewed favourably but is not a prerequisite.
Consulting Experience: Prior experience with a Big 4, global systems integrator, or automotive-industry consulting/coordination role; comfortable working in client-facing delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field; any ERP or Oracle Cloud certification is a bonus, not expected.
Willingness to travel to client sites (India and potentially Japan) as required by programme milestones.

Preferred / Good to Have
Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.

Description:
CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Description:
Job Summary
Senior Engineering Manager - Technology Operational Excellence
Location: Pune/Bangalore
We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to lead a critical portfolio within Technology Operational Excellence. This role is accountable for driving the strategy, roadmap, governance and execution across Recovery Assurance, Technology Risk Audit, Standards Assurance, Operational Excellence, and the application of automation and AI to strengthen assurance and operational outcomes.
This is not a traditional governance or reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a strategic leader with end-to-end ownership, defining direction, building high-performing teams and influencing senior stakeholders and platform teams to deliver measurable improvements in resilience, reliability, availability, operational maturity and risk reduction. Success will be measured by the ability to drive accountability, use data to identify improvement opportunities and translate strategy into sustainable outcomes across the technology landscape.
Reporting to the Director, Technology Operational Excellence, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, setting the direction and leading delivery across your area. The Director will provide strategic alignment, guidance and challenge, while you will be accountable for developing the strategy, roadmap and operating model required to deliver the agreed outcomes.
Responsibilities Strategy Portfolio Leadership
Define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Technology Operational Excellence capabilities.
Translate organizational objectives into measurable outcomes and improvement initiatives.
Drive prioritization across resilience, technology risk, audit, standards assurance and Operational Excellence, while working across adjacent capabilities such as Change Management to improve end-to-end operational outcomes.
Identify emerging operational risks and capability gaps and develop scalable solutions.
Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to senior technology leadership.
Recovery Assurance Resilience
Lead enterprise recovery assurance and resilience programs.
Improve recoverability of critical business and technology services by influencing platform teams to do the right testing, validation, and continuous improvement.
Drive failover, restore, and recovery exercises across cloud, SaaS, on-premise, and vendor-managed environments.
Ensure recovery risks are identified, tracked, and remediated effectively.
Technology Risk, Audit Assurance
Lead technology operational risk management, audit readiness and the sustainable remediation of audit findings.
Improve assurance through automated controls, evidence-based monitoring and policy enforcement.
Connect risks, incidents, recovery gaps, standards and control weaknesses to identify systemic issues.
Partner with the Change Management team to strengthen risk-based controls, use incident and performance insights, and support continual improvement in Change outcomes.
Contribute to the future evolution of Change Management strategy, governance and control effectiveness as the Technology Operational Excellence operating model develops.
Operational Excellence, Automation AI
Drive Operational Excellence initiatives across Technology portfolios.
Improve operational maturity, engineering standards adoption, and service reliability working with platform teams across tech.
Leverage Automation, AI, and data-driven insights to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and enhance operational effectiveness.
Support the transition from governance through reporting to governance through automated controls and intelligence-driven decision making.
People Leadership
Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning resilience, risk, audit and operational excellence.
Build leadership capability, foster accountability, and create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Engineering, Platform, Cyber Security, Internal Audit, and Business stakeholders.
What We're Looking For Essential Experience
Significant leadership experience in one or more of the following areas: Technology Operations, Operational Excellence, Resilience, Technology Risk, Audit or Assurance.
Proven track record of owning complex portfolios and driving strategy through execution.
Experience defining operating models, roadmaps, and transformation initiatives.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior leadership levels.
Deep understanding of operational resilience, risk management, technology controls, and modern engineering practices.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, develop talent, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Preferred Experience
Disaster Recovery, Recovery Assurance, or Enterprise Resilience leadership.
Technology Risk, Audit, and Control Frameworks.
SRE, Reliability Engineering, Observability, and Operational Readiness practices.
Automated controls, policy-as-code, and evidence-based assurance.
AI and Automation-led operational transformation.
Experience across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, and hybrid technology environments.
What Success Looks Like
Clear strategies and executable roadmaps across Technology Operational Excellence capabilities.
Improved resilience, recovery assurance, change success rates, and operational risk reduction.
Increased adoption of engineering and operational standards.
Greater use of automation, AI, and intelligent controls to simplify operations and strengthen assurance.
Sustainable closure of risks, control gaps, and audit findings.
A highly capable and empowered team with strong ownership and accountability.

MS Dynamics Developer/Consultant
Location: Pune, India
Experience: 4 to 10 years

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.
What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field

What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

We are looking for ADAS Developer with strong Embedded/C++, Linux skills and exposure to the Automotive domain. The candidate will work on developing and maintaining software for automotive applications.

Job Description

Experience:6-12 years
Location: Pune, Trivandrum, Chennai, Bangalore

Bachelors or Masters degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Embedded Systems, or a related fieldMinimum 10 years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on ADAS algorithm development.
Hands-on experience with high performance SoCs (NVIDIA or Qualcomm)
Strong programming skills in C++ or Model-Based Development (Matlab/Simulink).
Hands-on experience in developing ADAS components such as Vehicle Motion Control, Sensor Fusion, ADAS Applications (AEB, ACC, LKA, Lane Centring):
Good understanding of vehicle dynamics.
Good understanding of automotive control systems such as PID and MPC.
Good understanding of Kalman Filters / State Estimation techniques.
Hands-on experience in integration of ADAS software components in QNX Operating System
Good understanding of AUTOSAR (Classic and/ or Adaptive)
Experience with debugging and analysis tools such as CANoe.
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, SOME/IP)
Good proficiency in both English and Chinese (spoken and written) to enable effective communication between India and China teams

Job Description
Overview
We are seeking talented individuals for our Water Team to work on diverse sewerage projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment.

Your role
Work as part of AtkinsRealis' Urban Drainage Modelling team.
Work on a range of projects relating to sewerage/storm network modelling, drainage infrastructure design and planning from Bangalore/Gurgaon offices.
Work to high standards, ensuring right first-time delivery.
Ownership of the work of self and juniors they work with.
Support the technical development of Graduates and Technicians and contribute positively through knowledge sharing.

About you
Essential qualifications:
Bachelor or Master's Degree in Civil Engineering or MSc in Geology from a recognised University.
2 - 4 years of experience in the water and wastewater consultancy industry
Demonstrable experience of network design or hydraulic modelling is mandatory.
Experience of using design or hydraulic modelling software (preferably in InfoWorks CS/2D/ICM or Windes or Bentley suite of software).
Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems (GIS) e.g. MapInfo, ArcGIS.
Excellent report writing skills and fluency in English.
Desired qualifications:
Value addition through innovations and automation in project delivery.
Knowledge of Visual Basics and GIS automation - MapBasics, Python etc.

Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

About the Team: -
The team is focused on driving Data & AI based solutions for SaaS and PaaS clients for Accenture. The team collaborates actively with onsite counterparts to help identify opportunities for growth as well as drives client deliveries from offshore.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
As part of our Data & AI practice, you will join a worldwide network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading statistical tools, methods, and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll work with experts in SaaS & PaaS and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack and certifications.
In Data & AI you will understands the importance of sound analytical decision-making, relationship of tasks to the overall project, and executes projects in the context of a business performance improvement initiative.
What you would do in this role
Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems.
Manage large databases proficiently, conducting exploratory data analytics to derive valuable insights for stakeholders.
Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.
Develop and manage data pipelines to streamline the flow of information for enhanced efficiency.
Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements.
Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.


Qualification
Job Qualifications
Who are we looking for?
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field.
Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.
Proven experience (2+ years) in working on AI projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Hands-On exposure to Generative AI frameworks (Azure Open AI, Vertex AI) and implementations & Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including Embedding, prompt engineering, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.
Hands on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modelling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL
Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc.
