Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Assist in monitoring/tracking employee relations issues including resolution and follow-up.
Assist and support management and the leadership team with handling and resolving Human Resources issues.
Monitor all hiring and recruitment processes for compliance with all local, state, and federal laws and company policies and standards.
Inform Human Resources management of issues related to employee relations.
Respond to questions, requests, and concerns from employees and management regarding company and Human Resources programs, policies and guidelines.

Review and ensure accurate maintece of all employee records and files (eg, interview documents, I-9s).

Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. Reporting daily to Supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures

Write appropriate reports as required

Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves

The candidate will be responsible for managing customers/groups, conducting field visits, ensuring timely loan repayments, and supporting business growth while maintaining high service and compliance standards.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct regular field visits and customer meetings.
Identify and onboard new customers and form JLG/SHG groups.
Explain loan products, repayment schedules and company policies to customers.
Conduct customer verification and ensure proper KYC/documentation.
Manage centre meetings and maintain customer relationships.
Ensure timely collection of loan instalments.
Follow up on overdue accounts and maintain portfolio quality.
Monitor customer repayment behaviour and identify potential risks.
Resolve customer queries and complaints professionally.
Maintain accurate records and submit daily/weekly reports.
Achieve assigned business and collection targets.
Follow company policies, ethical collection practices and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Candidate Profile
Minimum 12th pass / Graduate preferred.
Experience in microfinance, banking, NBFC, sales or field collection will be an advantage.
Freshers with good communication skills may apply for Field Officer positions.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Basic knowledge of smartphones and mobile applications.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.
Knowledge of Hindi and local language/dialect preferred.
Candidates should be target-oriented, responsible and comfortable working in rural/semi-urban areas.

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channeling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.

Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing

Skills & Competencies
Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
To provide high-quality psychological assessment, short-term counselling, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions to outpatients and inpatients. The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career
.Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking ForExperience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development.
Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process
- Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
- Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
- Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
- Networks with local organizations (eg, Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
- Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.
- Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.
Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits
- Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
- Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.
- Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.
Assisting in Managing Employee Development
- Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
- Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
- Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations
- Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (eg, develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
- Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
- Utilizes an open door policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
- Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
- Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices
- Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
- Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
- Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
- Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
- Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
- Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (eg, property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc
- Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
- Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations.
Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions.
Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the ficial performance in all areas of responsibility.
Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced.
Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports.
Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (eg, banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (eg, dish room and purchasing).
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Leads kitchen management team.
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Operational & Surgical Management
Schedule & Flow: Coordinate daily surgical lists, elective/emergency cases, and room turnaround times to minimize delays and cancellations. 
Patient Safety: Enforce the WHO/NABH surgical safety checklist (Sign-In, Time-Out, Sign-Out), correct patient identification, consent verifications, and safe handover protocols. 
Emergency Preparedness: Maintain readiness for trauma or clinical emergencies inside and outside the OT. 
2. NABH Compliance & Infection Control
Sterilization & Asepsis: Monitor air-handling units (AHU / laminar flow), positive pressure, temperature/humidity logs, and CSSD (Central Sterile Supply Department) sterilization indicators. 
Biomedical Waste (BMW): Ensure strict compliance with national biomedical waste management rules (segregation, color-coding, and safe disposal). 
Audits & Documentation: Maintain accurate OT registers, anaesthesia records, implant tracking logs, incident reporting, and audit trails required for NABH accreditations. 
3. Equipment & Inventory Management
Equipment Upkeep: Oversee preventive maintenance, calibration, and quick repair coordination for high-end surgical and anesthesia equipment.
Stock & Expiry Control: Monitor consumable inventory, emergency drugs, surgical instruments, and implant availability; prevent stock-outs or expired items.
4. Human Resource & Staff Management
Duty Rosters: Prepare shift schedules, leave plans, and on-call rosters for OT nurses, OT technicians, and housekeeping staff.
Training & Competency: Conduct regular drills, biomedical safety trainings, and mandatory continuing education for OT personnel. 
5. Interdepartmental Coordination
Liaise closely with surgeons, anesthesiologists, ICU, Wards, CSSD, Blood Bank, and Pharmacy to ensure seamless patient transit and care. 
Qualifications & Experience
Education: B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing / GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) or a relevant healthcare administration degree; specialized postgraduate credentials or diplomas in hospital/OT management are an added advantage.
Experience: 6 to 10+ years of hands-on experience in operation theatre operations, with at least 2–3 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity. Prior experience working in a NABH or JCI-accredited hospital is typically mandatory or strongly preferred.

Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location: Mumbai

Achieve and consistently exceed assigned sales targets.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.

Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.








Requirements
Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, building materials).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.




Benefits

MWA: 5,000/ -
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 5,000 per month, depending on profile

Job Description
Title : Field Sales Executive
Location :  Gerabari, Kathiar
Job Type : Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry : Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.
Conduct at least 2 site visits per day to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
Spend at least two hours daily at the assigned store to engage customers and support sales activities.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to drive product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports via the online portal.
Requirements :
Valid two-wheeler is mandatory for field operations.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and driven by performance targets.
Minimum qualification: Graduation preferred.
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.
Benefits :
Net Take Home: 16K-22K (Negotiable)
MWA 5000/ -

Absorption after 1 year on performance basis.
Travel allowance up to 2000- 5000 per month based on profile.
Other pointers regarding this job:
Location: Gerabari, Kathiar ( Work from Office only).
Age Criteria: 18years old to 30years old are eligible
Gender : Only males can apply
Eligibility: Candidates with a minimum of 6 months to 1 year of experience in field sales, channel sales, banking, or insurance sales can apply.
Location: Only candidates based in Patna are eligible.
Qualification: Graduate (Preferred).
Work Details: Day shift role with third-party payroll (2coms).

Description:
About Us: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role: Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.
Expectations/ Requirements:
1.Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2.Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3.Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4.Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5.Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6.Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7.Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 ASMs & 200+ indirect employees.
Must Have: Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory

Skills: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition, Stakeholder Management, Employee Engagement, Problem Solving & Conflict Resolution, Data Management & Reporting
Description:
Regional HRBP

Location: PATNA

Role Overview
The Regional HR will be responsible for managing end-to-end HR operations at the regional level, including talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, and HR compliance. The role requires strong coordination with business stakeholders to ensure effective HR service delivery and workforce stability.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition
Source candidates through multiple channels including campus recruitment, job drives, employee referrals, and lateral hiring.
Screen candidate profiles for role fitment and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
Negotiate salary and ensure effective offer closures.
Drive joining ratios and ensure maximum conversion of offers to onboardings.
Conduct competitor mapping and talent benchmarking.
HR Operations & Employee Management
Oversee and manage overall HR operations at the regional level.

Description:
About the Role
We are seeking a skilled and proactive MEP Engineer with 4- 5 years of experience in executing and coordinating Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works for industrial food factory projects across India. The ideal candidate should have strong site execution expertise, contractor management skills, and the ability to ensure projects are completed on time while maintaining quality, safety, and statutory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Mechanical
Supervise installation and execution of HVAC, ventilation, firefighting, boiler, ETP, gas distribution systems, utility piping, and other mechanical services.
Review mechanical drawings, technical specifications, and shop drawings.
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and project teams for seamless execution.
Ensure all mechanical works are executed as per approved drawings, project specifications, and quality standards.
Electrical
Supervise installation of LT/HT panels, power distribution boards (PDB), switchboards, lighting systems, cable trays, cabling, earthing, DG systems, and CCTV installations.
Review electrical load calculations, drawings, and technical submissions.
Conduct inspections, testing, and commissioning activities.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and statutory regulations.
Plumbing
Supervise installation of plumbing, drainage, water supply, and sewage systems.
Verify piping layouts, installation quality, and material specifications.
Coordinate with civil and architectural teams to resolve site clashes and ensure smooth execution.
General Responsibilities
Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQ), quantity estimation, and material reconciliation.
Review contractor bills, measurements, and work progress.
Monitor project schedules and ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
Participate in project review and coordination meetings.
Ensure compliance with safety procedures, quality standards, IS Codes, NBC guidelines, and statutory requirements.
Resolve technical and site-related issues efficiently.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing systems.
Good understanding of MEP drawings, shop drawings, and construction methodologies.
Experience in industrial project site execution and coordination.
Knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity estimation, billing, and material reconciliation.
Familiarity with IS Codes, National Building Code (NBC), and safety regulations.
Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple site activities and work under project deadlines.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
4-5 years of relevant experience in MEP execution.
Experience in industrial or commercial construction projects is preferred.
Willingness to travel and work at project sites across PAN India.
Preferred Software Knowledge
AutoCAD
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
MS Project
MEP drafting and coordination software (preferred)
ERP/project management software (added advantage)
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work on large-scale industrial food factory projects across India.
Exposure to end-to-end MEP execution and multidisciplinary coordination.
Dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

Experience - 10 to 18 Years

Location - Bangalore And Gandhinagar

Full-Time

We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Lead to design, develop, and support SAP applications while leading a team of ABAP developers. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in SAP ABAP, SAP S/4HANA, and integration technologies, along with proven leadership and stakeholder management skills.

Lead and mentor a team of SAP ABAP developers.
Analyze business requirements and provide technical solutions within SAP landscapes.
Design, develop, test, and deploy SAP ABAP developments including:
Reports (Classical, Interactive, ALV)
Interfaces
Conversions
Enhancements
Forms (SmartForms, SAP Scripts, Adobe Forms)
Workflows

Work on CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, and Fiori backend development.
Perform technical design reviews and ensure coding standards are followed.
Coordinate with functional consultants and business stakeholders to understand requirements.
Estimate development effort and manage project deliverables.
Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide root cause analysis.
Support SAP upgrades, migrations, and integration projects.
Ensure compliance with security, performance, and quality standards.

Technical Skills
Strong expertise in SAP ABAP programming.
Hands-on experience with:
Reports, Enhancements, BADI, User Exits, BTEs
BAPIs, RFCs, ALE/IDocs
SmartForms, Adobe Forms
Object-Oriented ABAP
Module Pool Programming
Experience in SAP S/4HANA development.
Strong knowledge of:
CDS Views
AMDP
SAP Gateway and OData Services
SAP Fiori backend development
Experience with SAP integration technologies.
Debugging and performance optimization skills.
Functional Exposure

SD
MM
FI/CO
PP
WM/EWM
HR/HCM

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in ABAP Development, RICEF Objects, Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, BAPI, BADI, Enhancements, Reports, Interfaces, and S/4HANA development frameworks. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and enhance SAP ABAP programs based on business requirements.
Design and build RICEF objects including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms.
Develop Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, SAP Scripts, and Interactive Forms.
Create and enhance BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, and Enhancement Framework objects.
Design and develop ALV Reports, Classical Reports, and Interactive Reports.
Work with Functional Consultants to understand and translate business requirements.
Analyze and optimize existing ABAP programs for performance improvement.
Develop inbound and outbound interfaces using IDoc, RFC, Web Services, and APIs.
Support S/4HANA migration and custom code remediation activities.
Prepare Technical Specifications and Design Documents.
Conduct Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Production Support activities.
Resolve production incidents within SLA timelines.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams during project delivery.
Ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.

Qualifications

B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP ABAP and S/4 Hana experience for JL4.
Minimum 5 years of SAP ABAP experience for JL5.
Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture and development lifecycle.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.
AboutCompany: Bajaj Broking is a 100% subsidiary of Bajaj Finance Limited offering wide spectrum of Capital Market Solutions covering Equities, Mutual funds, corporate deposits, Bonds, Insurance & Loans which are been offered to Corporates, High-net-worth individuals, and Families.
CompanyAddress: Bajaj Auto Limited Complex, Mumbai-Pune Road,, PUNE, Maharashtra, India

Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) Global Procurement
Solutions (GPS) | Buying Desk - Global Technology Category Location Band Role Type Shift Kraft Heinz India GCC - Ahmedabad or Bangalore B13 Individual Contributor North America-aligned / night shift support required CRITICAL EXPERIENCE 10+ years in procurement, including 5-7 years specifically in IT Procurement Role Summary The Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) leads complex, end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives of up to USD 15 million across global technology categories within the Global Procurement Solutions organization. The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep expertise in technology sourcing, and the ability to structure and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements that deliver measurable business value. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. The successful candidate must bring hands-on expertise in SaaS agreements, supplier redlines, and complex IT services negotiations, working closely with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful contracting outcomes. Page 1 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Develop sourcing strategies covering supplier segmentation, RFx design, commercial structures, TCO and cost models, negotiation plans, communications, and award recommendations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations for SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, cloud services, managed services, telecom, and IT professional services. Review supplier contractual redlines and collaborate with Legal, Information Security, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive agreements to closure. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Procurement Compliance & Governance Own and enforce compliance with sourcing policies, approval thresholds, controls, and governance frameworks. Ensure correct usage of procurement tools, approved workflows, and standardized processes, including SAP Ariba and ServiceNow. Act as an escalation point for contract compliance and ensure contracts accurately reflect approved commercial and legal positions. Perform compliance checks across SOW, CR, Purchase Request, and Sourcing Request processes and maintain audit-ready documentation. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Security, IT, and Audit teams to protect governance integrity and mitigate risk. Page 2 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions 4. Supplier & Contract Management Lead supplier evaluation, selection, onboarding, and performance management based on category strategy and defined criteria. Drive supplier consolidation, innovation, performance improvement, cost efficiency, and long-term value creation. Manage supplier risks using structured governance, KPIs, scorecards, and quarterly business reviews. Build strategic partnerships with global suppliers across North America, Europe, and other relevant geographies. 5. Value Creation & Continuous Improvement Identify and implement improvements across sourcing and procurement operations. Drive demand optimization, supplier rationalization, AI-enabled sourcing, RFx optimization, and intake workflow automation. Develop reusable sourcing frameworks, templates, playbooks, and best practices. Support procurement transformation and maturity-building initiatives within the GCC. 6. Stakeholder Management Advise and influence global stakeholders and category leads to shape sourcing strategies and optimize outcomes. Collaborate with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, IT Directors and VPs, Information Security, and business teams across geographies. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Mentorship & Team Support Act as a senior mentor and knowledge leader within the Buying Desk. Guide junior team members on complex sourcing events, negotiations, contracting challenges, and problem-solving. Drive knowledge sharing, capability development, and procurement upskilling initiatives. Page 3 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Required Functional Skills & Expertise Technology Procurement Strategic Sourcing Contracting Negotiation SaaS, software licensing, cloud, telecom, managed services, IT professional services, and global technology suppliers Category strategy, RFx/eSourcing, supplier evaluation, spend analysis, market intelligence, TCO, cost modelling, and award recommendations SAP Ariba Sourcing and Contracts; SAP S/4 or ECC, Coupa or equivalent; ServiceNow; Excel; Power BI preferred SaaS agreements, vendor redlines, SOWs, change requests, contract lifecycle management, renewals, and commercial risk assessment Structured negotiation planning, leverage creation, stakeholder alignment, supplier negotiation, and measurable value delivery Governance Tools & Systems Procurement policies, approval thresholds, compliance controls, audit readiness, and source-to-pay governance Soft / Power Skills Strategic Thinking: Translate business needs into practical sourcing and commercial strategies. Leadership Without Authority: Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies. Negotiation Excellence: Apply a structured, fact-based approach to complex technology negotiations. Analytical Problem-Solving: Use data, cost models, and market insights to guide decisions. Executive Communication: Explain complex procurement strategies and contract positions clearly. Stakeholder Management: Build trust and effectively manage senior global stakeholders. Change Mindset: Challenge the status quo and drive process and technology improvements. Resilience & Agility: Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and global time-zone requirements. Page 4 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of experience in procurement and strategic sourcing. 5-7 years of direct IT Procurement experience across SaaS, software, cloud, telecom, managed services, or IT professional services. Demonstrated experience negotiating SaaS agreements and reviewing supplier redlines in partnership with Legal and business stakeholders. Proven technology negotiation experience, with the ability to explain the situation, strategy, tactics, stakeholder alignment, and commercial outcome. Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Clear communicator with stakeholder focus.

Description:
SAP CS (Customer Service) Consultant

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP CS (Customer Service) Consultant with strong expertise in service management processes, customer support operations, and SAP Customer Service module configuration. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in implementing, supporting, and enhancing SAP CS solutions integrated with other SAP modules.
Key Responsibilities
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer service processes.
Configure and support SAP CS functionalities including:
Service Notifications
Service Orders
Service Contracts
Warranty Management
Repair and Returns Processing
Design and implement end-to-end customer service solutions in SAP.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand service operations and recommend best practices.
Integrate SAP CS with:
SAP SD (Sales & Distribution)
SAP PM (Plant Maintenance)
SAP MM (Materials Management)
SAP FI/CO (Finance & Controlling)
Prepare functional specifications and support development teams during enhancements.
Conduct unit testing, integration testing, UAT, and production support.
Provide end-user training and create process documentation.
Support incident resolution and continuous process improvements.
Required Skills
6+ years of hands-on experience in SAP CS module.
Strong knowledge of:
Service Notifications
Service Orders
Installed Base Management
Equipment Master
Functional Locations
Service Contracts
Warranty Claims Management
Experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
Good understanding of customer service and after-sales service processes.
Knowledge of integration with SD, PM, MM, and FI modules.
Experience in implementation, rollout, support, or migration projects.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
The B2B College Connect Sales role is responsible for driving institutional sales across engineering colleges and universities. The role focuses on acquiring new academic partners, expanding existing accounts, and positioning L&T EduTechs industry-aligned skilling and learning solutions to higher education institutions. The incumbent will manage end-to-end sales cycles, engage academic stakeholders, and ensure sustained business growth within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Drive B2B institutional sales for College Connect programs across assigned regions.
Identify and engage with engineering colleges, universities, and academic institutions to promote L&T EduTech offerings.
Build strong relationships with Principals, Directors, Deans, HODs and academic leadership.
Understand institutional needs and propose solution-based skilling programs aligned to curriculum enhancement and employability outcomes.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle including lead generation, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.
Achieve assigned revenue, acquisition, and growth targets consistently.
Ensure repeat business and account expansion within existing partner institutions.
Coordinate with internal teams (content, delivery, operations, finance) to ensure smooth program onboarding and execution.
Track and maintain sales pipeline, forecasts, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and NEP-driven changes to refine sales pitches and proposals.
Participate in academic events, conferences, and institutional meetings to strengthen brand presence.

Reporting: Head College Connect Sales

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering (Preferred)
MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Marketing or Business Management (Preferred)

Domain & Functional Expertise
Strong experience in B2B institutional sales, preferably in EdTech or higher education solutions. Good understanding of engineering education ecosystem and campus buying processes.

Behavioral & Professional Skills:
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Relationship-driven approach with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
Result-oriented mindset with strong ownership and execution focus.
Professional demeanor with high ethical standards.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Territorial Scope: Regional / Location (as assigned)
AboutCompany: L&T EduTech is an initiative of the Larsen & Toubro Group focused on bridging the gap between academia and industry. It works with universities, colleges, enterprises, and professionals to deliver industry-aligned learning, skilling, assessments, and certification programs. L&T EduTech leverages the Groups extensive industry expertise to develop practical, future-ready skills and improve employability across engineering, technology, and other professional domains.
CompanyAddress: Mount poonamallee Road, Manapakkam, Chennai, Tamilnadu, India

Description:
Role & responsibilities

To ensure that all loose grocery staples (rice, wheat, pulses, spices, sugar, flour, etc.) are
processed and packed in the factory to meet FSSAI and regulatory standards and company
quality standards before reaching customers.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Raw Material Quality Checks
• Inspect incoming loose staples for quality parameters (moisture, infestation, purity,
grain size, colour, odour, foreign matter).
• Verify supplier quality certificates and conduct sampling/testing.
2. In-Process Quality Control
• Monitor packing lines to ensure correct weight, sealing, labelling, batch coding, and
hygiene.
• Ensure FEFO/FIFO practices in usage of raw materials and packaging materials.
• Conduct line clearance checks before production runs.
3. Finished Goods Quality
• Inspect packed products for compliance with defined standards (net weight,
labelling, shelf life, seal integrity).
• Retain samples for shelf-life studies.
4. Food Safety & Compliance
• Ensure the factory follows FSSAI, HACCP, GMP, and hygiene norms.
• Monitor pest control, sanitation, and staff hygiene.
• Support internal/external quality audits.
5. Documentation & Reporting
• Maintain inspection logs, QC reports, and non-conformance records.
• Raise corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with production & purchase teams.

Description:
Position: Branch Customer Service Manager
Department: Customer Service
Location: Branch Based
Reporting To: Area Customer Service Manager

Role Purpose
To manage end-to-end customer service operations at the branch level, ensuring excellent customer experience, timely resolution of service requests, compliance with regulatory and internal policies, and effective coordination with Sales, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Service & Operations
Ensure timely resolution of customer queries, complaints, and service requests.
Monitor branch-level service quality and customer satisfaction metrics.
Manage activities related to loan servicing, statement requests, NOCs, foreclosure requests, repayment support, and post-disbursement customer servicing.
Drive adherence to customer service SLAs and turnaround times.
Customer Experience
Deliver superior borrower experience across all customer touchpoints.
Handle escalated cases and ensure proactive resolution.
Identify customer pain points and recommend process improvements.
Support customer retention initiatives and relationship management.
Compliance & Process Governance
Ensure adherence to RBI, NHB, company policies, and operational guidelines.
Maintain audit readiness and ensure closure of observations within timelines.
Monitor compliance with documentation, service processes, and branch controls.
Stakeholder Management
Coordinate closely with Sales, Credit, Technical, Legal, Collections, and Central Operations teams.
Act as the primary customer service representative for the branch.
Support branch management in resolving operational and customer-related issues.
Team Management
Lead and coach branch customer service executives.
Monitor individual and team productivity.
Conduct regular reviews and capability-building sessions.
Foster a customer-centric culture within the branch.
MIS & Reporting
Track service-related KPIs and branch performance metrics.
Prepare periodic reports for management review.
Analyze trends in complaints, service requests, and operational issues.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Complaint Resolution TAT
Service Request Closure TAT
Audit & Compliance Scores
Customer Retention Metrics
Branch Service Quality Parameters
Process Adherence and Accuracy

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline.
2-6 years of experience in customer service, branch operations, banking, NBFC, HFC, or financial services.
Strong understanding of home loan servicing and branch operations.
Good knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage teams and drive service excellence.

What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. Thats the future we're building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.
What will you drive?
Team Leadership: You may get a team (of Builder - Retail Associates) to lead and mentor, ensuring they meet performance targets and provide exceptional customer service.
Dealer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding of dealers, guiding the team in identifying and engaging potential partners on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and others.
Lead Generation and Appointment Booking: Strategically manage the lead generation process and ensure seamless booking of customer appointments through social media outreach.

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Drafting, vetting, reviewing, negotiating agreements, amendments, other legal documents including agreements for HR, procurement, relating to engineering, telecom, IT sector, lease agreements and other agreements with a good understanding of risks.
Working in close co-ordination with legal, technical, HR, Admin, Finance, Procurement and other departments, external Legal Counsels.
To examine and summarise customer MSA, NDA, MOU, End User Licensing Agreement, Subcontractor/Vendor Agreement, RFP etc. at the global level.
Be conversant with GDPR, global data privacy laws and regulations.
Handle litigation matters as and when the need arises.
Advising and assist key departments on all contractual matters and be a strategic advisor to the business.
To draft alternative clauses where necessary.
To negotiate with vendors, customers agreements in conjunction with front end/sales teams.
Regular training of user teams on executed contracts, contract compliance.
In depth detailed research on various legal issues/projects.
Update contract database/Legal Repository.
Manage team under him/her ~ 2 resources to manage above tasks.
Handling general administrative duties.
Abreast with technology and technology applications in legal field.

Preferred candidate profile

Degree in Law from a renowned law school plus 4 plus years post qualification experience in international contract/commercial law and contract management.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and drafting skills.
Experience in dealing with external customers/clients.
Ability to manage and prioritize heavy and variable workload and manage team.
Proven accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to read contracts quickly and determine salient points.
Enthusiastic and hard-working.
Good negotiation skills to deal with internal departments and for future external contact.
Prior experience in engineering services, telecom or IT sector.
Experience in global or multicultural company
Ability to handle a team.

L&T Technology Services (LTTS) is an Indian multinational technology company that provides engineering research and development (ER&D) services, headquartered in Vadodara. We have an urgent opening for a position of Sales Executive for Mumbai, Bangalore & Ahmedabad Location

Role & responsibilities
Experience in sales leadership, preferably in the pharmaceutical equipment/lab equipment/process instrumentation industry
Develop, implement, and execute effective national sales strategies for pharmaceutical equipment to achieve business growth and revenue targets.

Strong experience in B2B sales, key account management, and enterprise sales cycles.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical ability to interpret sales data, market trends, and performance metrics.
Hands-on experience with CRM tools (ERP Software or equivalent) and Microsoft Office Suite.
Ability to lead large distributed teams across multiple regions and travel extensively as required.
Educational Qualification: B.E. (Electronics / Instrumentation) or B.Sc. / MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Administration (preferred with pharma equipment exposure).

Description:
bout the Role
Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives in high-volume, dynamic environments? We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to drive end-to-end frontline manpower hiring across west region. In this role, you will lead high-impact hiring initiatives, optimize sourcing channels, build grassroots partnerships, and ensure a seamless pipeline from candidate selection to onboarding and training.
If you excel at execution, community outreach, and balancing quality with speed, we want to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Direct Recruitment Planning (20%)
Review rolling 3-month hiring targets (location, quantity, skill requirements) and develop actionable recruitment plans.
Optimize sourcing channels, combining walk-ins, mass drives, digital recruitment, and specialized outreach programs (e.g., homecoming drives).
Identify resource requirements for hiring events and gain alignment/sign-off with leadership.
Recruitment Process Execution & Monitoring (80%)
Mobilize recruitment teams and lead execution of scheduled hiring drives and events.
Ensure full compliance with internal company policies, statutory regulations, and labor laws governing recruitment.
Issue Letters of Intent (LOI) to selected candidates and actively follow up to ensure seamless transition to training centers with required documentation.
Coordinate directly with training schools on candidate rosters and arrival schedules.
Track hiring event effectiveness, course-correct plans as needed, and maintain accurate recruitment MIS and reporting.
Stakeholders & Relationships
Internal: Hub & Branch Operations Teams, ISM Officers, Recruitment Lead.
External: Prospective candidates, Government/State agencies, Gram Panchayats, local community authorities, and NGOs.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate degree or equivalent (minimum required).
Experience: 5-7 years of relevant HR experience with a strong background in managing volume recruitment processes.
