Description:
Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Databricks and a strong background in Data Engineering. Develop APIs and microservices for AI model integration.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, latency, and scalability in production environments.
Follow MLOps best practices for model deployment, experimentation, and monitoring.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Description
 Position: Marketing Specialist Builder Partnerships (MBA Fresher)
Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.

Job description:
The FSE will be responsible for acquiring new clients, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and drive revenue growth for advertising space in print media. The role involves field visits, client meetings, proposal pitching, post-sales support, and internal coordination.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Sales & Revenue Growth:
Achieve sales targets as defined by the organization.
Motivate clients to choose bigger ads and run them more often to increase revenue.

Client Acquisition & Relationship Management:
Identify and visit prospective clients through internal database or internal references.
Offer print advertisement solutions that match the clients business goals.
Build and maintain strong long-term client relationships.
Win repeat business from Clients by giving steady, reliable service.

Solution-Oriented Pitching:
Understand the clients business needs and develop customized marketing proposal.
Use data insights, wherever possible, to help clients reach more customers in new areas.
Encourage client participation in Special Initiatives (festive editions, theme-based ads, etc.).
Support in field marketing activities related to SIs

Campaign Execution, Collections & Coordination:
Act as the point of contact for clients on all post-sale support (creatives, deadlines, placements).
Collect advertisement materials/creatives and ensure timely submission for publishing.
Coordinate with internal departments (Billing, RO Generation, Scheduling) to ensure smooth ad execution.

Job Location :Ahmedabad
Years of Experience Required : 3+ Years
Qualification : Graduate / Postgraduate / MBA/ PGDM

Job Title: Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager - Human Resources (Generalist Role)

Location: Ahmedabad
Experience: 4+
Department: Human Resources

Key Responsibilities:
Partner with business leaders to provide strategic HR support aligned with business goals.
Drive end-to-end HR operations including recruitment, onboarding, policy implementation, payroll coordination, and HRIS management.
Manage employee life cycle activities: joining formalities, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities.
Act as a change agent and drive initiatives on employee engagement, retention, and culture building.
Coordinating for the performance management process including goal setting, quaterly reviews, and annual appraisals.
Handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters while ensuring within TAT and empathetic resolution.
Prepare HR dashboards, MIS reports, and analytics for decision-making and strategy.

Requirements:
Education: MBA in HR, MSW, or any equivalent postgraduate qualification in Human Resources.
Experience: Minimum 4 years of relevant HR generalist experience.
Skills:
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Proficiency in Excel, HRIS systems, and MIS reporting
Problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive issues professionally

Travel: Should be open to travel within the Gujarat State as per business needs.

ROLE SUMMARY
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property features, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate pricing between buyers and sellers to close deals.
Onboard property owners and encourage premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.
ELIGIBILITY
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory
Smart freshers / Experience up to 2 years in field sales.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
Bike and valid Driving License.
Smartphone.
Candidates should be comfortable communicating in at least one of the required language combinations: English/Kannada, English/Telugu, English/Tamil, or English/Hindi.
PREFERRED SKILLS
Field Sales ¢ Business Development ¢ Lead Generation ¢ Customer Relationship Management (CRM) ¢ Negotiation ¢ Client Acquisition ¢ Relationship Building ¢ Sales Closing ¢ Site Visits ¢ Communication Skills ¢ Target Achievement ¢ Time Management
READY TO BUILD YOUR CAREER IN REAL ESTATE SALES?
Join a field-driven role where you will engage property owners and customers, conduct site visits, and contribute directly to successful property transactions.
NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd. | Seller Business Development Associate (BDA)

Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.

Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language

BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. Description:
Senior Technical Consultant - Risk & Security -ServiceNow (Global role)
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Chennai

Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Risk and Security Engineer who will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, implementation, integration and continuous improvement of enterprise ServiceNow GRC/IRM and Security Operations solutions. The role translates risk, regulatory, compliance, cybersecurity, incident response, vulnerability management and operational requirements into secure, scalable, supportable and upgrade-safe ServiceNow designs.
In this global role, you will design and deliver next-generation AI-powered solutions, intelligent workflows, and reusable accelerators that strengthen our ServiceNow portfolio and help shape the future of digital transformation.
The candidate must communicate credibly with senior executives, CISOs, risk and compliance leaders, internal audit, control owners, legal and security teams, SOC leadership, incident response teams, vulnerability management teams, architects and technical delivery resources. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

Key Responsibilities
Implementation and solution delivery
Lead technical delivery from discovery and requirements through design, configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare and transition to support.
Configure ServiceNow GRC/IRM capabilities including Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Audit Management, Operational Risk, Regulatory Change, issues and remediation, indicators, attestations, evidence and control testing.
Configure ServiceNow SecOps capabilities including Security Incident Response, Vulnerability Response, Threat Intelligence, Major Security Incident Management, phishing response and relevant cloud, application, infrastructure and operational technology vulnerability capabilities.
Configure authority documents, policies, controls, risks, entities, profiles, scoring models, vulnerable items, remediation tasks, response tasks, investigation workflows, prioritization rules, exceptions, deferrals, dashboards, workspaces and executive reporting.
Apply ServiceNow product guidance, platform standards, secure development practices, data-protection requirements and upgrade-safe configuration principles.
Design and architecture support
Provide detailed technical and product design input to Solution, Technical, Enterprise, Security and Integration Architects.
Recommend appropriate GRC/IRM and SecOps capabilities, data structures, workflow designs, integrations, access controls, security models and implementation patterns, balancing out-of-the-box functionality, configuration, orchestration, low-code and custom development.
Contribute to solution designs, configuration workbooks, data models, interface specifications, deployment plans, estimates, architecture decisions and technical risk assessments.
Assess interactions with the wider cybersecurity, risk, compliance and IT operations ecosystem, identifying product constraints, licensing considerations, dependencies, risks and design trade-offs.
Challenge requirements that introduce unnecessary customization, duplicate tooling, technical debt, security weaknesses, data risk or upgrade complexity.
Stakeholder and requirements management
Lead or support workshops with senior executives, CISOs, SOC leaders, risk and compliance teams, internal audit, legal, cybersecurity, process owners, control owners, incident responders, vulnerability managers, threat intelligence teams, IT operations, application owners, infrastructure teams and technical stakeholders.
Translate strategic risk, compliance, cybersecurity and operational objectives into functional and technical requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data requirements, integration requirements and non-functional requirements.
Assess existing processes, tools, queues, spreadsheets, integrations and manual activities to identify opportunities for standardization, automation, risk reduction and improved reporting.
Explain ServiceNow capabilities, limitations, dependencies, costs, risks and design implications clearly to executive and technical audiences and facilitate timely design decisions.
Technical configuration, integration and data
Perform advanced ServiceNow configuration using tables, forms, fields, workspaces, roles, groups, access controls, Flow Designer, playbooks, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, notifications and scheduled processes.
Develop or configure integrations using JavaScript, Glide APIs, REST/SOAP services, IntegrationHub, import sets, transform maps, authentication methods and event-driven integration patterns.
Integrate with identity, security, vulnerability, CMDB, asset, ERP, HR, document, regulatory-content, third-party risk, reporting, SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability scanners, endpoint and network detection tools, threat intelligence providers, email-security platforms, cloud-security tools, application-security tools and collaboration systems.
Design ingestion, transformation, normalization, correlation, enrichment, reconciliation, monitoring, error handling, encryption, auditability and support requirements.
Align risks, controls, incidents and vulnerabilities with configuration items, applications, business services, owners, locations and organizational entities using CSDM and CMDB data, authoritative sources, identification rules, reconciliation, synchronization and data-quality controls.
Support migration and validation of policies, controls, risks, issues, evidence, audit records, regulatory content, security incidents, vulnerable items and organizational data.
Risk, compliance, incident response and vulnerability management
Implement GRC/IRM workflows for control design and effectiveness, risk assessment, risk scoring, appetite and tolerance, attestations, testing, evidence collection, regulatory obligations, issues and remediation, indicators and continuous monitoring.
Implement SecOps workflows for incident triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, closure, evidence capture, communications, chain-of-custody and post-incident review.
Configure risk-based vulnerability prioritization using severity, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, exposure, service impact and business context.
Configure vulnerability groups, assignment rules, remediation tasks, service-level targets, exceptions, deferrals, false positives, scanner synchronization, backlog reporting and executive risk-reduction views.
Support Third-Party Risk Management, Business Continuity Management and integration with wider enterprise security and risk operating models where in scope.
Testing, governance and leadership
Develop and review unit, system, integration, regression and user acceptance test materials; investigate defects and resolve configuration, security, integration, workflow, data and performance issues.
Support release planning, code review, deployment, validation, rollback, Automated Test Framework usage, production hypercare, knowledge transfer and operational handover.
Ensure compliance with development standards, security policies, data-protection requirements, change controls, least-privilege access, segregation of duties, requirements traceability, peer review, security review and architecture governance.
Provide technical leadership to consultants, developers, analysts, administrators and integration specialists; review deliverables and contribute reusable methods, templates, accelerators and integration patterns.
Support pre-sales activities including discovery, solution shaping, demonstrations, estimates, proposals, statements of work and customer presentations.

Mandatory Qualifications and Experience
Current ServiceNow certification relevant to either GRC/IRM or Security Operations, such as Certified Implementation Specialist - Risk and Compliance, Certified Implementation Specialist - Security Incident Response, Certified Implementation Specialist - Vulnerability Response or current equivalent credentials.
Proven experience implementing ServiceNow GRC/IRM and/or Security Operations in complex enterprise environments, including multiple end-to-end implementations.
Strong knowledge of ServiceNow risk, compliance and security architecture, data structures, workflows, security, reporting, integrations, CMDB alignment and enterprise operating models.
ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) highly preferred
Excellent soft skills executive communication (written/verbal), adaptability, problem solving, teamwork, relationship building, dependability, and organization
At least 3 x Certified Implementation Specialist certificates
Extensive hands-on experience architecting and delivering ServiceNow solutions
Proven success leading technically complex implementations
Ability to lead technical discussions confidently with customers and stakeholders
Prior consulting experience
Experience leading teams and supervising others
Proven experience engineering and supporting ServiceNow in complex enterprise environments.
Proven ability to provide detailed product and technical design input to ServiceNow Solution and Technical Architects.
Experience translating risk, compliance, audit, regulatory, cybersecurity, incident response, vulnerability management and operational requirements into implementable ServiceNow designs.
Experience working directly with senior executives, CISOs, security leaders, risk and compliance leaders, internal audit, legal, security, control-owner teams, SOC, incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, IT operations, infrastructure and application teams.
Strong ServiceNow configuration and development skills, including JavaScript, Glide APIs, REST APIs, IntegrationHub, import sets, transform maps, authentication and technical documentation.
Experience integrating ServiceNow with security, identity, vulnerability, CMDB, asset, reporting, SIEM, SOAR, scanner, endpoint, threat intelligence and enterprise data platforms.
Excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to lead workshops, manage conflicting priorities and present complex recommendations to executive and technical audiences.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timescales.

Expected Experience
Typically eight or more years of cybersecurity, risk technology, security technology or enterprise application experience.
Five or more years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, with three or more years in ServiceNow GRC/IRM, SecOps or adjacent risk and security implementation work.
Delivery experience across at least two substantial end-to-end ServiceNow implementations in GRC/IRM, Security Incident Response, Vulnerability Response or comparable risk and security domains.
Experience in large, regulated, multinational, government, financial services, healthcare, energy, utilities, telecommunications, critical-infrastructure, defence or comparable environments is preferred.

Technical and Domain Knowledge
The candidate should demonstrate practical knowledge across ServiceNow GRC/IRM and Security Operations, including Policy and Compliance Management, enterprise and operational risk, risk assessment, scoring, appetite and tolerance, Audit Management, control design and effectiveness, attestations, testing and evidence, issues and remediation, indicators and continuous monitoring, regulatory obligations, Security Incident Response, Vulnerability Response, major security incidents, threat intelligence, response playbooks, evidence and audit requirements, risk-based vulnerability remediation, SIEM and SOAR, vulnerability scanners, EDR and NDR, cloud and application-security tooling, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, JavaScript and Glide APIs, REST/SOAP integrations, data migration, reporting, dashboards and workspaces, CSDM and CMDB, role-based access controls, Automated Test Framework, release management and upgrade-safe implementation.
Framework familiarity is preferred across ISO 27001, ISO 31000, NIST, NIST CSF, NIST 800-61, COBIT, COSO, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, CVSS, OWASP, SOC 2, PCI DSS, SOX, GDPR, DORA, HIPAA or comparable standards and regulations.

Preferred Qualifications
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer or additional relevant implementation credentials.
One or more additional ServiceNow certifications across Risk and Compliance, Security Incident Response, Vulnerability Response, Performance Analytics, IntegrationHub or Automated Test Framework.
Professional risk, audit, security or compliance qualification such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, Security+, CEH or equivalent experience.
Experience integrating GRC/IRM with SecOps, ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, SOC tooling and enterprise data platforms.
Experience supporting ServiceNow pre-sales, solution shaping, demonstrations, estimates, proposals and statements of work.

Professional Competencies and Key Deliverables
Competencies
Structured analysis and problem-solving with the ability to connect business risk, regulatory obligations, security operations and technical implementation choices.
Credibility with executives, CISOs, security professionals, risk and compliance leaders, internal audit, legal teams and technical specialists.
Strong facilitation, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
Confidence to challenge unclear, inappropriate, insecure or over-customized requirements while communicating risks and constraints objectively.
Professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, discretion and effectiveness during priority incidents or high-visibility governance discussions.
Ability to work effectively across distributed teams with a commitment to mentoring, reusable delivery methods and continuous improvement.

Measures of Success
Secure, maintainable and scalable solutions that conform to approved architecture, ServiceNow standards and enterprise security requirements.
Accurate translation of business, regulatory, cybersecurity and operational requirements into working functionality delivered to agreed milestones.
Effective management of technical risks, dependencies, defects and sensitive data, supported by complete documentation and successful operational handover.
Strong customer confidence, stakeholder collaboration and adoption of the implemented GRC/IRM and SecOps capabilities.
Visible improvement in risk transparency, control effectiveness, incident handling, vulnerability prioritization, remediation outcomes and executive reporting quality.


Regards
Ramkumar

Description:
ServiceNow CRM engineer
Location: Mumbai / Bangalore / Chennai
Scope of the Role:
"ServiceNow CRM engineer" is a senior technical leadership position within the Global ServiceNow Portfolio Organization, reporting directly to the CTO / Portfolio Lead and operating as a key member of the global leadership team.
Working closely with international stakeholders, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams across regions, the role drives engineering innovation and technology strategy at a global scale.
The position is responsible for leading the development of next-generation CRM accelerators, shaping the architecture of advanced GenAI and Agentic AI capabilities, and building differentiated intellectual property that strengthens Atos' global ServiceNow portfolio and market leadership. The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence, driving innovation initiatives, technology decisions, and long-term platform capabilities across the worldwide organization.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, configure, and develop solutions on the ServiceNow platform across CRM, CSM, enterprise workflow modules, and custom applications.
Develop and enhance Customer Service Management (CSM) workflows including Case Management, Customer Interaction Management, Omnichannel Engagement, Knowledge Management, Service Request Automation and Customer Self-Service Portals.
Implement intelligent customer workflows using Now Assist GenAI Skills AI Agents Configure workflows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, catalogs, and integrations.
Develop AI-powered customer support automation and conversational workflow solutions.
Build and maintain scoped applications using ServiceNow Studio.
Develop integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and external CRM/enterprise systems.
Support workflow orchestration across customer operations, support systems, and enterprise applications.
Participate in CMDB, CI lifecycle management, and CSDM-aligned service modeling initiatives.
Translate functional and technical requirements into scalable and efficient technical solutions.
Ensure compliance with ServiceNow development best practices, security guidelines, and coding standards.
Conduct unit testing, debugging, defect resolution, and technical troubleshooting.
Participate in peer reviews and contribute to development governance standards.
Support platform upgrades, enhancements, and release management activities.
Participate in AI-driven customer workflow automation and enterprise integration initiatives. Contribute to reusable CRM workflow frameworks, accelerators, and automation assets.
Participate in solution design workshops and technical discussions with customer operations and business teams.
Support deployment, UAT, hypercare, and post-production stabilization activities.

Required Experience & Capabilities:
7+ years of relevant ServiceNow platform development experience with expertise in CRM/CSM workflows, intelligent workflow automation, enterprise integrations, CMDB/CSDM implementations, and AI-powered ServiceNow capabilities.
Hands-on experience as a ServiceNow Developer in enterprise or consulting environments.
Strong understanding of customer service operations, digital customer engagement, and CRM workflow automation.
Expertise in JavaScript Glide APIs Flow Designer Script Includes Business Rules Client Scripts UI Policies IntegrationHub
Strong experience with ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) and related modules such as CSM ITSM Service Catalog HRSD ITOM Custom Applications
Experience implementing Case Management workflows Customer lifecycle workflows Omnichannel support experiences Customer self-service solutions
Knowledge-driven support automation Experience with Now Assist GenAI Skills AI Agents / Agentic Workflows AI Search
Predictive Intelligence Working knowledge of CMDB architecture CSDM framework CI relationships Service Mapping concepts Familiarity with A2A and MCP-based AI integration approaches is an advantage.
Understanding of scoped applications, update sets, CI/CD

Description:
About Us:
Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.

Our Leaders:
Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.

Working Days : 6 days a week
Working Hours : 11:00 AM 8:00 PM
Location : Bangalore & Chennai

Summary of the Role:
We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.

Responsibilities:
Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp.
Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.
End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.
Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets.
Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals


Required Skills and Qualifications:
Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage.
Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru / Tamil for Chennai) is highly desirable to build a local connection.
Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.
Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)


Whats in it for You?
Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures. Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months.
Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.
AboutCompany: Vedantu is India's one of the best education platforms, known for creating one of the most sought after learning apps. With our unique learning platform called WAVE and immensely talented best teachers, Vedantu offers a highly personalised learning experience for 1st to 12th grades across CBSE and ICSE Boards.

Description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Python Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Python-based test automation and SAP business process automation.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, enhancing and maintaining automated test cases using an existing Python automation framework. The role involves automating SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows, developing reusable automation components, and supporting end-to-end automation across various SAP business processes.
The candidate should have hands-on experience in Python programming, SAP S/4HANA automation, SAP GUI and Fiori, along with a strong understanding of automation frameworks and software testing methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and automate new SAP business test cases using the existing Python automation framework.
Enhance and maintain reusable Python components, transaction classes, workflows, subflows and automation utilities.
Automate SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows wherever applicable.
Develop end-to-end automation solutions across Procurement, Sales, Inventory, Finance and other SAP business processes.
Maintain and enhance regression, smoke and integration automation test suites.
Identify, debug and resolve automation failures to improve test stability and execution efficiency.
Improve synchronization, logging, reporting and error-handling mechanisms within the automation framework.
Follow coding standards and best practices, conduct code reviews and validate changes to prevent regressions.
Collaborate with SAP functional consultants, QA teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into reliable automation solutions.
Support continuous improvement of automation frameworks, utilities and testing processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in Python programming and automation development.
Experience in SAP S/4HANA automation and SAP business process testing.
Hands-on experience automating SAP GUI transactions.
Experience with SAP Fiori-based workflow automation.
Good understanding of Python automation frameworks and reusable component development.
Experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts and workflows.
Knowledge of regression testing, smoke testing and integration testing.
Ability to debug automation scripts and troubleshoot execution failures.
Understanding of SAP business processes such as Procurement, Sales, Inventory and Finance.
Strong problem-solving, analytical and debugging skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Pytest, Selenium, Robot Framework or similar automation tools.
Knowledge of SAP GUI Scripting API.
Exposure to PyAutoGUI or other desktop automation libraries.
Experience with SAP Fiori and SAP Gateway.
Knowledge of API automation and integration testing.
Experience working with reusable automation frameworks and test utilities.
Exposure to Agile development and testing methodologies.

Interested candidates can share their Cvs to namrata.dutta@mindseek.net.

Thanks & Regards
Namrata Dutta

Set performance goals and career paths for delivery teams

Ensure compliance with client, data security, and process standards

Support budgeting, forecasting, and revenue realization

Job Title: Unified Communication & Collaboration Support Engineer
Experience: 2.7 to 3 Years
Location: Pune / Bangalore / Coimbatore
Work Mode: Hybrid
Shift: US Shift
Education: 15 years of full-time education required

Job Description:
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents related to Unified Communication and Collaboration systems.
Support communication platforms, including Cisco UCS, Genesys, and Contact Centre solutions.
Assist with system performance monitoring and operational improvements.
Handle change requests and update technical documentation and knowledge base articles.
Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to resolve technical issues.

Required Skills:
Knowledge of Unified Communication and Collaboration Operations.
Basic understanding of Cisco UCS, Genesys, and Contact Centre technologies.
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with incident and change management processes.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.
Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).
Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

Description:
Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst
Location- Bangalore/ Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune
Exp- 8+ Yrs
Mandatory Skills- Oracle Payroll, E-Business Suite (EBS), SQL and PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formualas
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst to support, maintain and enhance Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Payroll within a complex, multi-country payroll environment.
Working as part of a specialist team of analysts and developers, this role combines deep Oracle Payroll functional knowledge with strong technical expertise to deliver payroll system enhancements, support legislative compliance, maintain platform stability and ensure the successful delivery of business-critical change.
The successful candidate will possess advanced technical skills in SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formula, Oracle E-Business Suite architecture, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), integrations and application lifecycle management. They will also have practical and demonstrable experience supporting payroll operations across multiple jurisdictions, translating country-specific legislative and regulatory requirements into compliant system configurations, calculations, controls and technical solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Oracle Payroll Support & Administration
Support, maintain and enhance Oracle EBS Payroll and associated HRMS modules.
Investigate and resolve complex payroll, application and integration issues.
Ensure system reliability, availability, performance and security.
Support payroll operations across multiple countries, ensuring compliance with local payroll legislation, statutory requirements, regulatory controls and reporting obligations.
Provide technical and functional expertise in payroll processing, balancing, reconciliation and issue resolution.
Monitor system health and proactively identify opportunities for improvement and risk reduction.
Technical Development
Develop, maintain and support:
SQL and PL/SQL solutions
Oracle Fast Formulas
Payroll configurations
Custom developments
Interfaces and integrations
Reports and data extracts
Analyse business requirements and translate them into scalable, supportable technical solutions.
Ensure developments comply with established development standards, security requirements and best practices.
Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
Support data migration and transformation activities where required.
Solution Delivery & Change Management
Manage the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for payroll enhancements and projects.
Support requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing and deployment activities.
Ensure technical solutions are documented, supportable and aligned with business and architectural standards.
Collaborate with Payroll, HR, Finance and project teams to deliver business-critical change.
Support release management, deployment planning and environment management activities.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and system optimisation opportunities.
Architecture & Technical Support
Maintain a strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and supporting technologies.
Support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.
Work with infrastructure teams and third-party support providers to resolve technical issues and implement system changes.
Support resilience, performance optimisation and capacity planning activities.
Contribute to technical roadmaps and platform improvement initiatives.
Maintain awareness of Oracle product strategy, security recommendations and industry best practices.
Upgrades, Patching & Release Management
Support the planning and execution of:
Oracle application upgrades
Security patching
Legislative updates
Environment refreshes
Release deployments
Participate in testing, validation and deployment activities.
Conduct impact assessments, support regression testing activities and deployment planning.
Ensure upgrades and patches are implemented in accordance with governance and operational requirements.
Assess Oracle legislative updates and country-specific regulatory changes and determine their impact on payroll configurations, calculations, interfaces and reporting.
Coordinate testing and implementation activities with Payroll and relevant subject matter experts.
Stakeholder Engagement
Communicate complex technical concepts and solution options clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with Payroll, HR, Finance, Tax, Legal and Compliance teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Work with in-country Payroll specialists to ensure local legislative requirements are accurately reflected within Oracle Payroll.
Support business stakeholders in understanding system capabilities, risks, limitations and solution options.
Build effective relationships across all levels of the organisation.
Provide clear and practical technical recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Vendor & Partner Management
Work closely with third-party infrastructure and application support providers.
Manage supplier performance against agreed service levels and operational standards.
Collaborate with vendors to resolve incidents, implement enhancements and deliver technical improvements.
Support supplier governance processes and periodic service reviews.
Escalate risks and service concerns appropriately to ensure timely resolution.
Audit, Controls & Compliance
Support and maintain a robust controls framework across the Oracle Payroll landscape.
Ensure payroll system processes, configurations and integrations operate in accordance with internal controls, audit standards and regulatory requirements.
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Security and Compliance teams to support periodic reviews and audits.
Provide system expertise and evidence for audit requests, including documentation of system controls, processes, workflows and technical configurations.
Identify and mitigate operational, security and compliance risks relating to payroll systems and processes.
Support the design and ongoing monitoring of application controls, segregation of duties and access management processes.
Ensure development, change management and release management activities comply with governance standards.
Lead or support remediation activities arising from audit findings, control assessments and compliance reviews.
Maintain accurate technical and functional documentation to support compliance, operational effectiveness and knowledge management.
Contribute to disaster recovery, business continuity and resilience testing activities.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll within multi-country environments.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.
Experience assessing, configuring, testing and implementing country-specific legislative and regulatory payroll changes.
Ability to interpret payroll legislation and statutory requirements and translate them into effective Oracle Payroll solutions.
Experience managing legislative and compliance-driven payroll requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of payroll balancing, reconciliation and validation processes.
Experience supporting complex payroll operations within large corporate environments.
Technical Expertise
Advanced SQL skills.
Strong PL/SQL development experience.
Extensive Oracle Fast Formula experience.
Strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and underlying technologies.
Experience supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Experience with:
Integrations and interfaces
Data migration activities
Troubleshooting and root cause analysis
Batch processing and concurrent programmes
Payroll calculations and reconciliation
Security and access controls
Enterprise Command Centre (ECC)
Oracle workflow technologies
Oracle development standards and best practices
Experience managing application upgrades, patching and environment management activities.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGCs), application controls and audit requirements.
Experience supporting internal and external audits.
Knowledge of segregation of duties, access governance and security controls.
Experience working within regulated and compliance-driven environments.
Ability to assess technical and operational risks and implement appropriate mitigation actions.
Understanding of change management, release governance and compliance frameworks.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll across multiple countries or jurisdictions, including the assessment, configuration, testing and implementation of country-specific legislative and regulatory changes.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.
Experience supporting large-scale, multi-country payroll environments.
Strong understanding of payroll governance, audit and compliance requirements within regulated environments.
Ability to interpret payroll legislation and statutory requirements, working with in-country payroll or specialist advisers where necessary, and translate those requirements into functional and technical Oracle Payroll solutions.
Experience managing legislative and compliance-driven payroll requirements and implementation deadlines across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll delivery processes and controls, including payroll calculations, balancing, reconciliation, validation, General Ledger, statutory reporting, audit requirements and legislative compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
Personal Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Collaborative team player with a proactive approach.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability and customer focus.
Excellent documentation and knowledge-sharing skills.
Continuous improvement mindset focused on operational excellence and resilience.
Qualifications (Desirable)
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Systems or a related discipline.
Oracle certifications relating to Oracle Payroll, HRMS or Oracle E-Business Suite.
Payroll qualification or equivalent payroll operations experience.
ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management certification.
Experience working within large, international or highly regulated organisations.

Description:
Project Engineering Manager (PEM) Electrical – Oil & Gas
Roles and Responsibilities
Lead and manage overall electrical engineering activities for Oil & Gas projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, applicable standards, and client requirements.
Manage end-to-end electrical engineering deliverables, ensuring completion within defined project schedules, quality, and cost objectives.
Oversee electrical engineering and design activities for Oil & Gas facilities, including substations, power distribution systems, and associated electrical infrastructure.
Review and approve electrical design calculations, engineering drawings, technical specifications, and project documentation.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, consultants, and vendors to ensure seamless project execution.
Lead technical discussions, design reviews, and resolution of engineering-related issues.
Manage vendor technical evaluations, technical clarifications, drawing reviews, and equipment approvals.
Monitor engineering progress, identify potential delays, and implement corrective actions to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
Lead, guide, and mentor engineering teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and technical performance.
Support tender engineering, BOQ reviews, technical bid evaluations, and project-related commercial activities.
Ensure adherence to relevant IEC, IEEE, IS, and other applicable Oil & Gas industry standards.
Qualification
B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
Minimum Years of Experience and Industry Preference
15+ years of experience in Electrical Engineering and Project Engineering Management within the Oil & Gas industry.
Must have significant experience in handling Electrical Engineering for Oil & Gas projects.
Strong understanding of electrical systems, including substations, power distribution, electrical equipment, protection systems, and control systems.
Experience in managing multidisciplinary engineering teams and coordinating with clients, consultants, and vendors.
Proven ability to manage multiple engineering deliverables and ensure project execution within defined schedules and quality standards.
Strong knowledge of applicable Oil & Gas industry standards, codes, and engineering practices.
Mandatory Requirement:
Must have relevant experience in Oil & Gas Projects.
AboutCompany:
L&T is a 27-billion-dollar Indian multinational company engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-tech Manufacturing and services operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer-focused approach and constant quest for top class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for over eighty decades. L&T is growing at 15% YOY with 61 Billion dollar consolidated orders in hand out of which 38% are international orders. L&T Construction itself owns around 66% of these total order book value. L&T operates in various Sectors like infrastructure projects, Energy Projects, Hi Tech Manufacturing, IT & Technology services, financial services, other business comprises of (a) Realty (b) Industrial valves (c) Construction equipment & mining machinery (d) Rubber processing machinery. Our company has ventured into many new age businesses like green energy, Semiconductor design, Data Centre, Ecommerce & Digital Technology.

L&T has completed many landmark projects such as the statue of Unity which is taller than statue of Liberty, The Narendra Modi Stadium, Mumbai Trans Harbor Link (MTHL)-Indias longest Sea bridge project, Bullet Train (Ahmedabad to Mumbai) the biggest contract value project, Lotus temple at Delhi and many more. We believe in nurturing and caring for our employees.

We emphasize on wellness, trust, and collaboration to foster Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and to enable employees to realize their full potential. We provide challenging assignments and continuous learning opportunities through online, offline and in house digital platforms. L&T has been rated as the Best Place to Work for the last two consecutive years.

We believe that employees mental health is very important for individual and organizational growth so more emphasis is given for better mental health of employees through customized counselling services by mental health experts. We also conduct financial planning workshops for our employees by Industry experts to manage their finance for a better retirement life. Furthermore, we encourage the open-door policy so each employee can approach his/her Superior for any kind of assistance or support at any time. Team-building activities, cultural events, and sports events are conducted at Project sites to keep the morale of the employees always high. L&T as an organization invests lots of money, time & efforts on people development so offers various developmental programs on Technical, behavioral and leadership skills

Job Description

Microsoft Intune Administrator / Endpoint Management Engineer
Experience
67 years in Microsoft Endpoint Management, Intune, SCCM/MECM, or EUC/Modern Workplace technologies.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Intune / Endpoint
Management Engineer to design, implement, administer, and support modern endpoint management solutions across Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android devices.

The role will be responsible for managing device enrollment, configuration policies, application deployment, compliance, security policies, Windows updates, endpoint troubleshooting, automation, and integration with Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with
SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Windows 10/11, Microsoft Entra ID, PowerShell, Autopilot

Key Responsibilities
Administration
Administer and maintain Microsoft Intune environments and SCCM policies.
Manage device enrollment and lifecycle management.
Troubleshoot Intune policy deployment and device synchronization issues.
Analyze Intune reports, device status, policy conflicts, and deployment failures.

Windows Endpoint Management
Manage Windows 10/11 devices through Microsoft Intune and SCCM.
Configure and manage Windows Autopilot deployments.
Support device provisioning, enrollment, re-enrollment, reset, retire, and wipe operations.
Manage Windows Update for Business policies and update rings, Configuration and baselines.
Plan and create new Site systems and roles
Manage and troubleshoot cloud services, distribution issues and MP issues in SCCM
Configure Windows security and endpoint hardening policies.
Troubleshoot Windows endpoint issues related to SCCM, OSD, Client install, patch\app failures, Intune, Entra ID, policies, applications, and enrollment.
Manage SCCM life-cycle

Application Management
Deploy and manage Microsoft Store, Win32, MSI, Microsoft 365 Apps, and LOB applications..
Troubleshoot application installation and deployment failures.

PowerShell & Automation
Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint administration and automation.
Create Intune Proactive Remediation / Remediations detection and remediation scripts.
Automate common endpoint management tasks.
Ensure scripts are secure, maintainable, and suitable for enterprise deployment.

Microsoft Entra ID & Identity
Manage Microsoft Entra ID joined and Hybrid Entra ID joined devices.
Troubleshoot device registration and enrollment issues.
Understand device identities, primary users, group memberships, and dynamic groups.
Troubleshoot common Windows enrollment and authentication issues.

Mobile Device Management
Manage iOS/iPadOS and Android Enterprise devices through Intune.
Configure enrollment profiles and device restrictions.
Manage mobile applications and compliance policies.
Troubleshoot Company Portal, enrollment, application, and compliance issues.

Description:
Role: ServiceNow Developer - Support Project

Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai

Experience: 5 to 9 yrs
Shift: 2:00 PM 11:00 PM IST

Experience & Domain Knowledge
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform, with strong experience in platform operations, development, upgrades, troubleshooting, and enterprise application support.
Strong understanding of the Insurance industry and related business processes, with the ability to translate insurance business requirements into effective ServiceNow solutions
Experience supporting large enterprise insurance clients and working across business and technology stakeholders is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities
Plan, coordinate, test, and execute ServiceNow platform clones and version upgrades, including upgrade planning, impact assessment, pre- and post-upgrade validation, ATF execution, defect identification, remediation, and stakeholder coordination.
Monitor and maintain the health, performance, usage, and overall compliance of the ServiceNow platform and its applications, including Health Scan activities, operational reviews, audit readiness, and remediation of identified risks.
Provide senior-level operational support and platform development for ServiceNow applications and modules, including ITSM, IRM, TPRM, GRC, BCM, and VR.
Responsibilities include troubleshooting, configuration, enhancements, customizations, and ongoing platform sustainment.
Experience with SPM, and CMDB is highly desirable.
Maintain and enhance Service Catalog, Service Level Management, and ITSM capabilities, ensuring platform stability, performance, and alignment with business requirements.
Perform advanced ServiceNow platform development and scripting, including Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Script Includes, Workflow/Flow activities, Service Portal, and other platform components.
Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot ServiceNow integrations using Web Services, REST/SOAP, JDBC, middleware, and other enterprise integration technologies.
Drive automation of ServiceNow platform operations and support processes, identifying opportunities to automate health checks, monitoring, testing, deployments, repetitive support activities, and operational workflows to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance platform reliability.
Drive the adoption and implementation of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including AI Search, Task Intelligence, and other emerging AI features, assessing business use cases, supporting configuration and deployment, and ensuring effective integration with existing platform processes and operations.
Lead ServiceNow deployment and release activities, developing and enforcing deployment plans, operational checklists, validation procedures, and production readiness criteria.
Lead incident, problem, change, and request resolution for complex platform issues, exercising independent judgment and coordinating with internal teams, ServiceNow, and implementation partners where required.
Ensure timely response to system alerts and customer-reported issues, including investigation, communication, escalation, root-cause analysis, and resolution in accordance with established support practices.
Lead Health Scan, audit, and compliance initiatives, translating findings into actionable remediation plans and tracking them through closure.
Design, develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality ServiceNow solutions based on business requirements, platform best practices, security standards, and maintainability principles.
Establish and maintain operational standards and processes, including SOPs, support procedures, operational checklists, knowledge articles, runbooks, and handover documentation with providers and implementation partners.

Description:
SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer Job Description and Summary We are seeking a passionate and skilled SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer with 9+ years of overall experience, including hands-on experience working with SAP environments and a minimum of 9 years in Generative AI (GenAI). The ideal candidate will combine an understanding of SAP applications, data, integrations, and technical landscapes with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Python, and modern AI engineering frameworks. The AI Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions and accelerators that address SAP transformation and delivery use cases. Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for SAP and enterprise use cases, with a strong focus on production readiness.
Build and scale RAG-based solutions using SAP and enterprise data, documentation, technical artifacts, and knowledge repositories.
Develop AI-powered accelerators supporting SAP use cases such as:
SAP custom code analysis and modernization
Functional and technical specification analysis
SAP configuration and documentation analysis
Code generation, review, and validation
Test case generation and automation
Data mapping and data validation
SAP API and integration recommendations
Impact analysis and knowledge assistants
Integrate LLM solutions with SAP applications, APIs, services, and enterprise data sources.
Build and integrate graph-based memory, tool-using agents, and context-aware AI solutions.
Implement multi-agent orchestration and reasoning workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, or custom agent frameworks.
Develop clean, efficient, reusable, and scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Work with cloud-based LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Collaborate with SAP functional, technical, data, integration, and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
Implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, performance, and reliability of AI solutions.
Apply strong software engineering practices covering version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and maintainability.
Support deployment and operation of AI solutions in enterprise production environments.
Required Qualifications
47 years of overall experience in software engineering, SAP technology, AI/ML, or related technology areas.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions.
Prior experience working within SAP environments or on SAP transformation/implementation programs.
Understanding of the SAP ecosystem, SAP business applications, data structures, APIs, integrations, and technical artifacts.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI GPT models, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.
Strong hands-on knowledge of RAG architectures and Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience building APIs, microservices, containers, and cloud-native applications.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Experience with tool calling, agent orchestration, graph-based memory, or memory-augmented AI architectures.
Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, grounding, and hallucination mitigation.
Solid understanding of software engineering practices including Git/version control, testing, CI/CD, and code quality.
Ability to work effectively with SAP technical and functional teams and translate SAP requirements into AI engineering solutions.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with one or more SAP technologies such as ABAP, CDS, RAP, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP APIs/OData, or SAP HANA.
Experience building AI solutions or accelerators specifically for SAP use cases.
Understanding of SAP S/4HANA transformation and Clean Core principles.
Experience integrating AI solutions with SAP BTP or SAP S/4HANA.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or other enterprise LLM platforms.
Experience with tool-using agents, multi-agent systems, memory-augmented architectures, or cognitive architectures.
Experience with LLM evaluation, optimization, observability, and production monitoring.
Prior contributions to open-source GenAI or agent frameworks are advantageous.
Experience deploying and maintaining AI systems at enterprise scale.
Mandatory Skill Sets
Generative AI (GenAI)
Agentic AI
Python
RAG and LLM application development
SAP experience/background

Job Description:
PLM Support Engineer (Teamcenter)
Experience
3 to 15 Years
Location
Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad / Remote (as applicable)

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced PLM Support Engineer to provide L2/L3 support for Teamcenter and other PLM applications. The candidate will be responsible for incident management, troubleshooting workflow issues, supporting CAD integrations, resolving production issues, and ensuring smooth PLM operations across global business functions.
Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 production support for Teamcenter PLM environments.
Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, service requests, and problem tickets within SLA timelines.
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Monitor and maintain PLM application performance and availability.
Investigate workflow failures, dispatcher issues, dataset validation problems, and integration errors.
Support BOM management, release processes, and lifecycle management activities.
Work on CAD integrations such as NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, and related engineering systems.
Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.
Coordinate with business users, development teams, and global stakeholders to resolve critical production issues.
Support user access management, release deployments, and environment maintenance.
Generate support metrics, ticket trend analysis, and operational reports.
Participate in change management, system upgrades, and enhancement activities.
Required Skills
PLM Tools
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam (good to have)
CAD Integration
NX
CATIA
SolidWorks
Technical Skills
L2/L3 Application Support
Incident & Problem Management
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Engineering Change Management (ECM)
BOM Management
Production Support Operations
Oracle SQL / Database Queries
User Access Management
System Monitoring
RCA and Performance Analysis
Soft Skills
Excellent Communication Skills
Stakeholder Management
Customer Support Orientation
Analytical Problem Solving
Global Team Collaboration
Preferred Qualifications
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Experience in manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, or industrial engineering domains.
Exposure to ITIL-based support processes.
Experience supporting global users and distributed teams.
Suitable Designations
PLM Support Engineer
Teamcenter Support Engineer
Teamcenter Administrator
PLM Application Support Consultant
Teamcenter Technical Support Consultant
Application Support Analyst (PLM)
Teamcenter Production Support Engineer

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.
