We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Canada Business is looking to appoint a number of Highways BIM Designer's to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.
Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, AtkinsRalis GTC's Canada business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.
This key post will be based out of Bangalore where we have thriving AtkinsRalis office, which deliver to all AtkinsRalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.
Your Role
Responsibilities
Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.
Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables. Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at AtkinsRalis.
About You
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 6 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil3D, and Bentley MicroStation with a minimum of 2 to 3 years.
AutoCAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
MicroStation experience must, detailed understanding of the MicroStation user interface and all its features to perform.
Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley ProjectWise and Autodesk Vault.

- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- At least 8+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Over4years of experience in developing and scaling Generative AI projects from prototypes to enterprise production, managing throughput, latency, cost, and multi-region deployments.
- Proven expertise implementing AI interoperability protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) at scale for seamless system integration.
- Skilled in using enterprise cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI to build and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions.
- Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen for building robust generative AI applications.

- Expertise in containerization and cloud-native orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker, serverless) and event-driven architectures for scalable deployment of agentic AI workloads; holds relevant AI or solution architecture certifications.

Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.

Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.

Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning

Strong understanding of retail industry

Job

Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced AI / GenAI Retail Specialist (Manager level) to lead the development and implementation of artificial intelligence solutions across our retail operations. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, domain knowledge in the retail sector, and leadership capabilities to drive impactful AI and GenAI initiatives. Your expertise in AI will drive the development of cutting-edge solutions that enhance retail performance across various domains, including merchandising, pricing, customer engagement, and product assortment.



Roles & Responsibilities:

Leverage Retail Knowledge:Utilize your deep understanding of the retail industry (merchandising, customer behavior, product lifecycle) to design AI solutions that address critical retail business needs.
Supervise teams in building, validating, and deploying ML/DL models using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face.
Develop and oversee the implementation of GenAI-powered tools

Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to lead the engagement effort of providing high-quality and value-adding consulting solutions to customers at different stages- from problem definition to diagnosis to solution design, development and deployment.
You will review the proposals prepared by consultants, provide guidance, and analyze the solutions defined for the client business problems to identify any potential risks and issues.
You will identify change Management requirements and propose a structured approach to client for managing the change using multiple communication mechanisms.
You will also coach and create a vision for the team, provide subject matter training for your focus areas, motivate and inspire team members through effective and timely feedback and recognition for high performance.
You would be a key contributor in unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high-quality, value-adding consulting solutions to customers adhering to the guidelines and processes of the organization.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
Technical Requirement
Minimum 9 years of experience in SAP FICO with strong integration skills across MM and SD modules.
Proven expertise in process flows like Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, and Availability to Produce.
Hands-on configuration experience in AR, AP, General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Product Costing, FSCM and COPA.
Ability to independently write Functional Specifications and work on custom object development and deployment.
Experience in at least one end-to-end SAP implementation project.
Exposure to Concur, T&E, industry-specific solutions, and customer-facing roles is a strong advantage.
Additional Responsibility
Ability to work with clients to identify business challenges and contribute to client deliverables by refining, analyzing, and structuring relevant data
Awareness of latest technologies and trends
Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge

We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Indore, Nagpur, Mangalore, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Coimbatore, Jaipur, Mysore, Hubli, Vizag.

While we work in accordance with business requirements, we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice, where possible.

Job Title -

Instructional Design Associate Manager

- T&O- (S&C GN)


Management Level:8 Associate Manager


Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai


Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline



Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model


Experience:Minimum 8 to 10 year(s) of experience is required



Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime


Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!


Roles & Responsibilities:
Together with the Functional Manager and Subject Matter Experts, understand the business problem, target audiences, learning needs, and develop learning and change objectives to implement in the proposed learning solution.
Effectively collaborate with the client team to identify the solution approach and design, and work through the design, development, and delivery phases.
Understand the overall learning solution design and create effective training materials that map to the clients business needs.
Support the Functional Manger to develop/identify and take client buy-in on Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) measures for the project (Language Style guide, Guidelines, Checklists, templates, branding guidelines etc.) based on the project requirements.
Conduct Training Need Analysis (TNA) and develop the training curriculum.
Develop high-level and detailed content outlines as per the curriculum.
Design and create standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists for the proposed learning solution.
Develop and review training deliverables as per the agreed upon quality standards and ensure that the deliverable quality is as per the project quality parameters and industry standards.
Provide team members clear and effective feedback based on your reviews with the intent to develop their instructional design skills.
Collaborate with the different internal and client stakeholders to design and develop the relevant and effective training deliverable.
Ensure that the project meets all productivity targets as per the project plans.
Identify and share the risks with the Project Leads/Functional Manager to discuss possible solutions/mitigations/alternatives.
Contribute to users/client organization through the Learning process.
Brief and coach instructional designers and content developers to prepare materials for Instructor Development Workshops, Train the Trainers etc.
Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution.

 Qualification 

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Education- Graduate/Post Graduate preferable with Background in HR/Learning
Professional Background - Desirable - MA/Diploma in Instructional Design or MA in Learning Sciences, MBA
8+ years of proven experience in content development and instructional designing.
Extensive experience in developing, reviewing and delivering different training modalities like Instructor-Led Trainings (ILTs), Web-Based Trainings (WBTs), application simulations, job aids, and quick reference guides.
Experience in working with global teams.
Experience in leading and coaching small teams independently.






Additional Information:

Ability to design, develop and deliver new age learning modalities, such as gamified learning, microlearning, mobile learning would be an added advantage.
In-depth knowledge and experience to identify, select and recommend a variety of training modalities, learning strategies and technologies for a learning solution.
Ability to apply proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning.
Proficient in industry standard design / rapid authoring tools such as Articulate / Captivate / Lectora / Camtasia and SAP Enable Now / WalkMe etc. and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools (The candidate should be aware of the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.)
Exceptional design and writing skills along with strong editing and reviewing skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
Strong analytical skills
Integrated business perspective
Business acumen
Communicate effectively in visual, oral and written form.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Cross cultural competence

Overview
The project management opportunities we have are varied in size and responsibility levels, from delivering our consultancy services, to working for the client organisation delivering their projects and programmes.
You ll have exceptional stakeholder communication and people management skills and thrive on working within a dynamic and diverse project delivery environment.
  Your Role

You must be able to appreciate complex practical, technical, and commercial issues and to work constructively with a broad range of stakeholders; leading project teams that are either local to you or distributed across multiple sites.
The opportunities we have are varied in size and nature, and particularly suit an agile project management style, where the work is particularly discovery in nature. To help us grow the future of our business we are particularly keen to speak to individuals who are building a career as a professional project manager, who are delivery focused, and enjoy being customer focused.
Other aspects of the role will include supporting the growth of our capabilities through building a reputation for excellence, mentoring others, supporting business development and bidding activities.
  About You
You ll have excellent communication, listening, stakeholder management and influencing skills. You ll be able to manage client relationships, engage constructively with multiple stakeholders and lead delivery teams. Through your work you will also help support and shape the development of future business.
You ll enjoy turning your hand to new challenges and will be keen to learn, whilst also wanting to support others within our diverse multi-disciplinary teams. Your experience in working collaboratively with teams spread across multiple geographical locations.
Engineering professional with 20 or more years of experience

Engineering design
Must be an Engineering Professional
Experience of leading and directing teams and resources. Able to motivate self and teams, deal with conflict and create a collaborative team culture to meet client requirements
A strong element of client relationship management and people leadership. Excellent communication skills.
Willingness to travel as necessary.
Willing to work flexibly with occasional out of hours work to accommodate project and client requirements.
Nuclear industry experience. Applications from candidates from other high hazard, or highly regulated industries such as process, Oil and Gas, Defense, and Aerospace would be welcomed.

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impactAre you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clientsAre you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation.

The Practice A Brief Sketch
The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients'' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI & Data and the governance that makes it trustworthy to power every single person and every single process. Define MDM architecture, golden record strategy, entity resolution, and data domain ownership across the enterprise using leading MDM platforms.

Design and implement metadata management, data lineage, data discovery, business glossary, and enterprise data catalog capabilities using platforms such as Collibra and Alation.

An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Strategy & Consulting
Accenture Strategy shapes our clientsfuture, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Qualification

Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role

Shape AI target operating models covering AI Centre of Excellence design, federated vs. centralized ownership, talent and capability model, operating cadence, and cross-functional ways of working across business, data, technology, risk, and legal teams.

Design pragmatic AI governance frameworks that balance innovation, control, and regulatory readiness.

Advise clients on controls for GenAI and traditional AI across data access, prompt and output risk, explainability, transparency, bias and fairness, traceability, and model lifecycle accountability.
Translate emerging regulatory expectations and enterprise risk requirements into actionable governance operating mechanisms, roles, forums, and reporting.

Support the design of data ownership models, governance forums, policy structures, quality controls, and domain-based roles.

Demonstrate consulting-led problem structuring, hypothesis-driven thinking, and the ability to translate ambiguity into actionable recommendations, roadmaps, and investment cases.
Engage confidently with CIO, CTO, CDAO, and business leadership on target state architecture, AI governance, operating model decisions, transformation sequencing, and value realization.
Use strong presentation, storytelling, and facilitation skills to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across business and technology teams.

Budgeting & Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and own proposals response for AI Op Model engagements.

Your Experience Counts!
MBA from a tier 1 institute preferred. 7 10 years of Strategy Consulting experience at a consulting firm. 5+ years of experience on projects showcasing skills across AI operating model design, AI governance and Responsible AI, enterprise operating model design, org design, governance forums, policy and control frameworks, and broader data management exposure including data governance, stewardship, accountability, metadata, data catalog, lineage, and foundational MDM and data quality concepts. Description:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Continuous deployment and delivery using Azure DevOps
Implement the security policy so that the system is secure at operating system, database and application server level (this includes also regular patching of the entire environment 
Configure and implement appropriate Monitoring Tooling using the correct and agreed event alerts
Perform High Availability and Disaster Recovery tests with support from other IT teams
IT Risk & security controls need to be put in place and accurately documented, for this you will need to get familiar and keep up to date with the ING Information Security M Policy
Specify, design, test and deploy the runtime scripts (e.g. stop / start / purge / backup / deploy / rollback)
Implement and work with the latest tooling with a strong focus on performance, stability and security
Perform Change Management activities in order to ensure the safe deliveries from Test, to Acceptance and to Production environment
Required Skills
Advanced knowledge on Windows OS administration, PowerShell and batch scripting
Advanced knowledge on MS SQL Server and Transact-SQL
Advanced knowledge on CI/CD, and experience with Azure DevOps, Git, Maven, Checkmarx, Jenkins, Ansible
Thorough understanding of networks, firewalls and scripting languages (e.g. PowerShell, bash, Python)
Knowledge of monitoring tools (such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, Zabbix)
A customer focus, with the mindset to find and resolve root causes of incidents to structurally improve the customer experience.
IT Operations/Support experience combined with analytical skills to identify root causes in workflows incidents (data, technical, functional). 
Familiarity with tools like ServiceNow, Confluence, Fortify
Experience or affinity with IT Risk (SOx, vulnerability management) and Security concepts (protocols, certificates, etc.)
Preferred Skills
Linux (RedHat Enterprise Linux (7 or 8)) is a plus
Experience with managing full-stack vendor packages, and additionally (low latency) infrastructural stack knowledge
Familiarity with Docker and orchestration for it like Kubernetes or Openshift
Functional knowledge of Financial Markets products – Interest Rates and Fixed Income derivatives

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep expertise in Python, modern web application development, AI-assisted software engineering, cloud-native architecture, and platform engineering.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with consulting capabilities, enabling them to engage directly with business stakeholders, understand complex problems, architect scalable solutions, and deliver production-ready applications. This role requires hands-on experience across frontend, backend, cloud, DevOps, governance frameworks, and emerging AI technologies.

Required Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 6+ years of overall industry experience in software engineering.
Minimum 6+ years of hands-on Python development experience.
Proven experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-grade applications.
Experience working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile development, DevOps, and cloud-native engineering practices.
Experience operating in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments.

Primary Responsibilities
1. Design and Develop Backend Services
Design, build, and maintain FastAPI-based services with comprehensive testing strategies, including unit, integration, and contract testing to ensure production-grade reliability and maintainability.
2. Build AI-Assisted Engineering Solutions
Utilize Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and other approved AI tools as core development accelerators to improve engineering quality, productivity, and delivery speed.
3. Engineer CI/CD and Platform Automation
Build and maintain GitHub Actions-based CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated testing, schema validation, quality gates, security scanning, governance checks, and deployment automation.
4. Develop and Deploy Cloud-Native Applications
Design, containerize, deploy, and support applications using Docker and Azure cloud services, including AKS, Azure Container Apps, and Azure App Service.
5. Build Enterprise Integrations and Governance Services
Develop Python services that integrate with GitHub APIs, JFrog REST APIs, identity systems, governance platforms, and enterprise tooling while enforcing RBAC, approval workflows, and audit requirements.
6. Develop Modern User Interfaces
Design and build intuitive React-based user interfaces, dashboards, and administration portals that provide seamless user experiences and integrate with backend services and enterprise platforms.
7. Build AI Governance and Content Classification Pipelines
Implement automated scanning, classification, governance, and compliance frameworks for AI-generated content, software packages, and engineering artifacts.
8. Own End-to-End Solution Delivery
Lead the complete solution lifecycle from discovery and architecture through development, deployment, adoption, and operational support, ensuring measurable business outcomes

Description:
Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking a CANDU Quality Specialist to support the delivery of world-class nuclear projects across the global CANDU portfolio.
Reporting to Quality function, you will provide independent quality assurance oversight to ensure engineering and project activities are delivered in compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, customer commitments, and the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
You will play a key role in strengthening quality culture, driving compliance, managing quality risks, and ensuring the objective evidence, traceability, and governance required to support safe, reliable, and Right First-Time delivery within a highly regulated nuclear environment.
Your Role
Nuclear Quality Assurance
Support the implementation and continual improvement of the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, project, and management system requirements.
Support the development and execution of project Quality Assurance Plans and quality oversight strategies.
Provide independent quality assurance support across engineering and project delivery activities.
Promote a strong Nuclear Safety Culture and Quality Culture across project teams.
Engineering Quality
Provide quality assurance oversight of design and engineering processes.
Verify compliance with design control, verification, validation, and configuration management requirements.
Support quality reviews and assessments of engineering deliverables and records.
Identify quality risks and drive timely resolution of quality concerns.
Ensure objective evidence is maintained to demonstrate compliance with project and regulatory requirements.
Audit, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Conduct audits, surveillances, and compliance assessments.
Support customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections.
Manage quality findings, non-conformances, and corrective actions through to effective closure.
Facilitate root cause analysis and lessons learned activities.
Analyse quality trends and identify opportunities to improve performance and reduce risk.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide quality guidance and coaching to project teams and stakeholders.
Communicate quality performance, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to management.
About You
The successful candidate will demonstrate uncompromising integrity, a strong commitment to Nuclear Safety Culture, and the confidence to provide objective and independent quality assurance oversight, even when faced with challenging project pressures.
They will possess exceptional attention to detail, a questioning attitude, and the professional judgement required to identify quality risks, challenge assumptions, and ensure compliance with nuclear quality requirements.
The individual will be highly analytical, disciplined, and evidence-driven, with a passion for delivering quality outcomes through rigorous verification, traceability, and continual improvement.
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills are essential, enabling them to build trusted relationships with engineering, project, supply chain, and quality teams while promoting accountability, learning, and Right First-Time delivery.
Above all, they will be recognised as a dependable quality professional who upholds the highest standards of safety, compliance, and technical excellence in support of global CANDU nuclear projects.
Essential Qualifications and Experience
Degree in Engineering and Quality Management
Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Nuclear Quality, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience implementing and maintaining Quality Management Systems and Quality Assurance Programs.
Experience conducting audits, assessments, supplier oversight, or compliance activities.
Experience managing non-conformances, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Essential Technical Knowledge
Working knowledge of
CSA N299 Series
CSA N286
ASME NQA-1
ISO 9001 and ISO 19443
Nuclear Safety Culture principles
Supplier Quality Assurance
Audit and Surveillance Techniques
Design Control and Verification
Configuration Management
Quality Records and Traceability
Non-Conformance and Corrective Action Management
Working knowledge of Hexagon, AVEVA Smart 3D / E3D, and Siemens NX and domain knowledge of nuclear sector
Desirable
CQI/IRCA Lead Auditor qualification.
ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent.
Experience supporting CANDU, nuclear new build, refurbishment, or life extension projects.
Experience as a QA Specialist, QA Engineer, PQAR, CQAR, or equivalent quality role.
Lean Six Sigma certification.
Experience with digital quality management and reporting tools.
Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team supporting Middle East projects based out of India
The role will provide economic, demographic and real estate market analysis to support development advisory, urban planning, master planning and infrastructure planning assignments. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including:
Land-use and development demand; Real estate asset mix and scale; Housing and employment requirements; Social infrastructure needs; Development capacity and absorption; Development and infrastructure phasing; and Investment priorities.
The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors.

Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border services, B2B & B2C warehousing, and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which include large and small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises and brands.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. Drive reduction in partner churn and ensure a stable, reliable delivery network.

3. Process & Compliance Ensure all partners adhere to Delhivery’s operational and safety guidelines. Maintain updated documentation and records for all partner interactions and activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely onboarding, training, and policy awareness among partners.

4. Data Analysis & Reporting Track and analyze partner satisfaction, retention rates, and performance metrics.

Prepare regular dashboards and insights to identify trends and areas for improvement.

Recommend data-driven interventions to improve partner experience and operational outcomes.

Key Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or a related field (MBA preferred).

3–6 years of experience in on-ground partner management, fleet engagement, or delivery operations, preferably in logistics, e-commerce, or mobility sectors.

Strong people management and relationship-building skills. Ability to analyze data and drive actionable insights.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to travel locally and work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
Job Description
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.
The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.
The position is Full-time with the opportunity for hybrid home/office working.
The Role:
The role will include:
Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations relevant reports.
Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.
Core Skills:
Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
LEED Accredited Professional
6-12 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using IES-VE software are advantageous.
Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results
Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases
Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, InDesign, AutoCAD, Rhino and Grasshopper.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Desirable but not essential
Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, SketchUp, and Rhino
Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms
LEED Commissioning: Experience with design stage commissioning preferably with LEED with relevant professional credentials
What We Offer:
Varied, interesting, and meaningful work.
A hybrid working environment with flexibility and opportunities for growth.
Access to training, with career progression or lateral moves as the team expands.
The chance to work with a large, global, multidisciplinary consultancy on a mission to transform business practices.
Meeting Your Needs:
We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer a 'Total Reward' package to help you thrive both in and out of the office. If you identify as having a disability, please inform us before your interview, and we will discuss any necessary adjustments.
Additional Information:
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive community where everyone can thrive. From day one, we offer family-friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and support networks for employees from all backgrounds. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we welcome applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy Grid Integration (HVDC) offers an exciting opportunity to work with advanced High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) and High Voltage Alternating Current (HVAC) technologies. You will be part of the Services team, supporting the installed base of HVDC systems by ensuring reliable operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and customer satisfaction while contributing to the long-term performance and availability of critical power infrastructure.
How You'll Make an Impact
Demonstrate a strong commitment to Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards, policies, and guidelines.
Serve as the primary customer interface for the HVDC installed base and maintain strong customer relationships.
Perform troubleshooting and restoration activities for HVDC systems and equipment during failures or outages, in coordination with technical experts.
Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities for HVDC and HVAC equipment.
Monitor installed HVDC assets using Asset Management tools, including performance monitoring and inventory control.
Coordinate with internal teams, customers, vendors, and OEMs to ensure fulfillment of warranty obligations and service requirements.
Manage replacement, installation, and commissioning activities related to failed HVDC/HVAC equipment.
Support Service Project Managers by providing reports, technical inputs, and updates related to warranty, reliability, availability, and Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSA).
Prepare and maintain site documentation, including Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and service reports.
Review technical drawings, engineering documents, protection schemes, and operating procedures to support maintenance and fault resolution.
Participate in outage management, fault investigations, emergency response activities, and root cause analysis.
Ensure timely communication and coordination with technical support teams during critical service events.
Travel domestically and internationally to support customer sites and project requirements.
Uphold Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, teamwork, and customer focus.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your Background
Education Experience
Diploma or bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
Additional certifications or training in HVDC, substation systems, control protection, or power system maintenance will be considered an advantage.
5 Years of experience in HVDC/HVAC systems, substations, power transmission, grid integration, or power system maintenance.
Hands-on experience in troubleshooting, maintenance, and operation of electrical equipment in utility, transmission, or industrial environments.
Experience in customer-facing service roles and managing technical support activities.
Exposure to outage management, fault diagnosis, equipment replacement, and commissioning activities.
Experience working with warranty management, LTSA contracts, reliability, and availability monitoring is preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively and work in demanding operational environments.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Job Description


Overview
AtkinsRalis is one of the world's most respected design, engineering and project management consultancies, with a proven track record of more than 75 years of relevant experience in the industry. AtkinsRalis is a leading provider of consultancy services in the field of master planning, economics and sustainability; architecture environmental management; landscape urban design; infrastructure planning; and engineering and transportation analysis, offering professional advice, engineering and environmental consultancy and design solutions.
As a provider of multi-disciplinary technical design services to the built environment, AtkinsRalis India is committed to design excellence in the delivery of first-class solutions which combine innovation, imagination and best practice.


Your Role
Roles Responsibilities
A sound understanding of electrical engineering principles and their application in Water, Wastewater Treatment plant and pumping stations.
Experience in the production of design documentations including optioneering reports, data sheets, calculations, and specifications of electrical equipment.
Undertake Electrical design to local and international standards, preferably for UK region.
Understand and apply BS/NEC/NFPA/IEC/International standards.
Undertake design of a variety of electrical design elements i.e., MV LV Distribution, Grounding, Lighting design (internal and external), Cable management, Sizing, Fire Alarm Protection Detection system.
Electrical Equipment calculations, Cable and cable tray sizing calculations, grounding calculation, lighting calculation (using Dialux EVO, AGI32), Lightening assessment etc.
A competent user of IT tools in particular Word, Excel, Outlook and Electrical design tools e.g., AMTECH, ETAP, SKM. Dialux Evo, AGI32, Specsizer etc
Liaison with clients (Lead Project Offices), developing and maintaining relationships.
Responsible for completion of projects within his/her team to time, cost and quality.
Should be able to present design solutions to the client requirement.
Check/review electrical drawings and designs deliverables.
Coordinate with other disciplines and improve inter-discipline working with other disciplines such as Mechanical, Architecture, Civil and Structural.
Should have knowledge of 3D Models for check review of Navis works.
Demonstrate ability to cultivate and lead a cohesive team, fostering individual growth and collaboration withing the organization framework.


About You
Qualifications Skills
Master/Bachelor's Degree in Electrical engineering;
Previous electrical engineering or design role experience within consultancy.
Relevant and appropriate experience of more than 14+ years in Water Wastewater Treatment plant and Pumping stations.
Experience of working in Multi-D environment and good understanding of co-ordination and interfaces with other disciplines.
Able to independently deliver work and integrate with larger project teams.
Good report writing skills, experience of making presentations to and attending meetings with clients is essential.
Positive and enthusiastic, a confident communicator at all levels, and a collaborator.
Resilient, can work under pressure, doesn't show frustration, and lose composure when facing resistance.
Mandatory Requirements
Relevant and appropriate experience within Water, wastewater treatment plant and pumping station.
Competent designer UK, International codes and standards.
Knowledge of tools such as AMTECH, DIALUX EVO etc.
Review model using Navis tool.
Should have working knowledge of common data environment (CDE) like BIM360, ProjectWise etc.
Manage quality of deliverables of yours as well as the team members.
Maintains harmony and a productive atmosphere by being open about the work activities and project status.
An effective communicator both written and verbal.
People manager and should be able to develop electrical engineers.

Be at the forefront of strategic transport planning and modelling. As a Senior Transport Planner, you will help deliver transformational projects worldwide, from strategic model development and local plan assessments to supporting major development and master planning initiatives, enabling sustainable and future-ready transport networks.
Your role

About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:Accenture Strategy & Consulting enables our clients to embrace the change and shape their future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture S&Cs services include those provided by our Capability Network a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. Be part of a highly specialized team including top notch professionals from leading business schools coupled with experience in working with global industry leaders. Grow your career and experience a stimulating, fast-paced environment working with prestigious clients on diverse projects to solve significant business challenges. You will deliver lasting impact as you work alongside the extremely skilled team, combining overseas client-site work with opportunities based locally, and contribute to high performance through continuous collaboration and knowledge sharing. Practice Overview:Capability Network CFO & Enterprise Value (CFO & EV) team supports CFOs / Finance organizations to craft and implement strategies anchored on digital disruption, new age operating models, best in class practices to drive market differentiation and creating value. We take pride in performing End to End Transformations, delivering tangible results and outcomes for our client on back of path breaking thought leadership, deep CXO relationships, digital investments & assets and collaborating with our other Accenture businesses like Technology and Operations. CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. Digital Finance Transformation Transform the core finance function from strategic vision through value realization, into a more efficient and effective capability and operating model, enabled by intelligent automation (RPA through AI), data and analytics strategies, and new ways of working. o Tax Transformation includes tax function assessment and process transformation, tax operating model transformation, automation of tax systems and end to end tax transformation. o Treasury & Working Capital Management includes treasury management and operating model, total working capital assessment, treasury and working capital technology solutions and digital innovation. Enterprise Planning & Analysis Developed integrated, cloud enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions. Digital Risk and Compliance - Actively engage with clients to prepare and protect their enterprise in an increasingly volatile world, enabling business outcomes over the short, medium, and long term. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation. Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year. About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design Specialist

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:9- Specialist

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 6-8 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Consultant in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Collaborate with the client team to understand the business problem, identify the solution approach and work through the design, development, and delivery phases.
Conduct Training Needs Analysis to develop the training curriculum.
Develop high-quality and detailed content outlines as per the curriculum.
Design standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists for the proposed learning solution.
Collaborate with internal and client stakeholders to design and develop relevant and effective training deliverables.
Review training deliverables to ensure that the deliverable quality is as per the project quality parameters and industry standards.
Identify and share the risks with the Project Leads/Functional Manager to discuss possible solutions/mitigations/alternatives.
Coach instructional designers and content developers to prepare materials for instructor development workshops.
Provide clear and effective feedback to team with the intent to develop their instructional design skills.
Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution.
Leverage proficiency in instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, content design, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Apply your strong knowledge in industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.

Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:6+years of proven experience in content development and instructional designing
Extensive experience in developing, reviewing and delivering different training modalities like Instructor-Led Trainings, Web-Based Trainings, application simulations, job aids, and quick reference guides
Experience in leading and coaching small teams independently



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

4+ years of software engineering experience

Familiarity with AI/ML-powered forecasting techniques - predictive analytics, anomaly detection, scenario modelling, and rolling forecast automation; exposure to tools such as Azure ML, Amazon Forecast, or embedded AI capabilities within EPM platforms

AI-Ready Process Analysis: Analyse FP&A workflows to identify automation and AI intervention opportunities
Python (must have): write clean functional scripts for data extraction, transformation, API calls, and workflow automation tasks; independently run and debug scripts within Finance transformation contexts
SQL (must have): Query Finance datasets from ERP / data warehouse environments; perform joins, aggregations, and sub-queries to extract operational insights supporting process assessments

Solution Documentation & Delivery Contribution: prepare workshop materials, process deliverables, status reports, and presentation decks; contribute to business case quantification

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Are you passionate about scaling businesses using in-depth frameworks and techniques to solve customer facing challenges? Do you want to design, build and implement strategies to enhance business performance? Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest?

Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities within Accentures Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song practice.

The Life Sciences Marketing Senior Manager position is within the Marketing Transformation vertical of Accenture GN Song. The individual would work at the heart of the top global Life Sciences (Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology and Medical Technology) and would collaborate on innovative projects while bringing in deep industry knowledge and Marketing skills.

The key responsibilities will include

Strong project management skills to plan, execute, and deliver content initiatives successfully. This includes managing timelines, budgets, resources, and coordinating cross-functional teams. An analytical & data driven mindset to drive result-oriented decisions

Exposure and experience in roles across the marketing value chain, primarily in the life sciences or allied industries as detailed out below.

Consulting & Advisory service

Market Research

Analysis and assessment of the pharmaceutical market across disease areas and opportunity identification for new launches, indication expansions , identify emerging trends, competitive landscapes, and new opportunities within the life sciences sector .

Job Information
Job Title

Business Development Partner (Commission Based)

Automobile Agencies / Showrooms / Garage
Salon / Beauticians / Boutique
Theme Parks / Theatres / Public Entertainment set ups
Professional Services Astrologers / Doctors / Veterinarians / Chartered Accountants / etc.
And other businesses within your city / nearby locations.
Job Purpose
Business Development and “New Market” & “Emerging Market” Business Development and Client Acquisition.
Generate Business through networking with Business Heads / Business Owners.
This is strictly a “Commission Based” association only and not a fixed salaried job. Please do study the key terms of association below.
Anyone who can contribute parallely with his current assignment or through part time or is a Home Based Entrepreneur.
Desired Exposure: Should have a strong network / association with local businesses.
Main Accountabilities
Role Requisites
Business Development

Generating business by coordinating with local business connects.
Cross selling services offered by “Udbhabana Business Solutions”, focus shall be on Business development of “Udbhabana Digytech Solutions”, though.
Brand Positioning

Position brand “Udbhabana Digytech Solutions” in the domain of expertise and generate brand awareness within the local and adjoining cities / territories.
Brand Value Preposition through customized Digytech solutions and position “Udbhabana Digytech Solutions” as one of the prominent business partners.
Key Points of Association
Rule of Association

This is a “Commission Based Assignment”.
Incumbent shall be responsible for Business Development and Client Acquisition with Udbhabana Business Solutions.
Incumbent shall receive a 100 percent payout within 72 banking hours upon receipt of 100 percent payment from the client, after statutory deductions if any, through bank transfer only.
Recurring Commissions

Recurring commissions are projects where Udbhabana Business Solutions are associated on a monthly delivery model and here the incumbent shall receive the said recurring commission every month, post payment by the client.
Statutes shall be applicable as per law.
One-Time Commissions

One time projects are projects where Udbhabana Business Solutions are associated for one specific project or task, and here the incumbent shall receive the said recurring commission every month, post payment by the client.
Statutes shall be applicable as per law.
Payout Timelines

Payouts shall be through bank transfers only, or as discussed during joining, and shall attract TDS or any form of mandatory local statutes.
Payout shall be released within 72 banking hours after the receipt of 100 percent payment from the client.
Desired Professional Attributes:
Incumbents with atleast one year of Business Development of any IT based service, however not a compulsion though.
Must have a great networking connect with local businesses.
Should be smart to understand the local businesses challenges and advise Digital Marketing and Tech solutions, as appropriate.
Udbhabana Business Solutions Offerings:
Please note that this commission-based role is for Digital Marketing Services from Udbhabana Business Solutions, however incumbents must be aware of the bouquet of services offered by Udbhabana Business Solutions, and if the incumbent makes a cross selling for any of the following services, besides Digital Marketing, then the incumbent has the potential to earn commissions as per the table mentioned below:

Services

Payouts

Digital Marketing.
E Commerce Platforms.
Create and Manage Websites.
Web & Mobile based App development & management.

(TDS / Taxes or compliance as applicable during disbursement shall be deducted, as per statutes)

Potential good performers will be given an option / invitation, to associate with us, with the same Variable Commissions and a fixed monthly salary component, after six months of successful and good performing association.
This opportunity is valid for Business Development association and related commissions within India only, if an incumbent generates overseas or international business, for which commissions will be discussed and finalized, case-to-case.

Job Description Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Engineer
Experience: 3 Years
Job Title: GCP Data Engineer
Work Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled GCP Cloud Engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and automation. The ideal candidate should have experience in managing cloud environments and supporting scalable, secure, and reliable cloud solutions.
Required Skills & Responsibilities
3 years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Good knowledge of GCP services such as:
Compute Engine (GCE)
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
Cloud Storage (GCS)
BigQuery
Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
Cloud SQL
Experience with IAM, service accounts, roles, and permissions.
Good understanding of VPC, subnets, firewall rules, and networking.
Experience in deploying and managing applications on GCP.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, or Cloud Build.
Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Knowledge of cloud monitoring and logging using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
Understanding of cloud security, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good to Have
Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification.
Knowledge of Python or Shell scripting.
Exposure to DevOps practices and automation.
Understanding of AWS or Azure cloud platforms.
Candidate Expectations
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead

With an immense amount of expertise and credibility, Shoppers' Stop has become the highest benchmark for the Indian retail industry. In fact, the company's continious expansion plans aim to help Shoppers' Stop meet the challenges of the retail industry in an even better manner than it does today.
