Description:
As the original house of luxury, St.
Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service.
At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury.
It is high-touch, personalized, creative and original.
It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
The Senior Butler oversees the functioning and delivery of butler services.
You verify that there is a seamless approach to the pre-arrival, guest stay and at departure through St.
Regis brand standards.
You supervise the work of the Butler team - comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets - and drive strong coordination with other departments.
Responsibilities also include people management tasks including interviewing and hiring Butler team members and creating schedules to ensure optimal staffing levels.
While the St.
Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service.
The Senior Butler s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, the ability to anticipate needs and impeccable interpersonal skills.
You will also be expected to create a safe workplace, follow company policies and procedures, uphold quality standards, and ensure your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Butler team members will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Butler team members - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
REQUIRE QUALIFICATIONS
Related Work Experience: 1 year related work experience required.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Social Media Executive to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.A Social Media Executive is responsible for planning, executing, and managing social media campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This role involves developing and maintaining a strong online presence for a company across multiple social media platforms, creating engaging content, and analyzing the success of social media efforts.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
2. Create and publish engaging and relevant content for multiple social media platforms, including but not limited to, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
3. Manage and grow the company's social media presence, including daily monitoring and responding to comments, messages, and reviews.
4. Analyze and report on the success of social media campaigns, using metrics such as likes, shares, comments, and reach to continually improve and refine strategies.
5. Manage and maintain the company's social media calendar, ensuring that content is planned and scheduled in advance.
Requirements:
1. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and engaging content.
2. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
3. A creative and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to continuously improve social media strategies.
4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
5. A strong understanding of brand messaging, tone, and voice, and the ability to consistently maintain a cohesive brand image across all social media channels.

Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Description:
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

Location:
Manipur, India
Qualification:
Diploma or BE in EEE/ECE

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Experience: Opportunity for 5- 8 YRS Experience Assisnant mechanical Engineer from Construction Background
Our Industry: Construction/ Heavy Civil Infrastructure

Onycon Infrastructure is Urgently Hiring 5- 8 YRS Experience Assistant Mechanical Engineer from Construction Background

Manage the operation, maintenance, and repair of heavy construction equipment and machinery at the project site.

4)Co-ordination:
Coordinate with site teams for machinery availability and operational requirements.Coordinate with vendors and service providers for repairs, spare parts, and technical support.

5)Supervision and Team Handling:
Supervise mechanics, technicians, operators, and equipment maintenance activities.Monitor equipment performance, maintenance costs, spare parts inventory, and service schedules.

6)Procedures:
Ensure compliance with equipment safety standards and maintenance procedures.Ensure optimum utilization and availability of plant and machinery for railway tunnel construction activities.

8)Documentation:
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly equipment performance and maintenance reports.

Requirements:
5-8 YRS of Experience in Repair & Maintainence of Euipment from a construction background.
Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical Engineer, Diploma / B.E. in Automobile Engineering.
Hands-on experience with heavy construction equipment, maintenance planning, troubleshooting, and equipment management.
Knowledge of preventive maintenance, spare parts.
Strong coordination, team management, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work at the Manipur project site.

Education
UG: Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical Engineer, Diploma / B.E. in Automobile Engineering

Administration Manager (Corporate)
Oversees daily office operations, facility management, vendor contracts, budgets, and administrative staff to ensure seamless business continuity.
Core Responsibilities
Office & Facility Management:
F Oversee corporate workspace allocation, building maintenance, housekeeping, utilities, security systems, and meeting room infrastructure.
F Maintain a high-end, agile office environment, optimizing hot-desking/hoteling arrangements, collaborative breakout areas, and state-of-the-art virtual meeting spaces.
Vendor & Procurement Management:
F Negotiate vendor contracts (security, travel, catering, maintenance, high-end office suppliers, facilities engineering), while tracking operational spend against strict corporate budgets. Monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and manage office supply inventory.
Budget & Cost Control:
F Prepare and manage departmental operating budgets, track expenses, and identify cost-saving efficiencies.
Travel & Event Logistics:
F Oversee seamless, high-touch support for senior partners and visiting clients, including boardroom hospitality, local fine-dining coordination, and rapid response requests.
F Coordinate end-to-end logistics for high-profile client workshops, corporate retreats, case study events, and internal networking seminars.
F Supervise the travel desk handling highly fluid, last-minute global itineraries, visa processing, premium hotel partnerships, and corporate card reconciliations.
Compliance & Policy Execution:
F Enforce internal corporate policies, health and safety regulations, fire safety drills, and statutory/legal compliance.
Management Information Systems (MIS) & Reporting:
F Maintain digital/physical record systems, asset registers, and generate regular operational reports for senior leadership.
Confidentiality & Information Security:
F Enforce strict physical data protection protocols (e.g., clean-desk policies, secure disposal, guest access controls) to safeguard sensitive client project data.
Team Supervision:
F Hire, train, schedule, and evaluate administrative support staff, receptionists, and facilities coordinators.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business administration, Management, or a related field with 8 to 10 years of corporate administrative or facilities management experience with a strong preference for backgrounds in premium professional services (Consulting, Big 4, Legal) or 5-star hospitality corporate desks.
2. Strong command of MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and workplace management or ERP/MIS tools.
3. Strong leadership and people management.
4. Vendor negotiation and contract lifecycle management.
5. Problem-solving under pressure and crisis management.
6. Flawless executive communication and stakeholder management.
7. Extreme discretion, emotional intelligence, and professional etiquette.
8. Agility to handle fast-changing schedules and urgent, last-minute requests.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 2-5 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5-9 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Job Description
Overview
As Wastewater Modeller, you will be working on diverse range of sewerage related projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment through a range of public and private sector clients.
Your role
Perform a role bringing together hydraulic modelling (1D-2D) and engineering aspects of the project. You will have to understand the engineering constraints and opportunities associated with modelling solutions to drainage problems to ensure model outputs are realistic.
Undertake technical work including hydraulic modelling like model build (1D - 2D), model verification, evaluation, feasibility, optioneering and outline design of solutions.
Understand the client requirements and deliver the work in smarter way by developing some automation tools along with high quality.
Demonstrate high standards deliverables by adopting various self-check methods and documentations.
Assist with project management and take a proactive approach to managing client relationships, clarifying expectations and outcome measures in order to meet their requirements and deliver successful projects.
Support wider business lines and develop and strengthen internal team.
About you
Has a Bachelor or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Water Resources or Environmental engineering or Geology or Geography.
10+ years of experience in hydraulic design or modelling.
Working towards achieving chartership with appropriate institution (i.e. ICE, CIWEM).
Good working knowledge or experience of Infowork ICM, Mapinfo, QGIS, Sewer Gems, HEC-RAS, MicroDrainage or similar.
A strong, self-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
Good communication writing skills.
Flexible to adopt new work /challenge work as per business requirement.

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
Job Description- Territory Sales and Clinical Lead

About us

SigTuple builds intelligent screening solutions to aid diagnosis through AI-powered analysis of visual medical data from human and animal samples. Its flagship AI100 product is an in vitro diagnostic device that automates manual microscopy using robotics and AI, enabling biological samples on glass slides to be digitized for AI-aided remote reporting and analysis. Along the same lines, SigTuple is building a Point-of-Care (POC) screening device for veterinary use, expanding its technology and diagnostic solutions into the animal health space

As a Territory Sales and Clinical Lead,you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening SigTuplespresence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, and distributors. Your role will focus on building a strong customer base, key opinion leader relationships, executing sales cycle from lead generation till closure and post sales support.,

Responsibilities:
Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote SigTuple products and generate profitable sales.
Maintain a healthy pipeline and conduct demonstrations to close the sales as per targets assigned.
Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.
Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
Qualification & Experience:
0-2 years
Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Science/ Science /Nursing/Biomedical /Diagnostics Medical Technician
Master's in related fields will be a plus.
Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory-based role.
Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge:
Strong understanding of the animal health market,
Experience working with clinics, hospitals & distributors.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.
Location:
Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad, Delhi, and Bangalore. Based in the city / should be a local permanent resident having full exposure to the territory field-based role covering an assigned sales territory.
AboutCompany: SigTuple combines AI, robotics, microfluidics, and high-resolution microscopy to automate microscopic analysis of biological samples — across human and veterinary diagnostics.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Description:
Job Title: Embedded UI Software Engineer
Experience: 4-9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++, LVGL, TouchGFX, or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU, or similar frameworks.
Develop UI applications for LCD/TFT touch displays on embedded platforms.
Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).
Develop and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.
Mandatory Skills
4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks.
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP).
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development.
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

About Us
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company and a pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution. Paytm builds technologies that empower small businesses with payments and commerce solutions.
Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer a world-class, frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups, including well-known unicorns. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler to a driver of revenue and growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI, and this team is responsible for growing penetration of Paytms PA–PG business across Indian merchants.

About the Role
Handle merchant escalations and resolve them on a high-priority basis. Proactively assist merchants to ensure timely and effective resolution of issues. Deliver exceptional merchant satisfaction through ownership and accountability of cases.

Key Responsibilities / Expectations
Resolve merchant complaints received through RBI, nodal officers, social media channels, or senior management escalations.
Understand the nature of each query, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and ensure resolution within defined TATs.
Prepare Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for escalations received.
Ensure adherence to agreed turnaround times to meet productivity and quality benchmarks.
Maintain high CSAT scores and ensure no repeat escalations for handled cases.
Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

Description:
Manager / Senior Manager - Sales
Location: Delhi / NCR, Gurgaon, Noida, Bangalore About the Role:
As a Sales professional, you will play a critical role in driving the growth of our organization. You will be responsible for promoting and selling our range of services to prospective clients. Your expertise in building strong relationships, identifying customer needs, and meeting sales targets will be instrumental to our success.
Key Responsibilities:
Execute the overall sales strategy by effectively leveraging our service offerings and value proposition to target potential clients.
Conduct strategic account planning based on market insights and existing client data.
Proactively identify and reach out to prospective clients through various channels (cold calling, networking, in-person meetings, etc.) to generate new leads.
Lead and support the bid process, including proposal development, commercial finalization, negotiation, and contract closure.
Adhere to the defined sales process and utilize appropriate sales tools for managing daily activities.
Take ownership to ensure that new sales targets, both in volume and revenue, are consistently achieved.
Maintain accurate reporting on pipeline, opportunities, and closures.
Key Competencies:
Proven experience in sales or business development, preferably in the private security services or allied sectors.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to establish and maintain relationships with clients, partners, and internal teams.
Strong negotiation capabilities, with a track record of successfully closing high-value deals.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills, capable of managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
Self-motivated, fast learner with a passion for sales and a proactive approach to achieving goals.

Job Title Client Account Lead Manager

Management Level: 07 - Manager

Location: Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad

Must have skills: Proven track record in sales origination and deal structuring within Communication, Media & Technology industries, Consultative selling expertise

Good to have skills: Stakeholder management with P&L responsibility, Domestic consulting experience is mandatory

Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of sales experience for Communication, Media, software and platforms, Hi Tech focused companies as clients.

Educational Qualification: Masters degree in business administration (MBA) or post graduate degree in management (PGDM)

Job summary
As a Client Account Lead, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, revenue expansion, and client value creation in the domestic India market. This role demands a strong ability to originate and structure deals, build long-term trust with C-suite executives, and position Accenture as a strategic partner for transformation and innovation. You will identify and pursue new opportunities, originate deals, and expand relationships with existing clients in telecom, media, and technology sectors.

Key Responsibilities
Originate and pursue new business opportunities with existing and potential clients in telecom, media, and Software Platforms, Hi Tech \ semiconductor sectors.

Develop compelling proposals and sales presentations, clearly articulating Accentures value proposition and ROI for client operations. Candidate should be able to own clients, drive revenue, and deliver engagements

Build and sustain C-suite relationships, positioning Accenture as a trusted advisor for transformation and innovation agendas.
Drive account growth and profitability, with full ownership of sales targets.
Construct innovative deal solutions, leveraging Accentures consulting and technology capabilities to differentiate in the market.
Ensure robust delivery and consulting for seamless execution of client engagements and maximize client satisfaction.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Proven track record in sales and account management (10+ years), with demonstrated success in revenue growth and deal origination.
Strong C-suite relationship management, with ability to influence executive decision-making and drive strategic partnerships.
Consulting and IT services sales expertise, preferably with domestic consulting experience in the India market across any Telecom, Media, Hi Tech, Software Platforms organisation.
Commercial acumen with experience in P&L management, deal structuring, and innovative commercial pathways.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, enabling persuasive client engagement and closing complex deals.
Leadership and team management skills, with ability to inspire, guide, and deliver results through high-performing teams.

Whats in-store for you

Learn and grow continuously: Build new skills, grow existing skills, develop new areas of expertise within functional, technical or industry areas of the business with Accentures unmatched 24/7 expert-curated learning boards, webinars and classroom-style training programs

Innovate: Get access to resources that will allow you to leverage the latest technologies and bring innovation to life with the worlds most recognizable companies - Thrive and advance: Grow your career as far as your ambitions take you.

Truly human: Bring your whole self to a company that aims to be the most diverse in the world and delivers real-time performance feedback based on your strengths, not stats



Qualification

Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of sales experience for Communication, Media, software and platforms, Hi Tech focused companies as clients.

Educational Qualification: Masters degree in business administration (MBA) or post graduate degree in management (PGDM)

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
We are seeking a talented and motivated Backend Developer with 3-5 years of experience to join our engineering team. You will play a key role in building and maintaining robust backend services that power our applications. This position requires a developer with strong experience in Golang and Python , along with hands-on knowledge of cloud infrastructure , containerization , and databases .

Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go (Golang) and Python .
Build and manage RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for efficient data storage and caching.
Develop and deploy applications in Docker containers using Kubernetes for orchestration.
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy and monitor applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high code quality and system reliability.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape backend system design.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for backend services.
Troubleshoot and resolve performance and scalability issues.
undefined

Qualifications:
3-5 years of backend development experience.
Proficiency in Golang and Python .
Strong understanding of PostgreSQL and Redis .
Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for orchestration.
Proficiency with AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, IAM).
Understanding of RESTful API design principles.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices.
Good problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile team environment.

Preferred Qualifications
B.E/BTech. degree in Computer Science, similar technical discipline or equivalent practical experience

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain
Existing responsibilities plus:
Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
Establish robust governance for:
BOM
Material master
Routings
Lead times
Planning parameters
Purchase orders
Production orders
Inventory records
Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity
Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.

9. Continuous Improvement
Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
Improve:
Planning accuracy
Inventory turns
Supplier OTD
Material availability
Production plan adherence
Lead time
OTIF
Supply Chain cost
Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.

10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs.
Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases.
Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness.
Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable.

Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption

Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

Experience : 10 19 yrs
Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days.
Location : Pune

Role Summary
The Program Manager will lead a high impact marketplace platform program for a large enterprise client in a delivery focused client facing role This role involves end to end program management strategic leadership and stakeholder management to ensure the programs objectives are met on time within budget and to the required quality and scope The Program Manager is accountable for planning executing and governing multiple project workstreams aligning project outcomes with the clients business goals and marketplace platform strategy
This position demands strong leadership communication and organizational skills to coordinate cross functional teams and deliver a successful marketplace program that achieves the desired business outcomes
Key Responsibilities
The Program Manager will have full ownership of program delivery and governance Key responsibilities include
Program Planning Execution Develop a comprehensive program plan and schedule based on client needs establishing a scope budget and timeline baseline Oversee daytoday program execution including Multi project coordination resource planning and change management to keep all workstreams aligned with program goals
Delivery Management Drive the program to completion on time within budget and to scope Monitor progress across all projects implement rigorous milestone tracking and budget control and proactively manage variances to ensure the program stays on track and in control.
Risk Issue Management Anticipate potential risks and issues across projects Establish a structured risk and issue management process identify assess and mitigate risks promptly and effectively7 Develop actionable contingency plans to address project challenges and ensure minimal impact on timelines or deliverables
Stakeholder Communication Interface regularly with client and internal stakeholders at all levels providing clear updates on program status risks and achievements8 Prepare and deliver executive level reports to communicate progress and ensure stakeholder alignment Serve as the primary point of contact for program related communications managing expectations and facilitating issue escalation and resolution.
Quality Governance Enforce program governance processes and quality standards throughout the program lifecycle10 Conduct stage gate reviews and quality assurance checkpoints to ensure deliverables meet enterprise standards and contract requirements Maintain rigorous adherence to project management methodologies and client's compliance guidelines
Team Leadership Coordination Lead cross functional teams including project managers and technical leads in a matrix environment to ensure cohesive execution11 Foster collaboration among engineering product operations and other functional teams to meet integrated program milestones Provide mentorship and clear direction to project teams aligning their activities with the program's strategic objectives
Business Alignment Ensure the marketplace platforms development and deliverables align with the client's business objectives and marketplace strategy12 Collaborate with product owners' architects and business analysts to incorporate marketplace best practices and requirements into the program Support development of business cases and ensure the program delivers expected business value and ROI
Education Bachelors degree in Computer Science Engineering Business Management or a related field advanced degree preferred Professional ProjectProgram Management Certification eg PMP PRINCE2 PgMP is highly desired

Domain Knowledge Familiarity with digital marketplaces ecommerce platforms or largescale platform implementation projects Demonstrated ability to quickly understand complex platform architectures and business models
