Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Description:
Gen AI | Infosys | 2-5yrs | Pan India

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Job Description


Overview
Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.
Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


Requirements
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Resources/Environment/Water Management/Hydrology, with 2 to 4 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in any WQ modelling using SWMM, WASP, SWAT, Qual2k, RIOT, HEWRAT, MIKE, SAGIS-SIMCAT, Infoworks ICM.
Strong Data and Statistical analysis skills using Excel, R, SPSS, PowerBI etc.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the Water Quality studies/ Assessments.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall WQ parameters and treatment processes.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits

This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.


About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Worker Type Employee
Job Type Regular
At AtkinsRalis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Area

We are recruiting Academic Associates across the following Areas:
Decision Sciences, Operations Management and Information System
Economics & Public Policy Area
Finance, Accounting and Control
General Management
Marketing Management
Organization Behaviour and Human Resource Management
Strategic Management, Entrepreneurship and International Business

The Academic Environment
Embedded within a multidisciplinary, research focused and student centric Institution of Eminence (IoE), our academic areas play a pivotal role in shaping curricula, mentoring diverse student cohorts, and contributing to scholarly and professional communities worldwide.

The Opportunity
We invite applications from dynamic and committed Academic Associates who are eager to shape the next generation of professionals and thought leaders. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing institution with global aspirations, a strong faculty community, and a deeply student centred ethos.
As an academic associate, you will:
Assist in course delivery, including lectures, tutorials, and lab sessions.
Support in preparing teaching materials, grading assignments, and managing course logistics.
Conduct discussion sessions, clarify student queries, and hold office hours.
Help maintain academic integrity and ensure smooth functioning of course assessments.
Coordinate with faculty for research and administrative support, as needed.

Qualifications & Profile
We seek colleagues who combine academic rigor, pedagogical commitment, and intellectual curiosity. We are looking for individuals with an MBA, M.Com, or Masters (Regular degree) in a relevant discipline (as per areas mentioned above) who demonstrate:

Strong MS Excel (basic) and analytical skills.
Prior teaching or mentoring experience (preferred, not mandatory).
Familiarity with relevant databases and software, as well as learning management systems (Blackboard, Moodle, etc.) is a plus.
A genuine passion for learning and mentoring, particularly at the undergraduate level.
A proven enthusiasm for guiding undergraduate students and an active research agenda are desirable.

We encourage interested candidates (including PhD aspirants) to apply with their Updated resume and cover letter (including at least two relevant references) at the earliest. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Description:
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.

Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role type- IC
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique RD and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations
What You'll Love About Working Here
We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Description:
Job Title: Academic Counsellor / Sr. Academic Counsellor
Department: Business Development / Admissions
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Days: 6 Days (Mon-Sat), Work From Office
Note: 1 South Indian language is mandatory for Bangalore location(kannada/Telugu preferred)
Job Overview
We are looking for a target-oriented Counsellor to handle lead generation, student counselling, sales, and admissions. The role involves guiding students, parents, and working professionals on educational programs, study-abroad opportunities, and career-oriented training while ensuring smooth enrolment and achieving business targets.
Roles & Responsibilities
Generate leads through calls, digital platforms, referrals, and promotional activities.
Counsel students and parents on courses, eligibility, career opportunities, and study-abroad options.
Manage the admission process, including applications, documentation, follow-ups, and enrolment.
Guide study-abroad applicants on university selection, applications, and visa-related procedures in coordination with relevant teams.
Promote educational programs and training services to prospective customers.
Achieve counselling, admission, and sales targets through effective lead conversion.
Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and reports using CRM tools or Excel.
Coordinate with internal teams and institutional partners for smooth admissions and onboarding.
Required Skills
Excellent communication, counselling, and negotiation skills.
Strong sales orientation and target-achievement mindset.
Good relationship management and follow-up skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification & Experience
Graduate in any discipline,postgraduate qualification preferred.
1+years of experience in counselling, admissions, sales, business development, or education consulting.
Study-abroad or Online Degree sales experience is an advantage.

Job Description: Qualys Platform Engineer

Core Responsibilities

Architecture & Deployment Management:

Design, deploy, and manage Qualys infrastructure, including Virtual Scanner Appliances (vSAs) across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises environments.
Architect, test, and deploy the Qualys Cloud Agent across Enterprise Networks (Windows, Linux, macOS) ensuring zero business disruption.
Optimize scanning schedules, asset tagging, and network discovery rules to maintain an accurate, real-time asset inventory.

Integration & Automation:

Build and maintain custom scripts and automation workflows using the Qualys API to automate scan scheduling, asset tagging, and report generation.
Develop robust data pipelines to ingest Qualys vulnerability data into corporate SIEMs (Splunk, Sentinel), ticketing platforms (ServiceNow VR), and CMDBs.
Embed automated vulnerability scanning directly into DevOps CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions) to achieve "shift-left" security.

Platform Health, Scaling & Support:

Monitor the health, connectivity, and capacity of all Qualys scanner appliances and cloud agents globally.
Act as the SME engineering point of contact for troubleshooting Qualys platform issues, authentication failures, and scanning bottlenecks.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Education & Experience:
BS in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of dedicated experience managing, configuring, and engineering the Qualys Guard / Qualys Cloud Platform at an enterprise scale.

Qualys Suite Mastery:
Deep technical expertise in core Qualys modules: VMDR (Vulnerability Management, Detection, and Response), CAR Module, PC (Policy Compliance), WAS (Web Application Scanning), CAR and AssetView/Global ITAM.
Strong understanding of authenticated vs. unauthenticated scanning, scanning engine behavior, and credential management.

Automation & Scripting:
Proficient in scripting with Python, PowerShell, or Bash to interact directly with the Qualys API (REST/XML).

Systems & Cloud Infrastructure:
Strong foundational knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems.
Solid understanding of enterprise networking concepts (firewalls, routing, NAT, load balancing) necessary to debug scanning obstacles.
Experience supporting cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and  GCP).

Preferred Qualifications
Certified Qualys Specialist (e.g., Vulnerability Management, Cloud Agent, or API certifications).
Proven experience building the Qualys Connector
Familiarity with container security scanning (Docker, Kubernetes) via Qualys Container Security.

Description:
Role Name: Platform + Middleware engineer
Experience: 8 to 10 Years


We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Middleware Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF), AWS, Oracle WebLogic, Akamai, NGINX, Terraform, Splunk, and New Relic, along with working knowledge of GitHub Copilot (GHCP), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agentic AI.
Tools: AWS, Nginx, Akamai, Weblogic, Tomcat, Apache, Splunk, New Relic, Shell scripting, Service Now, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, UDeploy, Jira, Nessus ,Qualys and SonarQube
Key Responsibilities:
Support, maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) environments.
Manage AWS infrastructure including EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, Route 53, IAM, CloudWatch, and related services.
Administer and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic application environments.
Configure and support Akamai for CDN, traffic management, caching, and application delivery.
Configure and manage NGINX as a reverse proxy and load-balancing layer.
Provision and automate infrastructure using Terraform.
Monitor applications and infrastructure using Splunk and New Relic.
Troubleshoot application, middleware, network, performance, and production issues.
Perform incident resolution, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and platform health checks.
Work with applications, cloud, network, security, and DevOps teams to support reliable production environments.
Middleware & Application Platform Management
Manage deployments, rollbacks, and environment synchronization across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production.
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain WebLogic, Tomcat, Apache, and Nginx servers. Perform JVM tuning, thread pool optimization, connection pool management, and performance tuning.
Troubleshoot middleware issues related to memory leaks, thread contention, SSL, certificates, and clustering.
Cloud Engineering (AWS /PCF)
Architect and manages AWS services: EC2, VPC ,IAM, CloudWatch ,ALB/ELB, Lamda, S3
Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform and enforce cloud governance
Drive Secure, cost- optimized and resilient cloud deployments
Manage PCF foundations, tiles, build packs, org/space and platform upgrades
Troubleshoot PCF platform issues including networking, container life cycle and app run time
Vulnerability Management
Identify vulnerabilities across cloud, PCF, middleware, OS, and network layers.
Lead remediation efforts: patching, configuration hardening, dependency upgrades, and secure coding guidelines.
Implement security frameworks, WAF policies, and threatmitigation strategies.
Collaborate with security teams to enforce compliance, risk reduction, and proactive defense. (Aligned with Lead Security Architect responsibilities)
Incident, Problem & Change Management
Lead major incident bridges, coordinate cross functional teams, and provide timely updates.
Manage problem tickets, root cause analysis, and preventive action plans.
Ensure compliance with ITIL processes for change, release, and incident management.
Monitoring, Logging & Observability
Configure dashboards, alerts, and performance insights using New Relic and Splunk.
Develop logbased monitoring strategies and anomaly detection.
Implement proactive monitoring to reduce downtime and improve reliability.
Behavioral Competencies
Communication: Clear, structured communication with customers and internal teams.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
Collaboration: Works effectively across engineering, QA, product, and business teams.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
We are seeking an Environmental Consultant to join our growing team in this role in AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC); you will collaborate with multidisciplinary technical specialists and contribute to a diverse portfolio of projects.
Your role
Leading and coordinating planning and environmental consenting projects, including Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) processes and the implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS).
Provide technical support across environmental services, including Net Zero, ESG, Sustainable land resources, Ecology, and Biodiversity.
Act as a Technical lead on projects, ensuring high-quality delivery.
Engage with clients, regulators, and stakeholders.
Manage projects, including budgets, programmes, and resourcing.
Mentor and support junior team members.
About you
Postgraduate degree qualified in an environmental or related discipline.
12+ years' experience in leading and coordinating planning and environmental consenting, Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) processes and the implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS).
Passionate, proactive, and enthusiastic about environmental sustainability.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities, work under pressure, and maintain technical excellence.
Strong analytical and report-writing skills.
Experience in preparing bids or tenders.
Proven experience delivering projects from the bid stage through to completion.
Membership of a relevant professional body or working towards Chartered RTPI/IES/IEMA/Environmentalist/Scientist status (or equivalent).
Desirable Skills: Experience using digital and spatial tools, including ArcGIS, QGIS, Power BI, and spatial modelling platforms.
Reward benefitsThis includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We are proud to say it is thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise, and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. Our teams are proud to deliver on some of the most prestigious projects across the world. It's thanks to our talented people and their diverse thinking, expertise and knowledge. Join us, and you'll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.
We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic self-starter to join our team as a Senior Principal Ecology Consultant, supporting projects across the UK region.



Your Role
Lead a team of 30 ecologists.
The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of UK clients' requirements and be able to reach back into the business to get the support required to fulfil those requirements and develop relationships/work.
Leading on multi-million capex large projects or frameworks, inputting or overseeing project programmes and budgets.
Collaborating within multi-disciplinary teams and engaging with stakeholders/clients.
The candidate will engage with other areas of the business, seeking opportunities to cross sell and leverage AtkinsRalis' capabilities, preparing bids, supporting on strategic opportunities, building client relationships (internal and external) and driving work-winning in the region.
Undertaking technical checks and reviews of a range of ecological reports and licence applications.
Undertaking ecological assessment and habitat design for a variety of development and nature recovery projects.
Supporting the development of innovative and pragmatic approaches to ecological mitigation and compensation.
Delivering clear and concise, high-quality ecological deliverables in line with current guidance and good practice.
Candidate may coach, mentor and support other staff members in their development.
Task/project management.
About you
A minimum of 15 years of overall professional experience in ecology, including at least 8 years supporting projects in the UK, US, Australia and/or European markets.
An exemplary working knowledge of the UK natural environment and wildlife legislation.
Chartered through the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM), CEcol or CEnv, or actively working towards chartership.
Experience of working on Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects and familiarity with the Development Consent Order (DCO) process would be viewed favourably.
The ability to undertake and provide technical advice on Preliminary Ecological Appraisal, Ecological Impact Assessment and Biodiversity Net Gain assessments.
Strong project management experience, including technical delivery, financial management and quality assurance.
Experience in protected species, mitigation and licensing.
Demonstrable experience of bidding and tendering, particularly in the UK region, including work winning and maintaining strong client relationships.



Reward benefits


This includes:

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.

About the role:
As a Brand Manager, your role is about generating sales and solving customers' problems with regard to
marketing/advertising. You will work as an extended marketing arm of the brands and all the actions strongly exhibit
a Customer-First approach. The primary role is to identify potential brands/companies, onboard new clients, and
ensure the retention of existing ones. In the process of onboarding and retention, you are also exposed to campaign
planning and execution based on the client's brief.
What makes this Job profile interesting?
1. Complete understanding of Sales funnel and acquisition of brands onboard.
2. Exposure to a variety of clients from different industries & categories to know their marketing spend trends
& AOP cycle.
3. Get to work with the marketing team of various companies (small, mid, and large)
Job Description:-
The role has 2 distinct areas of responsibility:
Day-to-day research of relevant brands and their marketing spending trends and marketing approach.
Relationship Management with clients or agencies regularly to know their upcoming campaigns.
You Are Expected To
Identify new brand/company basis trends, market knowledge, current advertisers
Reach out and make connections with identified brands /companies /Agencies

Understanding client's businesses, identifying their marketing problems, and collecting the marketing
campaign brief
Plan the advertising campaign basis the brief and get a go-ahead from clients to execute the advertising
campaign
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that the campaigns are performing/executed as per the
commitment.
Coordinate with clients for smooth flow of work and reporting of ongoing advertising campaigns
Ensuring that the monthly/yearly revenue targets are being achieved with input and output criteria
Preparing Daily Task Reports
The work hours are equally split between - answering emails/calls and campaign execution & campaign
planning
Forge strong business relationships with the clients to ensure its a long-run business avenue year on year
basis.
Build a culture of high performance & innovation in the team with a paced approach
Experience and skills required
Desired Candidate Profile
Excellent communication skills in English.
Ability to change according to business requirements.
work experience of minimum 1-2 years preferred
Demonstrate a positive, ‘can-do’ attitude. Willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Keen interest in analysing performance data and transforming it into actionable strategies.
Keen to grow as an individual.

Description:
ROLE - Manager, Brand Partnerships & Alliances ( Regional)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
As a Brand Manager, your role is about generating sales and solving customers' problems with regard to
marketing/advertising. You will work as an extended marketing arm of the brands and all the actions strongly exhibit
a Customer-First approach. The primary role is to identify potential brands/companies, onboard new clients, and
ensure the retention of existing ones. In the process of onboarding and retention, you are also exposed to campaign
planning and execution based on the client's brief.
What makes this Job profile interesting?
1. Complete understanding of Sales funnel and acquisition of brands onboard.
2. Exposure to a variety of clients from different industries & categories to know their marketing spend trends
& AOP cycle.
3. Get to work with the marketing team of various companies (small, mid, and large)
Job Description:-
The role has 2 distinct areas of responsibility:


Day-to-day research of relevant brands and their marketing spending trends and marketing approach.
Relationship Management with clients or agencies regularly to know their upcoming campaigns.
You Are Expected To


Identify new brand/company basis trends, market knowledge, current advertisers
Reach out and make connections with identified brands /companies /Agencies







Understanding client's businesses, identifying their marketing problems, and collecting the marketing
campaign brief
Plan the advertising campaign basis the brief and get a go-ahead from clients to execute the advertising
campaign
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that the campaigns are performing/executed as per the
commitment.




Coordinate with clients for smooth flow of work and reporting of ongoing advertising campaigns
Ensuring that the monthly/yearly revenue targets are being achieved with input and output criteria
Preparing Daily Task Reports
The work hours are equally split between - answering emails/calls and campaign execution & campaign
planning

Forge strong business relationships with the clients to ensure its a long-run business avenue year on year
basis.


Build a culture of high performance & innovation in the team with a paced approach
Experience and skills required
Desired Candidate Profile






Excellent communication skills in English.
Ability to change according to business requirements.
work experience of minimum 1-2 years preferred
Demonstrate a positive, can-do attitude. Willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Keen interest in analysing performance data and transforming it into actionable strategies.
Keen to grow as an individual.
What we have to offer!



Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world
Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Benefits




Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Rewards & Recognition
Travel Allowance

About the Opportunity

Ericsson is looking for a Telecom Billing L2 Production Support Specialist to support billing and invoicing operations. The role involves 24x7 production support, billing-cycle monitoring, incident resolution, application troubleshooting, and coordination with technical and business stakeholders.

Provide L2 production and operational support for telecom billing and invoicing systems.

Coordinate with L3/L4 application, database, infrastructure, vendor, business, and other stakeholder teams.

Support approved changes, releases, and post-deployment validation.

Prepare RCA documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.

Identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.

The resource should be able to translate business requirements into scalable apps, automated workflows, chatbot experiences, and Microsoft 365 integrated solutions.

Required Expertise

Key Responsibilities

Develop Power Apps, Power Automate cloud flows and Dataverse-based solution components.
Configure Copilot Studio bots using approved knowledge sources, topics, and workflow actions.
Integrate solutions with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, APIs, and business systems using connectors.
Perform testing, defect fixes, deployment support, UAT assistance and post-go-live stabilization.
Prepare concise configuration notes, test evidence, handover inputs, and support documentation.

Required Experience & Skills
46 years of IT experience with Power Platform delivery.
Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 services.
Exposure to Copilot Studio, virtual agents, generative answers, or conversational AI use cases.
Ability to troubleshoot flow failures, connector issues, access restrictions, and deployment challenges.
Good communication skills to work with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders.

Good to Have
Microsoft certifications such as PL-900, PL-100, PL-200, PL-400, or AI-900.
Exposure to AI Builder, Azure OpenAI, chatbot analytics, Power BI or enterprise reporting use cases.
Understanding of ALM, solution packaging, audit requirements, and Power Platform governance.

Description:
Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Description:
Gen AI | Infosys | 5to11 yrs | Pan India

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Description:
Role Overview
We are looking for enthusiastic, target-driven, and result-oriented sales professionals for the WP Sales team at upGrad. The candidate will be responsible for engaging with prospective learners, understanding their career aspirations, recommending suitable learning programs, and converting leads into enrollments.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with prospective students and working professionals through inbound and outbound calls.
Understand customer requirements, career goals, and learning expectations.
Explain upGrad's programs, course structures, fees, and career benefits.
Counsel prospective learners and recommend suitable programs.
Follow up with interested leads and drive conversions.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and lead status in CRM.
Ensure a positive learner experience throughout the admission process.
Handle customer queries and objections effectively.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline (preferred).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven sales environment.
Good presentation and customer-handling skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and CRM tools.
Positive attitude, self-motivation, and willingness to learn.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Prior experience in inside sales, telesales, education sales, or counselling will be an advantage.
Candidates comfortable with calling and sales targets are preferred.
AboutCompany:
About upGrad:
upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field

monitoring.

parameters.

Job Title: Senior Associate / Project Leader Market Access
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: - This role will be responsible for market access/payer analytics, analyzing payer and patient-level data to deliver robust insights and solutions to client.
Job Responsibilities:-
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients
Work closely with project managers to define the analytical approach, break down complex access problems into structured execution steps, and ensure high-quality delivery
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to onshore/client stakeholders through clear, compelling slide decks and discussions.

Job Requirements:-
34+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain
We are looking for candidates with strong exposure to Market Access, Payer Analytics and commercial pharmaceutical analytics
Solid understanding of pharmaceutical contracting entities and landscape, including commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, formulary tiers, prior authorization, step edits, rebates, contracting and affordability programs
Hands-on experience working with payer-related datasets such as APLD, eLAAD, EMR, claims, formulary data, specialty data and prescription data.
Proven ability to structure ambiguous access-related problems, design analytical methodologies, and translate complex analyses into actionable Market Access insights
Ability to handle a variety of projects ranging from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis to reporting, collaborate effectively, and work in fast-paced, global client environments.
Technical requirements Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI and knowledge of self-service analytics platforms like Dataiku will be an added advantage
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Familiarity with advanced analytics, statistical modelling, or forecasting techniques is a plus.

Must-Have Skills:-
Strong expertise in Payer Analytics and hands-on work with patient and payer-level datasets
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding using Power BI

Skills that give you an edge: -
Experience using Dataiku for data preparation, automation, and analytics workflows
Good to have work experience in building statistical modelling and/or AI/ML models using Python/R

We will provide: -

Job Title: Senior Associate / Project Leader Market Access
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: - This role will be responsible for market access/payer analytics, analyzing payer and patient-level data to deliver robust insights and solutions to client.
Job Responsibilities:-
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients
Work closely with project managers to define the analytical approach, break down complex access problems into structured execution steps, and ensure high-quality delivery
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to onshore/client stakeholders through clear, compelling slide decks and discussions.

Job Requirements:-
34+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain
We are looking for candidates with strong exposure to Market Access, Payer Analytics and commercial pharmaceutical analytics
Solid understanding of pharmaceutical contracting entities and landscape, including commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, formulary tiers, prior authorization, step edits, rebates, contracting and affordability programs
Hands-on experience working with payer-related datasets such as APLD, eLAAD, EMR, claims, formulary data, specialty data and prescription data.
Proven ability to structure ambiguous access-related problems, design analytical methodologies, and translate complex analyses into actionable Market Access insights
Ability to handle a variety of projects ranging from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis to reporting, collaborate effectively, and work in fast-paced, global client environments.
Technical requirements Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI and knowledge of self-service analytics platforms like Dataiku will be an added advantage
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Familiarity with advanced analytics, statistical modelling, or forecasting techniques is a plus.

Must-Have Skills:-
Strong expertise in Payer Analytics and hands-on work with patient and payer-level datasets
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding using Power BI

Skills that give you an edge: -
Experience using Dataiku for data preparation, automation, and analytics workflows
Good to have work experience in building statistical modelling and/or AI/ML models using Python/R

Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps.

Microsoft Security Copilot and AI-driven SOC Automation.

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
About the Role
We are hiring Maintenance Technicians to handle on-ground service and repair of our different types of robots. This is a field-intensive role requiring strong hands-on capability in electronics and mechanical systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently. The role involves extensive travel within the assigned zone and direct interaction with customers.

Key Responsibilities
1. Field Service & Repairs
Perform installation, servicing, and repair different kind of robots
Diagnose issues across:
Electrical/electronic components
Mechanical assemblies
Ensure effective and timely resolution during field visits.

2. Fault Diagnosis & Troubleshooting
Identify root causes of failures using structured troubleshooting.
Differentiate between:
Electrical faults
Mechanical wear and tear
Usage-related issues
Minimize repeat visits through accurate diagnosis.

3. Preventive & Routine Maintenance
Conduct periodic maintenance checks to prevent breakdowns.
Ensure appliances operate efficiently post-service.
Follow defined service checklists and SOPs.

4. Customer Interaction
Interact directly with customers at site:
Explain issues and repairs clearly
Provide basic usage guidance to avoid recurring problems
Maintain professional conduct and service quality.

5. Spare Parts & Tools Management
Identify required spare parts for repairs.
Ensure proper usage and handling of tools and equipment.
Coordinate for parts replacement where required.

6. Service Reporting & Documentation
Update service details after each visit:
Issue identified
Action taken
Parts replaced
Maintain accurate service records for tracking and analysis.
Preserve the replaced partes and compile a document and send it to head quarters for further Analysys

7. Travel & Field Coordination
Travel extensively within assigned zone (city clusters).
Coordinate with supervisors for scheduling and escalation.

Required Skills & Qualifications
2-5 years of experience in servicing FMCG appliances (washing machines, mixers, fans preferred)

Strong understanding of:
Basic electronics (wiring, PCB-level basics, motor circuits)
Mechanical systems (motors, bearings, moving parts)

ITI / Diploma / Certification in Mechatronics preferred

Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues independently

Willingness to travel extensively within assigned region

Preferred Attributes
Hands-on, problem-solving mindset
Ability to work independently in field conditions
Good communication and customer-handling skills
Quick learner with adaptability to different appliance models Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Number of service calls completed per day/week
Repeat complaint rate
Customer satisfaction at site
Turnaround time for issue resolution

Description:
Job Responsibility

1. Grievance handling for all bargainable employees:
Interact with employees to identify and effectively resolve all issues
Effective predicting of issues that pose a threat to smooth functioning of organization & prioritize accordingly
Prevent employee grievances from turning into bigger IR issues that can hamper production
Conduct regular meetings like IRC (Industrial Relations Committee) to capture all employee grievances.
2. Ensure maintenance of Internal Discipline:
Ensure that there is good understanding & acceptance for all rules and regulations mandated by the Management.
Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.
4. Drive initiatives to motivate bargainable employees:
Identify and implement welfare activities including sports for blue collar workers in line with organizational guidelines
Organize regular Reward & Recognition functions like the long service awards
Plan and organize various family events or departmental picnics.
Be responsible for a set of employees in shop/area for engagement, growth, recognition,
Self –Directed teams , SQDCME (Safety / Quality/ Delivery/ Cost/ Morale and Environment)
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Employees: Regular Liaising & proactive IR
Block Union Representatives / Line Managers/Divisional Heads/Factory Heads : Regular Interaction and communication for smooth functioning.
Shared services, Construction, Safety, Administration, Medical: To assist workmen in resolving their grievances
ER Team: Regular Interaction between factories for good flow of management ideas.
External
Labour Department & Government Agencies: For Statutory Requirements
Industry Associations: Participation in industry associations and forums related to Industrial Relations to stay informed about trends, regulations, and emerging practices.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education : Post Graduate in Human Resources.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Title: Senior Manager - Sales SCVPU
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Channel SalesBusiness DevelopmentMarket Share, Channel Sales ManagementSales Strategy, About company, Regards,
Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing.

Skills & Competencies
Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills
