Description:
Responsible for the analysis of revenue, profit and demand associated with hotel rooms and space inventory in a given market or cluster.
Position prepares forecasts, budgets, weekly and daily projections and analyzes the progress of each.
Develops and/or uses analytical tools and systems to maximize revenues and profit.
Position critiques sales strategy effectiveness and prepares historical and future analysis of revenue and profit opportunities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data
- Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Analyzes information, identifying current and potential problems and proposing solutions.
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Extracts and analyzes data in order to draw viable/actionable business conclusions.
- Provides revenue analysis functional expertise to general managers, property leadership teams and market sales leaders.
- Prepares forecasts of revenue, profit, demand and occupancy for rooms and function space - three-month and six month, long range and budget.
- Prepares revenue and profit opportunity analysis.
- Manages all revenue, profit and demand data associated with rooms and function space.
Executing Revenue Management Projects and Strategy
- Takes a predetermined strategy and drives the execution of that strategy.
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Observes, receives, and otherwise obtains information from all relevant sources.
- Works with other people to gather the information necessary to manage projects, achieve goals, and resolve problems.
- Understands and accurately represents individual property needs.
- Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue analysis processes.
- Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.
- Promotes and protects brand equity.
- Prepares sales strategy critique.
Building Successful Relationships
- Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintaining them over time.
- Provides targeted and timely communication of results, achievements and challenges to the stakeholders.
- Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
Additional Responsibilities
- Informs and/or updates the executives and the peers on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Enters, transcribes, records, stores, or maintains information in written or electronic form.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations .
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page (RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.

Apply Now

What will you drive?
As a Retail Associate, your primary responsibility will be to build strong relationships with New Car Dealerships (NCDs)and generate high-quality leads for customers looking to sell or exchange their cars.
Your day will revolve around visiting 3-5 NCD outlets daily, engaging with dealer partners, and identifying customers interested in selling their old vehicles or opting for exchange deals. You will act as the face of CARS24 on the ground ensuring that every potential lead is captured, nurtured, and converted through our platform.
This role is not just about visits its about consistent follow-ups, relationship management, and closing deals. Strong coordination with dealers and timely follow-ups on leads will be critical to your success.
You will work towards monthly targets, where your performance will be measured based on lead generation, conversions, and dealer engagement quality. Your persuasion and negotiation skills will play a key role in turning opportunities into successful transactions.
To set you up for success, you will go through 715 days of structured training(classroom + on-field), equipping you with the right product knowledge, sales techniques, and tools.
Expect a high-performance environment with attractive incentives tied to your achievements because at CARS24, we celebrate results and reward top performers.

Key Responsibilities
Visit4-6 Dealerships daily to generate leads
Identify customers interested in selling or exchanging their cars
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealer partners
Ensure consistent follow-ups with NCDs for lead flow
Convert leads into successful transactions via CARS24
Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions
Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Working Days
6 days a week
Week off during weekdays

Who are we looking for?
Strong field sales mindset with willingness to travel daily
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Ability to follow up persistently and close deals
Self-driven, target-oriented, and highly energetic
Prior experience in automobile, dealership, or field sales is a plus

Description:
Assists with identifying and addressing employee and organizational development needs.
The position is assist in ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results.
Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills.
Assists in conducting needs assessments, designing and developing training programs and facilitating the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs.
Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting with Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Assisting with Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.

Title: Business Development Executive \ Field sales apprentice role
Location: Ranchi (Retail Store Based)
Job Type: Full\-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics \/ Retail \/ FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store\-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast\-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
\- Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
\- Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
\- Conduct in\-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
\- Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
\- Support retail partners with business development strategies and on\-ground execution
\- Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
\- Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass\-out)
\- Freshers are encouraged to apply
\- Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
\- Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
\- Personal two\-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
\- Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty\/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
\- Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
\- Work Schedule: 6 days a week
\- Weekly Off: Sunday
\- Work Type: Retail store\-based with regular local market visits

Benefits
\- Fixed salary: \\u20b911,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 in hand)
\- Daily TA\/DA: \\u20b9200
\- Attractive performance\-based incentives

Description:
Job Title: Executive Assistant (Civil Construction)
Department: Executive Office / Administration
Reports To: Project Director / Managing Director / Senior Executives

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Executive Assistant with specialized experience in civil construction and government building projects. In this role, you will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to senior leadership. You will act as a key liaison between project managers, department heads, and government authorities, ensuring smooth document management, scheduling, and project reporting.

Key Responsibilities
Project Administration: Manage, format, and organize highly confidential government tenders, project proposals, contracts, and compliance documents.
Calendar & Schedule Management: Coordinate executive calendars, schedule high-level stakeholder meetings, and manage project site visit timelines.
Data Management & Reporting: Create, maintain, and analyze complex project trackers, budget sheets, and material inventories.
Communication & Correspondence: Draft official letters, memos, and emails to government bodies, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Document Processing: Handle heavy data entry, draft meeting minutes (MOM), and transcribe technical project briefs with high accuracy.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Industry Experience: Proven track record as an Executive Assistant or Project Coordinator within the civil construction sector, specifically dealing with government building construction.
Advanced Tech Skills: High proficiency in Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data automation) and the Google Workspace suite (specifically Google Calendar, Docs, and Sheets).
Technical Typing & Tools: Fast and accurate typing speed, with hands-on experience utilizing specialized administrative/coding scripts like abscript for document formatting or automation.
Computer Literacy: Strong overall command of computer systems, cloud storage organization, and digital workflow tools.
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored for professional corporate and government environments.

Education
Bachelors Degree: A graduation degree.
Graduation/Construction Background (Preferred): Graduation /Construction Management is a massive advantage, as it helps the assistant understand technical government tenders, site blueprints, and construction jargon.(Civil engineers advantage)
Computer Certifications: A certified course in Advanced Excel, Microsoft Office, or G-Suite administration, Abscript(google)
Typing Certification: A formal typing certification (e.g., 30+ words per minute) is highly preferred for handling swift government documentation.

Experience: - 5+ years
Salary- 18000 to 30000
AboutCompany: R S Agrawal Infratech Pvt. Ltd work in Goverment Projects.

Designation: Team Member
Job Brief: Join JSW Steel Limited's Maintenance Department as a dedicated team member responsible for ensuring the optimal functioning and reliability of manufacturing equipment. This role involves hands-on maintenance activities, troubleshooting, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support continuous production processes. The ideal candidate will contribute to minimizing downtime, enhancing equipment efficiency, and upholding safety standards in a fast-paced steel manufacturing environment.
Responsibilities:
Perform routine and preventive maintenance on manufacturing machinery and equipment to ensure operational efficiency.
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic issues promptly to minimize production downtime.
Collaborate with engineering and production teams to plan and execute maintenance schedules and shutdown activities.
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, including repairs, inspections, and parts replacements.
Adhere strictly to safety protocols and company policies to maintain a safe working environment.
Assist in the installation and commissioning of new equipment and machinery as required.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and report potential equipment failures to senior maintenance staff.
Support inventory management by monitoring and requesting necessary spare parts and tools.
Participate in continuous training programs to stay updated with the latest maintenance techniques and industry standards.

Preventive Maintenance
Mechanical Troubleshooting
Electrical Systems Knowledge
Hydraulic Systems Maintenance
Equipment Installation and Commissioning
Safety Compliance
Maintenance Documentation
Inventory Management
Team Collaboration
Problem-Solving
Preferred Qualifications:
Diploma or degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering or a related technical field.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in maintenance roles within the steel manufacturing or heavy industrial sector.
Required work experience

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.

Description:
We are looking for a talented Computer Vision Developer to design and implement advanced image and video processing solutions.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in computer vision algorithms, deep learning frameworks, and real-time image analysis, enabling innovative AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and optimize computer vision models for image classification, object detection, segmentation, and tracking.
Implement solutions using OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
Work on image preprocessing, feature extraction, and data augmentation techniques.
Integrate vision models into production systems and optimize for real-time performance.
Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to deliver AI solutions.
Ensure model accuracy, scalability, and deployment efficiency.
Stay updated with the latest research and advancements in computer vision and deep learning.
Required Skills:
Strong experience with OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar libraries.
Proficiency in Python (and optionally C++ for performance-critical tasks).
Knowledge of image processing techniques and computer vision algorithms.
Experience with CNNs, object detection models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN), and segmentation models (Mask R-CNN, U-Net).
Familiarity with GPU acceleration and model optimization for deployment.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with video analytics, 3D vision, or AR/VR applications.
Knowledge of edge deployment (NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT).
Understanding of cloud-based AI services (AWS Sagemaker, GCP AI Platform).

Location: PAN INDIA

EXPERIENCE:5-10 YEARS

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Description:
Manager (Chartered Accountant) - Corporate Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Location: Jajpur, Odisha
Department: Finance & Accounts
Experience: 2-5 Years Post Qualification Experience (PQE)
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)

Roles & Responsibilities

Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements (CFS) on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.
Perform intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and consolidation adjustments.
Ensure compliance with applicable Ind AS and financial reporting requirements.
Prepare Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow Statement, and Notes to Accounts as per Schedule III.
Support quarter-end and year-end financial closure activities.
Handle NCI, goodwill accounting, and foreign currency translation adjustments.
Coordinate with statutory auditors and provide audit-related schedules and documentation.
Prepare technical accounting workings and support regulatory compliance.
Work on SAP S/4HANA and advanced Excel-based reporting and analysis.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders for accurate and timely financial reporting.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Qualified CA with 0-5 years PQE.
Experience in Financial Reporting, Group Consolidation, or Statutory Audit.
Strong knowledge of Ind AS and Schedule III Reporting.
Hands-on experience in CFS preparation, intercompany reconciliations, and audit support.
Proficient in SAP S/4HANA and Advanced Excel.
Exposure to manufacturing/large corporate environments preferred.
IFRS or Ind AS certification will be an added advantage.

Office Location:

Position description: Join Jindal Ferrous Limited's Blast Furnace Mechanical Department as an entry-level engineer, where you will contribute to the efficient operation and maintenance of blast furnace equipment critical to our mining and metals production processes. This role involves hands-on mechanical engineering tasks, supporting senior engineers in ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of blast furnace machinery. The position offers a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise in heavy industrial equipment within a leading mining and metals company, fostering growth in a dynamic and safety-focused environment.

Primary Responsibilities:
Assist in the routine inspection, maintenance, and repair of blast furnace mechanical systems to ensure optimal operational efficiency.
Support the implementation of preventive maintenance schedules and procedures for critical blast furnace equipment.
Collaborate with senior engineers to troubleshoot mechanical failures and develop corrective action plans.
Monitor equipment performance data and report anomalies to the maintenance team for timely intervention.
Participate in the installation and commissioning of new mechanical components and systems within the blast furnace department.
Ensure compliance with safety standards and company policies during all mechanical operations and maintenance activities.
Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance activities, equipment history, and technical reports.
Assist in coordinating with procurement and inventory teams to ensure availability of necessary spare parts and tools.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing equipment reliability and reducing downtime.
Support training programs for operational staff on mechanical system awareness and safety practices.

Troubleshooting Mechanical Systems
Blast Furnace Operations Knowledge
Technical Documentation
Safety Compliance in Industrial Settings

Description:
Revenue Lead Ops&Sales-Puri/BBSR

About OYO
OYO is one of the worlds leading hotel and travel tech companies, driven by the mission to make affordable and comfortable stays accessible to all. We work with thousands of hotel partners across India, helping them grow revenue, improve customer experience, and scale their business.
Key Responsibilities
Drive business expansion by acquiring and onboarding new properties.
Meet hotel/property owners, present OYOs vision, and build profitable partnerships.
Develop joint business plans and ensure SLA compliance with partners.
Manage hotel partner relationships, resolve escalations, and drive retention.
Collaborate with transformation & operations teams to make properties live.
Ensure occupancy growth, sellable room availability, and revenue performance.
Key Performance Indicators
Sellable rooms signed & made live month-on-month.
Occupancy (URNs) & Pay at Hotel (PAH) realization.
Gross margin from signed properties.
Daily availability of sellable rooms (DSRN).
Education
Graduation is mandatory.
Experience & Skills
1+ years of experience in business development, operations, or key account management.
Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Analytical, data-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Prior experience in managing escalations and cross-functional teams is an advantage.
AboutCompany:
About OYO: OYO is one of the leading global travel and hospitality brands, offering a wide range of accommodations through its extensive network of hotels and homes. With a strong presence in over 80 countries, we are transforming the way people experience travel and stay. We are looking for passionate, dynamic, and result-driven individuals to join our team and help drive growth in our B2B Travel and Corporate Sales domain.

Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Business Development, Corporate SellingB2BSalesField SalesBusiness to BusinessB2B SalesRevenue GenerationCorporate SalesEnterprise Sales, About company, About OYO: OYO is one of the leading global travel and hospitality brands, offering a wide range of accommodations through its extensive network of hotels and homes. With a strong presence in over 80 countries, we are transforming the way people experience travel and stay. We are looking for passionate, dynamic, and result-driven individuals to join our team and help drive growth in our B2B Travel and Corporate Sales domain.
Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

With a strong presence in over 80 countries, we are transforming the way people experience travel and stay. We are looking for passionate, dynamic, and result-driven individuals to join our team and help drive growth in our B2B Travel and Corporate Sales domain.

Description:
Project Role : Technology Support Engineer

Project Role Description : Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. Create and implement Requests for Change (RFC) and update knowledge base articles to support effective troubleshooting. Collaborate with vendors and help service management teams with issue analysis and resolution.

Must have skills : Storage Area Networks (SAN) Architecture and Design

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Technology Support Engineer, a typical day involves addressing and resolving incidents and problems that affect various business system components to maintain smooth and stable operations. The role includes managing change requests and continuously updating documentation to enhance troubleshooting efficiency. Collaboration with external vendors and internal service management teams is a key part of the daily routine, ensuring timely analysis and resolution of technical issues to support business continuity and operational excellence.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
Assist in monitoring system performance and proactively identify potential issues to prevent downtime.
Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on technical challenges.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of processes, incidents, and resolutions to facilitate knowledge sharing.
Engage in continuous learning to stay current with evolving technologies and industry best practices.

Professional & Technical Skills:

Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in Storage Area Networks (SAN) Architecture and Design.
Strong understanding of storage protocols and technologies including Fibre Channel and iSCSI.
Experience with storage array management and performance tuning.
Knowledge of backup and recovery solutions related to SAN environments.
Ability to troubleshoot complex storage infrastructure issues and optimize system availability.
Familiarity with storage virtualization and integration with cloud platforms.
The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Storage Area Networks (SAN) Architecture and Design.
This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office.
A 15 years full time education is required.

Qualification 15 years full time education

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal skilled trades training program, assists site Electrician skilled trades to learn and develop electrical skills in a manufacturing environment under direct guidance. Apprentice will be required to successfully complete and document specified classes and a minimum quantity of on the job training hours. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Learns and applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs supervised work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Attends required classes to build basic electrical skills and knowledge to qualify as an Electrician. Completes all required on the job training hours. Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment and other miscellaneous duties within their capabilities . Assists with preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development. 1. Key Skills Required
DG Set Testing Commissioning - hands-on experience in DG/engine testing.
Electrical Troubleshooting - ability to identify and rectify faults in electrical circuits, panels, wiring and protection systems.
Electrical Electronic Systems - good understanding of AC/DC circuits, sensors, relays, contactors, breakers and control systems.
Engine Electronics - basic understanding of ECU, ECM, sensors, actuators and electronic control systems.
Test Instruments - proficient in using multimeter, clamp meter, megger/insulation tester and other electrical measuring instruments.
Electrical Drawing Reading - ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and circuit diagrams.
Control Panel Knowledge - troubleshooting of DG control panels, protection circuits and monitoring systems.
Test Cell Operations - understanding of engine/DG test procedures, parameters and test-cell equipment.
Problem Solving RCA - ability to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Safety Knowledge - strong knowledge of electrical safety, LOTO, PPE and safe working practices.
Documentation - maintaining test reports, check sheets, troubleshooting records and equipment history.
Computer Skills - basic MS Office/Excel and ability to work with digital testing/monitoring systems.
2. Roles Responsibilities
DG Testing Operations
Perform DG/engine testing as per defined test procedures and specifications.
Carry out pre-test inspection and verify electrical connections before starting the test.
Monitor key electrical and engine parameters during testing.
Ensure timely completion of testing to support engine dispatch requirements.
Identify abnormalities during testing and take appropriate corrective action.
Electrical Electronics Troubleshooting
Troubleshoot electrical and electronic issues during engine/DG testing.
Diagnose issues related to sensors, wiring, ECU/ECM, control panels, relays, contactors, breakers and protection circuits.
Use appropriate diagnostic and electrical test equipment for fault finding.
Coordinate with Maintenance/Engineering teams for complex issues.
Quality Documentation
Ensure testing is performed as per SOP, Control Plan and Quality requirements.
Record test results accurately and maintain all required documentation.
Escalate test failures and abnormal conditions promptly.
Support RCA and corrective/preventive actions for recurring failures.
Safety
Follow all electrical and test-cell safety requirements.
Ensure proper LOTO, grounding, PPE and safe isolation before electrical intervention.
Immediately report unsafe conditions and near misses.
Maintain 5S and housekeeping in the test-cell area.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to reduce testing time, breakdowns and rework.
Support implementation of improvements in test-cell electrical systems.
Participate in problem-solving and improvement projects.
3. Ideal Candidate Profile
Diploma - Electrical / Electrical Electronics Engineering | 2-3 years experience
The candidate should be hands-on, comfortable working in a test-cell environment, strong in electrical troubleshooting, and capable of independently performing DG testing and resolving routine electrical/electronic issues.
Preferred: Experience with Cummins engines/DG sets, engine test cells, ECU/ECM-based systems, generator controls, or industrial electrical systems.
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the functions needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Minimal or no work experience required.

Description:
Wipro is seeking an AI Engineer to implement and test agent nodes on a production Agentic AI platform for a large-scale healthcare technology engagement. You will work within an established LangGraph architecture, building individual agent nodes, tool integrations, and LLM-powered processing steps under the technical direction of the Senior AI Engineer and AI Architect. This is a hands-on implementation role for an engineer who is proficient in Python and eager to work on production clinical AI at scale.

Responsibilities
Implement individual LangGraph agent nodes per agreed specifications: data retrieval, clinical assessment, evidence gathering, decision evaluation, and recommendation.
Build and maintain tool wrappers in the AI Tool Layer for enterprise clinical service integrations (claims, Rx, clinical documents, clinical model rules).
Write and optimize LLM prompt templates for relevance scoring and document processing tasks.
Implement error handling, retry logic, and circuit breaker patterns within agent nodes.
Instrument nodes with OpenTelemetry spans and structured audit log events.
Write unit and integration tests for all implemented nodes and tool integrations.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards within the team.
Support integration testing, debugging, and defect resolution through the testing phase.

Required Skills & Experience
5+ years software engineering experience; 3+ year working with LLM APIs or AI application development.
Python: async programming, REST API consumption, clean modular code.
LLM integration: experience calling LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or equivalent); function/tool calling, prompt construction, response parsing.
LangGraph or LangChain: working knowledge of agent node patterns, state management, and tool use. Production experience a strong plus.
Azure fundamentals: containerized workloads on AKS, Azure services consumption.
Testing discipline: unit tests, integration tests, and test-driven development practices.
Comfortable working within a defined architecture under senior technical direction.

Preferred Skills
Healthcare or regulated industry exposure: HIPAA awareness, PHI handling, clinical data types.
Familiarity with clinical coding systems: RxNorm, CPT, ICD-10, SNOMED-CT.
OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience.
Experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, or event-driven architectures.

Description:
OverviewA Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking ForExperience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Position description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced engineering professional to join our Slag Yard team within the Steel Melting Shop (SMS) department at Jindal Stainless Limited. The role involves overseeing the technical operations, maintenance, and optimization of slag handling and processing systems in a large-scale mining and metals environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in metallurgical engineering or related fields, with proven expertise in managing slag yard operations to ensure safety, efficiency, and compliance with environmental standards. This position requires leadership capabilities to coordinate cross-functional teams, implement process improvements, and support sustainable production goals in a dynamic industrial setting.

Primary Responsibilities:
Manage and supervise all technical activities related to slag yard operations, including slag handling, cooling, and disposal processes.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures to ensure the reliability and safety of slag yard equipment and infrastructure.
Coordinate with production, quality, and environmental teams to optimize slag processing and minimize operational downtime.
Monitor and analyze slag yard performance metrics to identify areas for process improvement and cost reduction.
Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and company safety standards in all slag yard activities.
Lead root cause analysis and troubleshooting of operational issues, implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Prepare and manage budgets related to slag yard operations, including resource allocation and procurement of materials.
Collaborate with engineering design teams to plan and execute upgrades or expansions of slag yard facilities.
Train and mentor junior engineers and technicians, fostering a culture of continuous learning and safety awareness.
Generate detailed technical reports and documentation for management review and regulatory submissions.
Drive initiatives for sustainable slag management practices aligned with corporate social responsibility goals.

Description:
Company Description
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
Qualifications
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Manager Project Procurement

Location: Jajpur, Odisha
Department: Project Procurement
Experience: 10-15 Years
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or Civil Engineering (Mandatory)

Key Responsibilities

Manage procurement and contracting for project, civil, structural, infrastructure, and industrial packages.
Lead vendor sourcing, tendering, techno-commercial evaluations, negotiations, and contract finalization.
Handle BOQ/Item Rate, Lump Sum, and Rate Contracts.
Execute procurement for CAPEX, OPEX, MRO, spares, and consumables.
Conduct cost analysis, benchmarking, and commercial negotiations covering pricing, payment terms, project schedules, LD, bank guarantees, taxes, and statutory clauses.
Prepare commercial recommendations and obtain internal approvals for contracts and purchase orders.
Draft, review, and administer commercial contracts and key contractual terms.

SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, building materials).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.

MWA: 5,000/ -
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance

Description:
Business Development Executive Franchise & HRMS Sales
FOR YOU MART | Chaspa Supermart Pvt. Ltd.
Location: DLF Cybercity, Patia, Bhubaneswar
Experience: 1–3 years
Salary: 20,000–25,000 fixed gross per month + conversion incentives
Employment: Full-time, on-site, with client visits as required
FOR YOU MART is hiring a sales professional to develop two business opportunities: supermarket franchise partnerships and subscriptions for For You Team, our employee-management application.
We are looking for someone who can find suitable prospects, understand their requirements, present a clear solution and follow opportunities through to paid conversion.
Your responsibilities
Build a pipeline through incoming enquiries, prospecting, referrals, professional networks and approved field visits.
Assess franchise enquiries for investment readiness, proposed location, property availability and decision timeline.
Present approved franchise options and arrange management discussions or store visits for suitable prospects.
Approach business owners, HR managers and other decision-makers for For You Team subscriptions.
Discover customers’ employee-management requirements and demonstrate relevant, available application features.
Prepare approved quotations, handle objections and follow up on proposals.
Coordinate agreements, payment confirmation and customer handover with the authorised teams.
Maintain accurate lead records, discussion notes, opportunity stages and follow-up dates in the For You Team app.
Submit weekly pipeline reports covering qualified leads, demonstrations, proposals, paid conversions and pending decisions.
Meet agreed sales targets while maintaining accurate and professional communication.
The role owns sales progression and customer handover. Franchise opening execution and technical implementation are handled by the respective teams. All commercial commitments must follow approved company terms.
Candidate requirements
1–3 years of experience in sales, business development or customer acquisition.
Experience in franchise sales, software/HRMS/SaaS sales or another B2B service is preferred. Experience in either business area is acceptable.
Ability to conduct prospect calls, presentations and software demonstrations.
Strong follow-up, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Comfortable using Excel, online meeting tools and CRM or lead-management applications.
Ability to communicate with local customers in Odia and Hindi and write professional emails in English.
Willingness to work from Bhubaneswar and visit prospects when required.
Compensation and incentives
Fixed gross salary: 20,000–25,000 per month, based on relevant experience and assessment.
Franchise incentive: 5,000 for each eligible new franchise conversion.
HRMS incentive: 15% of eligible first-year net subscription collections from new customers.
Incentives are additional to fixed salary and depend on verified qualifying sales.
Statutory deductions and benefits apply as applicable.
How to apply
Apply through Naukri with your updated CV. Include your current location, products or services previously sold, individual sales achievements, expected monthly gross salary and earliest joining date.
Immediate joiners are preferred.
AboutCompany:
Our Mission & Vision

For You Mart is a purpose-driven supermarket chain based in Odisha, built on the belief that quality, dignity, and a modern shopping experience should be accessible to everyone regardless of whether they live in a city, town, or rural area.
In many rural and semi-urban regions, women often have limited mobility and fewer opportunities to travel to distant markets or large city stores. For You Mart brings the city-style shopping experience closer to home, allowing women and families to shop comfortably, safely, and confidently within their own locality.
Our stores are designed to offer a clean, organized, and respectful environment where customers — especially women — can experience the convenience, choice, and confidence usually associated with urban retail spaces. By placing our outlets within reach of local communities, we help customers enjoy a modern retail experience without the need to travel far, making everyday shopping easier and more dignified.
Beyond convenience, our mission is rooted in service, not just sales. We provide a wide range of daily-need grocery and essential products under one roof, ensuring better quality at more affordable prices than both large chains and local markets, with special focus on everyday household needs.
To support monthly budgeting, we run a Super Savings Week from the 4th to 10th of every month, including unique offers such as 1 kg sugar at just 9 on a minimum purchase of 1499, enabling families to plan their expenses better at the beginning of the month.
Every purchase also earns reward points, and customers shopping for 1999 or more receive a Scratch Card with assured rewards ranging from 500 to 1,00,000 — creating real value and excitement for our customers.
Our vision is to grow as a trusted neighborhood supermarket brand that blends service, affordability, inclusivity, and innovation, while empowering communities, supporting women shoppers, and expanding responsibly across Odisha.
For You Mart is more than a supermarket — it is a promise to bring city-level quality, comfort, and respect to every neighborhood we serve.

Description:
Educational Requirements
Bachelor of Engineering
Service Line
Infosys Quality Engineering
Responsibilities
Lead QA strategy and execution across projects, ensuring robust automated testing coverage and release readiness.
Design, develop, and maintain Java-based Selenium automation frameworks aligned with best practices and long-term scalability.
Design test plans, test cases, and automation suites for functional, regression, and smoke testing across applications.
Review automation code, enforce quality standards, and drive improvements in test design, stability, and execution speed.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to clarify requirements, identify risks early, and ensure testability of features.
Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and provide clear defect reports with reproducible steps and evidence.
Mentor and guide QA engineers, supporting skill development, task planning, and consistent delivery across the team.
Track quality metrics and communicate status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders in a timely manner.
Design and implement automation frameworks using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript for web and API testing, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and reusability.
Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites for functional, regression, smoke, and integration testing across multiple applications and environments.
Collaborate with cross functional teams (developers, product owners, business analysts) to understand requirements, define acceptance criteria, and translate them into effective automated test scenarios.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Git-based workflows, ensuring fast feedback and reliable build quality gates.
Perform API testing using Rest Assured or equivalent tools, validating request/response flows, status codes, and data integrity.
Conduct database testing by writing and executing queries to validate data consistency, transformations, and back-end logic.
Technical and Professional Requirements
Experience leading QA teams or acting as a test/automation lead across multiple releases.
Expertise in building reusable automation components, applying design patterns, and improving framework maintainability.
Experience with test execution and reporting practices that improve visibility and decision-making for releases.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence quality outcomes across cross-functional teams.
Exposure to performance and API testing concepts and integrating automation into modern delivery pipelines.
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright (minimum 3 years) for UI test automation, including test creation, execution, and maintenance.
Proficiency in TypeScript (or strong JavaScript with willingness to work in TypeScript) for writing clean, modular, and reusable test automation code.
Solid understanding of automation testing concepts including test design techniques, test data management, and defect lifecycle.
Preferred Skills
Technology->Automated Testing->Selenium-Java
Technology->Automated Testing->Playwright Typescript

Description:
Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.

You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives

You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
Technical Requirement
Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP FICO with strong integration skills across MM and SD modules.
Proven expertise in process flows like Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, and Availability to Produce.
Hands-on configuration experience in Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Product Costing, FSCM, and COPA.
Ability to independently write Functional Specifications and work on custom object development and deployment.
Experience in at least one end-to-end SAP implementation project.
Exposure to Concur, Travel & Expense (T&E), industry-specific solutions, and customer-facing roles is a strong advantage.
Additional Responsibility
Ability to work with clients to identify business challenges and contribute to client deliverables by refining, analyzing, and structuring relevant data
Awareness of latest technologies and trends
Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge

We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Indore, Nagpur, Mangalore, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Coimbatore, Jaipur, Mysore, Hubli, Vizag.

While we work in accordance with business requirements, we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice, where possible.

Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.
