Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Hiring: Associate Agency Development Manager (AADM) | Axis Max Life Insurance

Location: Madanapalle

Axis Max Life Insurance is looking for energetic and goal-oriented professionals to join our Agency Sales team as Associate Agency Development Manager (AADM).

Eligibility:

Graduate in any discipline
6 Months - 1 Year of Field Sales Experience
Local candidates preferred

Key Responsibilities: • Recruit and build a team of Insurance Advisors
• Train, mentor, and develop advisors for business growth
• Drive sales through the Agency Channel
• Achieve monthly business targets
• Ensure strong customer engagement and service

What We Offer:

Fixed Salary + Incentives + Performance Rewards
Career Growth Opportunities
Training & Development Support
Opportunity to work with one of India's leading Life Insurance companies


Interested candidates can share their updated resume or apply

CONTACT : Akriti HR - 9599669839
AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Services Ltd. is part of the Axis Max Group, which is a leading Indian multi-business corporation, while Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance is a member of the MS&AD Insurance Group, which is amongst the leading insurers in the world.

Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

During the financial year 2018-19, Axis Max Life achieved ‘Gross Written Premium’ of Rs. 14,575 crore & had sum assured in force of Rs. 7,03,972 Crore. As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Description:
Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Overall Evaluate the financial and economic benefits of infrastructure and disaster risk reduction interventions, including assessment of avoided losses and long-term impacts.
Undertake cost-benefit analysis and economic analyses to support investment decisions for resilient infrastructure and risk mitigation measures.
Support preparation and review of financial and economic appraisal documents, models, and justification notes for government review and approval.
Provide technical inputs to prioritisation and decision-making processes based on economic viability, sustainability, and value for money.
Educational Qualifications:
CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).
Skills and Experience:
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in the field.
Experience of working on at least one externally funded project (such as ADB, AFD, WBG, etc.)
Prior work experience across Himalayan regions with exposure to multiple hazards in India, Nepal, Bhutan, etc.
Interested candidates may send their CVs along with a cover letter with the subject line: Name- Position Applying For- Years of Experience. Only candidates with relevant qualifications and proven experience are encouraged to apply.

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
dispensing lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product
recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Role Overview The Field Officer is the frontline member of the KiDS project team, responsible for direct engagement with schools, teachers, students, parents, and communities in the assigned districts. The role reports to the District Coordinator or Programme Manager and requires consistent field presence and strong community engagement skills.
Location
Saharanpur, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Lucknow, Kanpur
Organization
YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)
Project
KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi

Skills
Proficiency in MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) to oversee and manage MEP works for a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, coordination, quality control, site supervision, and timely completion of all MEP activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day MEP site activities, including electrical, plumbing, firefighting, HVAC, and other building services.
Review and coordinate MEP drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and installation layouts.
Supervise site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper execution of MEP works.
Coordinate with civil, structural, architectural, and other project teams to avoid clashes and ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with government officials, clients, consultants, and contractors for inspections, approvals, and technical clearances.
Monitor material procurement, consumption, manpower, and resource utilization to ensure cost-effective execution.
Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of all MEP systems.
Maintain quality standards and ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety regulations, and approved project specifications.
Prepare progress reports, measurement sheets, billing documents, and material reconciliation reports.
Identify and resolve technical issues and ensure timely completion of MEP works as per the project schedule.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Good knowledge of MEP drawings, BOQs, billing, and site execution.
Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in hill-area or sloping terrain projects will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on professional capable of independently managing MEP site operations, coordinating with multiple teams, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely project delivery.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Mayasheel Ventures Limited is an established engineering and construction company with a presence in the infrastructure sector since 2008. The company specializes in the execution of government infrastructure projects on EPC and item-rate basis, with expertise in highways, bridges, electrical works, and other civil construction projects. With experience across multiple states, including the North-Eastern region, the company is committed to quality construction, efficient project execution, and timely delivery.

- Achieve monthly and annual sales targets for AAC Blocks in Mizoram.

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.
Ability to respond to sales queries promptly and effectively, demonstrating strong communication skills both over the phone and in person.

Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Internship Trainee

Location: Chennai, Pondicherry, Erode
Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Firmware Development: Design, write, and test low-level firmware in Embedded C for bare-metal architectures and Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS).
Peripheral Drivers: Develop and maintain low-level drivers and Board Support Packages (BSP) for timers, ADC/DAC, DMA, GPIO, and external Flash/EEPROM.
Wired Protocols: Implement, configure, and troubleshoot wired serial and fieldbus interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN / RS-485.
Hardware Bring-Up: Lab Debugging: Bring up prototype boards and troubleshoot firmware-hardware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
Hardware Collaboration: Review hardware schematics, pinout mappings, and semiconductor datasheets in close collaboration with hardware design engineers.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE):
Experience: Minimum 3 years of hands-on professional experience in embedded firmware development.
Core Programming: Proficient in software development skills (C/C++/Python/...)
Target Microcontrollers: Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least one major MCU family: STMicroelectronics (STM32), NXP (LPC, Kinetis, S32K), or Renesas (RA, RX, RL78).
Communication Interfaces: Direct experience configuring and debugging wired buses: UART/USART, SPI, I2C, and CAN.
OS &Execution Models: Practical understanding of RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS tasks, queues, semaphores, mutexes) and bare-metal superloops.
Lab Instrumentation:
Hands-on experience using in-circuit debuggers (J-Link, ST-Link, E2) and diagnostic
tools (logic analyzers, digital oscilloscopes).

Bachelor degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE),
Electrical & Electronics Engineering, (EEE),
Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

Hire and build a new team to support our growing needs and future projects.

Define sales processes that drive desired sales outcomes and identify improvements.
Going to the Merchant and educating him/her about the benefits of the Swipe machine (EDC) converting them and managing their accounts.
Exceptional communication, presentation skills and relationship building skills.
Ability to aggressively manage the successful execution of a sales strategy.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Job Purpose:
Responsiblefor evaluating and underwriting loan applications received via digitalchannels. Focus on quick, accurate decisioning with policy adherence, KYCverification, fraud checks, and coordination with stakeholders to achieveseamless, paperless disbursements.

Evaluate digital loan applications within definedturnaround time (TAT) using scorecards and policy rules.

Strong analyticaland decision-making skills.
Knowledge ofretail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency indigital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention todetail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Graduate /Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
13 years incredit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

Description:
Position: Sales Specialist/Consultant

Job purpose:
The incumbent is responsible for the designated region in order to meet ophthalmologists on a regular basis and accomplish revenue objectives in line with team/organizational goals. Meet the company's call average and ophthalmology coverage requirements in the designated region.
Main Accountabilities:
Accountable for assigned territory, meeting ophthalmologists, opticians & Doctors on a regular basis, and meeting revenue budgets in line with team/organizational goals.
Collaborate with sales teams from various locations to generate revenues in the Hospital Retail Channel.
Carry out customer/market development efforts in collaboration with line managers.
Key Result Areas:
Manage and continually updates a client base of consultant ophthalmologists, institutions, and hospitals & Doctors and review the list to improve the business for product line refraction lenses & refraction devices.
Conduct product conversations with ophthalmologists, as well as consumer education, retail audits, and monitor distributor
Implement the company's marketing strategies on a regular basis, thereby meeting sales targets and product volume budgets.
Meets the company's call average and ophthalmology criteria in the designated region.
Adhere to reporting procedures, work schedules, and budgets in order to maximize sales and establish efficient sales processes.
Job Specifications:
The candidate must be a graduate in science, pharmacy, or optometry with a strong track record (MBA preferred)
4-12 years of previous successful sales experience in the Product Sales (Pharmaceutical / Healthcare /Optical/Ophthalmology industry preferred)
AboutCompany:
ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the fields o f o ptics a nd optoelectronics. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace. Further information at ZEISS India

Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.

-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations."

Description:
To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.
Ensure customer service-related complaints or termination notifications/STOP Services are attended to effectively and promptly.
Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager
AboutCompany:
Rentokil Initial, founded in 1925 and headquartered in Crawley, West Sussex, UK, is a global leader in pest control and hygiene services. Operating in over 80 countries, the company provides innovative solutions, including pest prevention, removal, and monitoring, as well as workplace hygiene and specialist disinfection services. Renowned for its sustainability efforts and technological advancements, such as smart pest control systems, Rentokil Initial serves a diverse clientele across industries like healthcare, hospitality, and food production. Its mission is to protect people and enhance lives by delivering essential, high-quality services that promote health and safety.

Description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager who can take full ownership of the warehouse: racking and storage, stock accuracy, dispatch, and the supervisors and workforce. The person who joins must be able to run the operation independently and report to the owner with clear, accurate information.

Key Responsibilities

Racking & Storage
Manage a G+5 pallet racking system with defined bin locations (row, column, level)
Ensure every pallet is put away in the correct bin and the location is recorded accurately
Plan space usage, put-away, and picking to keep the warehouse organized and avoid congestion
Enforce FIFO by batch, production date, and MRP
Ensure safe forklift / reach truck movement and racking load safety

Inventory & Stock Control
Maintain 100% stock accuracy between physical stock and records
Conduct regular cycle counts and month-end physical stock audits
Track good vs. damaged stock and handle damage segregation and reporting
Reconcile stock with client records and resolve differences quickly

Inward & Dispatch
Plan and supervise daily receipts from the factory and dispatches to depots
Coordinate vehicle placement, loading, and documentation without delays
Ensure dispatch accuracy (right SKU, batch, quantity)

People Management
Lead supervisors, forklift operators, and loading/unloading labour
Allocate shifts and daily work, and hold supervisors accountable for targets
Maintain discipline, attendance, and productivity on the floor
Resolve worker issues firmly and fairly, without escalating everything to the owner
Train new staff on racking, stock procedures, and safety

Compliance, Safety & Reporting
Prepare daily/weekly MIS on stock, inward, dispatch, damages, and manpower
Ensure housekeeping, fire safety, and PPE compliance
Be ready for client audits and inspections at any time

Requirements
5+ years of warehouse experience, with at least 2 years as Warehouse Manager / In-charge
Mandatory: hands-on experience managing a pallet racking warehouse with bin locations
Experience in FMCG, 3PL, or manufacturing warehouses preferred
Proven experience leading a team of 20+ workers and supervisors
Strong knowledge of FIFO, batch tracking, stock audits, and damage handling
Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets (WMS or SAP exposure is a plus)
Good communication in Tamil; English and Hindi preferred
Graduate in any discipline; diploma/degree in logistics or supply chain is a plus

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.

Description:
Job Purpose:

To independently manage day-to-day HR operations, employee relations, statutory compliance and branch administration at the Pondicherry location.

Key Responsibilities:
HR Operations: Manage onboarding, employee documentation, employee records and exit formalities.
Attendance & Leave: Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, leave applications and biometric records.
Payroll Coordination: Validate monthly attendance, overtime, leave and payroll inputs.
Statutory Compliance: Maintain statutory registers, notices and support PF, ESI, PT and other applicable compliance requirements.
Employee Engagement: Conduct employee interactions, address grievances and coordinate engagement activities.
Recruitment: Coordinate hiring, candidate screening, interviews and joining formalities.
Performance Management: Coordinate appraisal activities, goal reviews and training programme.
Branch Administration: Monitor housekeeping, dress code, pantry supplies, petty cash, office maintenance and workplace discipline.
HRMS Management: Ensure employees use the HRMS for attendance, leave applications and other HR activities.
HR Reporting: Prepare monthly HR MIS covering headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment and compliance status.

Required Skills:
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of HR operations and Indian labour laws.
Proficiency in MS Excel and HRMS.
Strong coordination and employee-handling skills.
Ability to independently manage branch-level HR activities.

Perform routine machine cleaning and basic maintenance.
Follow machine safety procedures, PPE requirements and 5S practices.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset

With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.
