Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. Description:
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates with strong hands-on experience in milk procurement and direct farmer management, particularly from the dairy / Agri / Food industry.

Preference: Candidates who have handled large-scale milk procurement operations and farmer networks at a zonal/regional level, with strong field exposure and team-management experience.

Role & responsibilities
Lead milk procurement operations across the assigned zone.
Strengthen relationships with farmers, Milk Collection Centres (MCCs), and procurement teams.
Drive milk volume, quality and procurement efficiency across the zone.
Develop and implement strategies for farmer engagement, retention and milk productivity.
Monitor milk procurement, quality parameters, pricing, cost and daily procurement performance.
Ensure effective functioning of MCCs, BMCs and milk collection infrastructure.
Coordinate with Veterinary, Dairy Development, QA, Operations, Logistics and Sales teams as required.
Identify opportunities to improve farmer base, procurement coverage and milk availability.
Lead and develop the Zone 4 procurement team and ensure accountability for targets.
Monitor market conditions impacting milk procurement.
Drive initiatives for farmer loyalty, productivity enhancement and sustainable milk sourcing.

Must-have:
Experience in milk procurement / farmer relationship management.
Strong exposure to village-level milk collection and farmer networks.
Experience managing milk procurement teams and operations at a regional/zonal level.
Good understanding of milk quality, procurement processes and farmer engagement.
Fluency in Punjabi/Hindi is mandatory, with the ability to communicate effectively with local farmers and stakeholders.
Strong field orientation and willingness to extensively engage with the farmer community.
AboutCompany:
We are one of the Leading Private Dairy Players in India with a Chilling Capacity of 1.95 million litres per day, Processing Capacity of 2.57 million litres per day and Packaging Capacity of 1.71 million litres per day. By deeply committing ourselves to innovation and to providing authentic, high-quality milk products, we have grown multifold to occupy a sizeable share in India's Dairy Market.
We process and market a full line of dairy products including fresh milk, curd, buttermilk, lassi, ice-cream, paneer, ghee, table butter, cooking butter, milk powder, flavored milk, UHT milk and dairy whitener. Headquartered in Hyderabad, we have a significant presence in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Maharastra, Odisha, NCR Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand & Uttar Pradesh.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
FB and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our FB Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.

Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. Description:
Need to Clarify and define design requirements with the customer in the form of specified project descriptions, analyzing design expenditure
Working out design drafts on the basis of CAD data provided by the customer with regard to device design, assemblies and parts, taking technical and economic aspects into account
Drawing up design solutions taking functional, material-related, technical production and economical aspects into account; drawing up selected designs for detailing
Implementation and arrangement of detailing work for devices, assemblies and parts; preparation of all the necessary 3D documents
Arranging for tests (mechanical, mechatronic, photometric, thermal) on sample devices, integration of results in the design
YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor s in mechanical engineering /Mechatronics/Product Design /Industrial engineering /Automobile Engineering
5 - 8 years of experience in automotive product design / Lighting domain
Good knowledge of CAD (Catia V5), DFA and DFM
Good Knowledge of the molding injection process and tooling technology
Designing Mechanical Equipment: Design and develop mechanical equipment while adhering to budgetary, manufacturing, and industry standards to meet project requirements.
3D Modeling: Creating, interpreting, and managing 3D models and detailed mechanical drawings using computer-aided design tools such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or Inventor.
Prototyping: Collaborate with designated staff on the prototype production of designs and modifications. Ensure designs are feasible and can be efficiently manufactured.
BOM Management: Prepare and manage bills of material and part/document revision control for all new and modified designs.
Engineering Support: Provide technical support to the manufacturing department during product production.
Collaboration: Work closely with engineers, production personnel, and other designers to ensure design accuracy and
efficiency. Participate in cross-functional teams to achieve project goals.
Presenting Designs: Showcase design work at internal and external meetings, when necessary, to gain consensus around design direction or to resolve any potential design hurdles.
Documentation: Document design process, specification, and testing protocols in adherence to organizational and regulatory standards.
Maintain Industry Knowledge: Maintain up-to-date knowledge on industry trends and development in mechanical design technologies.
Quality Assurance: Check and confirm the accuracy of the work performed and the methods used by engineering staff. Ensure that the final product satisfies the product specifications and meets the users requirements.

Description:
1. Customer Delight & Experience Excellence Deliver a seamless, personalized experience for every pet parent and pet, ensuring high NPS and repeat visits through proactive engagement, swift service delivery, and empathetic interactions.


2. Operational & Booking Efficiency Achieve 100% accuracy and timeliness in appointment booking, grooming and vet service scheduling, and follow-ups to maximize resource utilization and service turnaround time (TAT).


3. Client Relationship Management Build lasting relationships with customers by maintaining regular touchpoints, resolving concerns promptly, and leveraging CRM tools to track preferences, special occasions, and feedback.


4. Team Engagement, Training & Capability Building – Hire, train, and retain a passionate, customer-first team; conduct regular skill-building programs for grooming, retail, and vet support staff; foster high engagement through recognition and career development.


5. Retail & Service Profitability – Drive revenue growth through optimized product mix, upselling & cross-selling between product, grooming, and vet services, and effective cost control.


6. Shrinkage & Stock Loss Control – Maintain shrinkage at or below 1.5% of total net sales through FIFO compliance, robust inward/outward stock control, regular CCTV review, and theft prevention measures.


7. Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness – Ensure all operational licenses (e.g., Shops & Establishment, Trade, Bio Medical Waste Management,PNDT, X-Ray/AERB) are valid and renewed on time; manage official visits/inspections in liaison with Area Manager, Legal, and HR.


8. Community & Brand Building – Position the Experience Centre as a local hub for pet care by hosting events, workshops, and collaborations, strengthening brand loyalty and visibility.


9. Compliance & Process Adherence – Ensure 100% adherence to SOPs, safety protocols, and hygiene standards across retail, grooming, and vet care services.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

AboutCompany:
The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5500+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.

The Company offer 30+ Staff Welfare Measures ranging from Fast Track Promotions, Career Development Programs, National Pension Scheme, Foreign Trips, five types of Annual Incentives/Bonuses, Cash Rewards, Contests with prizes, Maternity Benefits, Medical benefits, Employee Insurance etc. to name a few.
Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.
Shri. Amitabh Bachchan Ji is the Brand Ambassador of The Muthoot Group.
The Group takes humble pride in its 800 years of family business legacy and unblemished track record. Over these years, millions of underserved Indians have been served through a bouquet of products and services and have been helped in a big way to move ahead in life.

AboutCompany:
IIFL Home Finance Limited is a technology-driven, India's leading retail-focused housing finance company dedicated to supporting first-time homebuyers from the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Low-Income Groups (LIG) in India. A subsidiary of IIFL Finance Ltd. (79.59% stake), Abu Dhabi Investment Authority holds the remaining (20.41% stake) as a shareholder since 2022.

Operating through a wide network of 315 branches across 18 states and 2 Union Territories, IIFL Home Finance focuses on underserved and emerging geographies, including the suburbs of Tier 1 cities and Tier 2 to Tier 4 towns, with residential property serving as collateral.

Job Description IT SYSTEM ADMIN | SOC Analyst
Experience: 03 Years (Freshers can also apply)
Salary: 3.5 LPA 5 LPA
Job Locations: Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Guntur, Hyderabad

Job Responsibilities

T Support & Troubleshooting
Provide technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT devices.
Troubleshoot Windows OS, hardware, software, email, and internet connectivity issues.
Manage Microsoft 365, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Linux, and shared drives.
Perform software installation, configuration, updates, antivirus checks, and data backups.
Handle user accounts, password resets, permissions, and Active Directory.
Network Administration
Manage and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, VPN, and network infrastructure.
Configure Cisco routers, switches, WLANs, and VLANs.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and performance issues.
Work with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IPv4/IPv6, NAT, OSPF, and BGP.
Implement basic network security measures, ACLs, and access controls.
SOC & Cybersecurity Support
Monitor, detect, and report potential security threats and suspicious activities.
Review security alerts, system logs, and network activities.
Support vulnerability assessments and threat-hunting activities.
Identify system misconfigurations and assist with security patch management.
Support security audits, antivirus monitoring, and data protection activities.
IT Service Management & Administration
Handle daily ITSM activities, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management.
Manage and resolve end-user support tickets using Service Now or other ticketing tools.
Maintain IT asset inventory, software licenses, and hardware records.
Perform daily backups, data restoration, and disaster recovery support.
Coordinate with vendors for IT repairs, AMC, and technical support.
Maintain technical documentation and knowledge base records.

Required Skills
Windows 10/11, Hardware & Software Troubleshooting
Networking, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN & Wi-Fi
Routing & Switching, OSPF, BGP, VLAN, VPN
Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Outlook & Azure
Linux, Cisco Networking & Network Security
SOC Operations, Cybersecurity & Threat Monitoring
Vulnerability Management & Security Auditing
Service Now, ITIL & Incident Management
AWS, Azure & Virtualization
Python (Basic Knowledge)
Backup & Disaster Recovery
Desired Candidate Profile
B.Tech /B.E graduates with relevant technical knowledge.
0–3 years of experience in IT Support, Networking, or SOC Operations.
Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work in a team environment.

AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.

JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.

The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Role & responsibilities
ITC 24mantra is hiring for pre procurement quality role.

To ensure quality assessment and compliance of agricultural crops before procurement by conducting physical inspections, quality checks, sampling, and documentation. The role focuses on ensuring that only crops meeting defined quality standards are procured.

Key Responsibilities
Conduct pre-procurement quality inspections of agricultural crops at procurement locations.
Assess crop quality parameters such as moisture content, physical purity, foreign matter, grain size, color, infestation, and damage levels.
Collect crop samples and perform quality testing as per company SOPs and quality standards.
Verify crop compliance against procurement specifications and grading standards.

Maintain inspection reports, quality records, and procurement documentation accurately.

Job Description: Onboarding Executive (Swiggy Dineout)

Location: Vishakhapatnam(Field-based)

Role Overview
As an Onboarding Executive for Swiggy Dineout, you will be the face of the company on the ground. Your primary mission is to expand the Dineout network by identifying, visiting, and onboarding high-potential restaurants across assigned districts in Chennai. You will be responsible for the end-to-end sales cyclefrom the first cold visit to final offer negotiation and digital onboarding.
Key Responsibilities
Field Sales & Visitation: Conduct daily field visits to different restaurants
Stakeholder Engagement: Identify and meet with Restaurant Owners or General Managers to pitch Swiggy Dineout’s value proposition.
Negotiation & Closing: Present and negotiate exclusive offers, discounts, and commission structures to ensure the best deals for Swiggy users.
End-to-End Onboarding: Manage the administrative process of getting a restaurant live on the platform, ensuring all documentation and menu details are accurate.
District Coverage: Travel across various Chennai districts using personal transport to ensure deep market penetration.
Reporting: Maintain a daily sales tracker (Sales Visit Report) detailing visit outcomes, manager contacts, and status of negotiations.
Requirements & Qualifications
Experience: Prior experience in Field Sales, Business Development, or Vendor Onboarding (experience in Food-tech or hospitality is a major plus).
Communication: Exceptional communication and persuasion skills in English and Tamil.
Negotiation Skills: Ability to handle objections and negotiate commercial terms with business owners effectively.
Mobility: Must possess a two-wheeler and a valid driving license for daily travel across Chennai.
Attitude: Goal-oriented with a high "bias for action" and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive Pay: A healthy mix of fixed salary and performance-based incentives.
Brand Association: Gain experience with one of India’s leading tech unicorns (Swiggy).

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

HR Manager

Position Overview
The role is responsible for managing end-to-end payroll activities, statutory compliance, payroll reporting, employee loan administration, and day-to-day HR operations. The position requires strong attention to detail, accurate employee data management, timely statutory filings, and effective coordination with HR, Finance, employees, and reporting managers.
1. Payroll Management
Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing across applicable business units and locations.
Collect and validate employee attendance and overtime (OT) details from site coordinators and employees.
Verify attendance records in the HRMS and coordinate with reporting managers to resolve discrepancies.
Prepare final attendance and overtime calculation sheets for payroll processing.
Prepare salary working sheets covering salary advances, leave encashment, reimbursements, and other payroll adjustments.
Upload and maintain employee loan details in the HRMS.
Verify employee bank account, PF, and other payroll-related details and update missing or incorrect information.
Review and incorporate payroll inputs and remarks received from the HR team before processing.
Complete payroll validations and coordinate the monthly salary processing cycle.
Prepare and maintain the monthly payroll budget sheet.
Conduct final payroll verification with the relevant stakeholders before salary processing.
Coordinate payroll processing for other applicable business units and work closely with the Finance Team.
Release employee payslips after salary credit.
2. Monthly Payroll Reports & Documentation
Prepare and submit monthly actual salary reports to the designated management stakeholders.
Maintain monthly payroll records, including location-wise employee sheets and individual salary records.
Maintain and update the employee loan recovery tracker.
Coordinate and communicate monthly loan recovery details to employees.
Compile and submit required income tax and payroll-related data to the designated stakeholders.
3. Statutory Compliance PF, ESI & Professional Tax
Prepare PF and ESI contribution data for statutory challan generation.
Prepare EPF contribution and return-related sheets for applicable business units.
Prepare ESI return statements, including zero-return statements wherever applicable.
Prepare EPF zero-return statements wherever applicable.
Share validated statutory data with the designated compliance partner for challan generation.
Prepare Professional Tax (PT) sheets for applicable locations and coordinate with the designated stakeholders for challan processing.
Verify statutory challans received from the compliance partner and forward them to the Finance Team for payment processing.
4. Compliance Management
Prepare and submit statutory compliance reports after completion of PF, ESI, and PT payment activities.
Prepare and submit location/business-unit specific compliance reports within the required timelines.
Maintain supporting documentation for statutory compliance activities and audit requirements.
5. Employee Loan Administration
Share loan application documents and relevant information with eligible employees.
Collect and verify completed employee loan applications.
Coordinate with the Finance Team for employee loan disbursement.
Maintain and update the employee loan register and recovery records.
6. HR Operations & Employee Support
Resolve employee queries related to payroll, payslips, PF, ESI, leave balances, and other payroll matters.
Provide support for day-to-day HR operations and payroll-related activities.
Coordinate with HR, Finance, reporting managers, and employees to resolve payroll and statutory discrepancies.
Provide operational support as required by the HR leadership team.
7. Payroll, Compliance & Data Management
Maintain and update employee statutory records accurately and systematically.
Prepare and maintain PF, ESI, PT, and other applicable statutory compliance reports.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrads programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
AboutCompany:
About upGrad:
upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Description:
Job Summary
This position is open with Bajaj Finance Limited. The Branch Manager is a managerial responsibility for providing full leadership and direction to the team of employees in growing business and client base of consumer gold loan. The overall objective of this role is to build customer loyalty and recommend the development of business strategies or initiatives and may include the management of activities by external organizations, and the direct management of individuals.
Responsibilities
Responsible for overall branch operations, performance profitability of the branch.
Drive/participate in field-marketing activities of various financial products along with the team to improve brand visibility.
Plan, conduct, and monitor the branch field level marketing activities to ensure a healthy pipeline of leads resulting in business conversion and branch growth.
Focus on customer engagement for new customer acquisitions and retention of old customers.
Conducting error-free valuation appraisal of gold ornaments pledged in branch with correct weight and purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Joint custodian of the Vault with responsibility for safekeeping of pledged securities as per company policies.
Responsible for keeping NPAs in control through strong follow-ups from the customers for interest collections.
Good planning abilities are required for smooth functioning of the branch for developing cohesiveness within the company and co-workers.
Hiring, coaching, mentoring and training employees and providing timely feedback on their performance.
Maintaining quality performance of the business, preparing various reports of the same and taking necessary actions for growth of business in branch.
Increase Gold Loan business, plus various other third-party products i.e., NCDs, Gold Coins sale, etc.

This position is open with Bajaj Finance Ltd.

MS Excel

Basic Computer Skills
Attention to Detail

We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030:
No child dies from preventable causes before their fifth birthday All children learn from a quality basic education and Violence against children is no longer tolerated
We run programmes in the remotest corners of India and urban areas in the areas of Health Nutrition, Education, Child Protection and Livelihood Economic Wellbeing in order to facilitate quality education, healthcare and protection from harm and abuse and life-saving aid during emergencies to children.
Background Context
Bal Raksha Bharat with support from SEIL Energy India Limited has implemented projects on Education theme in Government schools Nellore in the year 2022 -2024. The programmes were focussed on providing access to quality education to the children and strengthening of capacities of the teaching staff.
The proposed intervention aims to create safe, hygienic, inclusive and child-friendly learning environments by strengthening essential school infrastructure and Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) facilities in Five schools.
The identified 05 schools serving children from economically and socially vulnerable communities face challenges related to ageing and poorly maintained infrastructure. These include deteriorated toilets, damaged flooring and wall tiles, inadequate water and sanitation facilities, unsafe electrical systems, no painting, damaged doors/windows, cracks and dampness in walls and ceilings, and other infrastructure lacks. These conditions can adversely affect childrens health, safety, dignity, attendance and overall learning experience, particularly for girls and adolescent students.
This proposal aims to undergo need-based repair, renovation and refurbishment based on systematic school-level infra technical assessments. The programme will prioritize critical infrastructure and WASH gaps and ensure that the investments result in visible, functional, safe and sustainable improvements. The intervention will also promote greater ownership among school management, teachers, School Management Committees (SMCs) and other stakeholders, with emphasis on regular maintenance and sustainability of the improved facilities.
Common challenges observed in schools:
Damaged or poorly maintained toilets.
Broken or deteriorated flooring and wall tiles.
Plumbing and water supply deficiencies.
Damaged doors, windows and other civil structures.
Unsafe electrical wiring, switches, lights and fans.
Inadequate finishing of class rooms
Poor sanitation and hygiene conditions.
Considering the above factors, Bal Raksha Bharat had planned to improve the above in coordination with the Department of School Education, Infrastructure and will be implemented in 5 Government Schools in Nellore District, Andhra Pradesh.
The role of the position: To monitor and supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at the project site, ensuring that contractors execute the assigned work as per instructions, approved timelines, agreed scope, quality expectations, and safety requirements.

Having Civil Engineering qualification will be preferred with good observation, coordination, communication, and follow-up skills to ensure proper execution of construction activities under the guidance of a qualified civil engineer or project manager.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities A. Site Supervision and Monitoring
Regularly monitor ongoing civil construction activities at the site.
Ensure contractors and workers are carrying out assigned work as instructed.
Monitor activities such as excavation, concreting, brickwork, plastering, flooring, painting, waterproofing, and other civil works.
Check whether the work is progressing according to the agreed scope and schedule.
Bring any deviations, defects, or unusual site conditions to the attention of the concerned engineer.

B. Contractor and Labour Coordination
Coordinate with civil contractors, subcontractors, and workmen.
Ensure contractors deploy the required manpower at the site.
Monitor daily attendance and manpower availability.
Follow up with contractors to ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
Maintain discipline and proper housekeeping at the construction site.

C. Work Progress Monitoring
Monitor daily progress against the agreed work schedule.
Take photographs of work progress at different stages.
Maintain a daily activity and progress report.
Highlight delays, manpower shortages, material shortages, and other constraints.
Escalate issues to the project manager for timely resolution.

D. Material and Resource Monitoring
Monitor the receipt and availability of construction materials.
Verify material quantities received against delivery challans.
Keep track of material usage and report any unusual wastage.
Ensure materials are properly stored and protected.
Inform the concerned team about material requirements in advance.

E. Quality and Workmanship Observation
Visually monitor the quality and finishing of completed work.
Check whether work is being carried out as per the instructions of the qualified engineer.
Identify visible defects such as cracks, uneven surfaces, improper finishing, leakage, and damages.
Report quality-related issues to the concerned engineer.
Ensure rectification of identified defects by the contractor.

F. Safety and Housekeeping
Ensure workers use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
Monitor general site safety and cleanliness.
Ensure construction debris and waste are removed regularly.
Report unsafe working conditions and incidents immediately.
Ensure contractors follow site safety instructions.

G. Documentation and Reporting
Maintain daily site progress reports.
Maintain photographic records of construction activities.
Record contractor manpower and material receipt details.
Maintain a list of pending activities and observations.
Report daily progress, delays, and issues to the reporting manager.
Assist in checking contractor bills against actual work progress under the guidance of the project team.

3. Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline or Diploma in any relevant field.
Civil Engineering qualification is not mandatory.
Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel, Word, and email.

4. Experience
3-5 years of experience in site supervision, facility maintenance, project coordination, or construction-related activities.
Experience in handling contractors and monitoring site activities will be an advantage.

5. Required Skills and Competencies
Good observation and monitoring skills.
Ability to coordinate with contractors and workers.
Good communication and reporting skills.
Basic understanding of civil construction activities.
Ability to identify visible defects and deviations.
Good follow-up and problem-escalation skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Office.
Willingness to work at construction sites.
Creativity:
Effectively influences others by understanding their interests and showing how they will be met by own preferred solution
Look at low cost and high impact design for the schools to minimise the cost for utilising the resources for more activities within the project
Integrity:
Ensure efficient and transparent use of resources in accordance with internal controls
Remains effective and retains perspective in the face of difficult or demanding situations
Maintains ethical and professional behaviour in accordance with relevant codes of conduct
Demonstrates approachability and trust by listening carefully to others and valuing their contribution, and making others feel comfortable by being open and honest about their thoughts and feelings
Make sure the entire project and WASH component will help children and consider to prove as a model to advocate with government to replicate in other schools/geographies
Other
Ensure that all activities and partnerships under the project are fully compliant with systems and procedures of Bal Raksha Bharat (Save the Children) and of our partners, as applicable.
Ensure timely submission of internal reports (monthly, quarterly, and annual) and all donor reports, as required (Programme and Finance)
Tracking of budget VS expenditure to avoid
Ensure compliance with BRBs policies and practices, including the Child Safeguarding Policy.
Ensure effective coordination with Programme and other functions as required for exchange of information and work needs
Undertake timely corrective measures to ensure project is implemented as per the agreed timelines and quality standards.
Create evidence base of the processes, activities, changes and impact of the project interventions on regular basis in coordination with Knowledge Management team of BRB (Save the Children).
Quality timely compliance on periodic reporting to the state office, donor and local government department.
BRB Compliances:
Comply with the requirements of Bal Raksha Bharat s (Save the Children) Child Safeguarding Policy to ensure maximum protection for children.
Ensure that you work to the best of your ability and demonstrate high levels of commitment to BRB in order to ensure the objectives of your role and the country programme are met.
Ensure the efficient use of all BRB resources in order to maximise use of resources for benefiting children.
Contribute to a positive working environment.
Promote the work of Bal Raksha Bharat - communicating, both internally and externally, in an accurate, sensitive and motivating fashion
Ensure that all activities comply with applicable law at all times, including compliance with data protection legislation
Other ad hoc duties as required in line with your skills, experience and role

- Continuously provides feedback and updates to achieve improved results

Deliver high quality results in line with the on-going proposals and Bal Raksha Bharat (Save the Children s) strategy - to do this in a way which maintains the reputation of the WASH team.
Comply with Bal Raksha Bharat s (Save the Children) policies and practice with respect to child protection, code of conduct, health and safety, equal opportunities and other relevant policies and procedures.
To perform such other responsibilities as agreed with your line management.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Key Focus Area
Functions - Weightage
BTG Shift Operations - 40%
HT and LT switchgear trouble shooting - 40%
Vacuum circuit breakers - 10%
Air circuit breakers - 10%
Desired Qualification & Experience

B.Tech in Electrical Engineering with 5-10 years of experience.
5-10 years of experience in handling Shift activities of BTG/BOP area.
Expertise in equipment condition monitoring, HT and LT switchgear maintenance and trouble shooting.
Industry Type Exposure

Thermal Power plant 150MW or Above capacity
Roles and Responsibility/ Duties to be performed.

Operate and monitor BTG and BOP equipment during shift operations.
Ensure safe, reliable, and economical operation of the generating unit.
Monitoring and maintain plant HT/LT motors, Power and Distribution Transformers & HT/LT switchgear parameters within prescribed operating limits.
Coordinate with the Control Room Shift In charge for smooth plant operation.
Safety & Compliance Leadership: Enforce strict PTW, LOTO protocols and statutory safety norms to ensure zero accidents/incidents during maintenance works.
Functional Competencies:

Technical Expertise: Mastery of HT/LT motor construction, breaker mechanisms and protection schemes for effective troubleshooting and system reliability.
Preventive & Predictive Maintenance Support: Assist maintenance teams by identifying equipment abnormalities and recommending preventive actions.
Emergency Handling: Ability to respond effectively to boiler trips, turbine trips, generator trips, blackout conditions, and other emergencies.
Behavioral & Management Competencies:

Leadership and Teamwork: Ability to guide operators, supervise technicians, allocate work, and ensure adherence to operational and maintenance procedures.
Problem-Solving and Resilience: Demonstrate analytical thinking to resolve equipment issues during high-pressure plant tripping situations.
Strategic Resource Management: Effectively plans, utilizes, and optimizes available manpower, equipment, utilities, and materials to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant operations while minimizing downtime and operational costs.
Employment Type

Full Time
AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.

JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Description:
Location: North Goa

Job Description: The Customer Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers and rider partners, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries.
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options.
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements.
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels.
Handling customer and rider partner escalations-preparing RCA and providing the solution.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts.
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements and providing best solutions to the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Required Skills:
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and rider partners and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment - this is applicable for our rider partners as well
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer and rider partner issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer and rider related issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand.

Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies.

Description:
Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.

Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Video Producer who is passionate about shooting and editing films, advertisements and digital video content.
The role involves creating engaging visual content for Delhivery's brand and marketing initiatives, from shooting on-ground stories and brand films to producing advertisements, social media videos and campaign content.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling the entire video production process independently, from setting up the camera and lighting to shooting, editing and delivering the final film.
Key Responsibilities
1. Video Shooting & Production
Independently shoot advertisements, brand films, corporate videos, social media content and documentary-style stories.
Operate professional cameras, mirrorless cameras and other video equipment.
Manage camera settings, framing, composition, camera movements and lighting.
Handle on-location shoots across offices, warehouses, operational facilities and outdoor locations.
Record quality audio and manage basic sound equipment.
Plan and execute shoots with minimal supervision.
2. Video Editing & Post-Production
Edit videos for different platforms and formats, including YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn and digital advertising.
Create engaging edits with strong storytelling, pacing, transitions and visual flow.
Perform basic colour correction, colour grading, sound mixing and audio enhancement.
Create titles, subtitles, graphics and basic motion graphics.
Adapt long-form footage into short-form videos, reels and advertisements.
Deliver final videos in the required aspect ratios, resolutions and formats.
3. Creative Collaboration
Work with the Brand and Marketing teams to translate creative briefs into effective video content.
Contribute ideas on visual storytelling, camera treatments and editing styles.
Collaborate with internal teams, employees and external production partners during shoots.
Stay updated on emerging video production techniques, equipment and editing trends.
Skills & Qualifications
2-5 years of experience in videography, video production and editing.
Strong hands-on experience in shooting and editing videos independently.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.
Working knowledge of After Effects is an advantage.
Good understanding of cameras, lenses, lighting, audio recording and composition.

What We Are Looking For
Someone who loves being behind the camera as much as being in the editing room.
A strong visual sense and an eye for detail.
Someone who can independently take ownership of a video assignment from shoot to final edit.
A practical, resourceful individual who can produce quality content without always depending on large production crews.
A portfolio demonstrating actual shooting and editing work is essential.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities
