or a minimum of 2 years experience in Purchasing or a related field.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Work, Projects, Policies, and Standards for Purchasing Across Departments
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Compiles, codes, categorizes, calculates, tabulates, audits, or verifies information or data.
- Assures sanitation compliance.
- Assists Executive Chef in all aspects of purchasing (eg, Food, Beverage and Controllable) to ensure quality and profitability.
- Orders all food and beverage based on business needs.
- Assists Executive Chef in maintaining/lower budgeted food/controllable costs.
- Delegates and enforces first in/first out inventory rotation for all storeroom products.
- Maintains sanitation and safety standards as specified in the brand guidelines.
- Ensures that proper safeguards are in effect for the security of the food and beverage storeroom assets.
- Enforces item use-up with storeroom personnel and kitchen management to keep inventory at lowest level possible levels.
- Communicates with kitchen, restaurant management and vendors to ensure timing of deliveries satisfies advanced food production needs.
- Checks invoice on goods received against shipment to ensure quantity, quality, weights and purchase specifications are as ordered.
- Uses existing computer programs to perform daily and period end food and beverage costs.
- Maintains inventory controls for proper levels, dating, rotation, requisitions, etc
- Completes administrative tasks on a timely basis (eg, C-7s, menu costing, general office duties).
- Completes period end inventory according to Food and Beverage and Accounting standard operation procedures.
- Calculates figures for food and beverage inventory.
- Ensures that price and product availability issues are communicated as needed to the F & B Director and Executive Chef.
- Ensures all LSOPs are adhered to by all employees.
- Receives and inspects all deliveries.
- Maintains an accurate controllable log and beverage perpetual
- Ensures accurate administration of all invoices, and adherence to proper bookkeeping procedures.
Demonstrating and Applying Accounting Knowledge to Purchasing Operations
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Uses computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.
- Uses relevant information and individual judgment to determine whether events or processes comply with laws, regulations, or standards.
- Keeps up-to-date technically and applying new knowledge to your job.
Supporting Purchasing Operations
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Ensure disciplinary situations are addressed in timely fashion and with consistency.
- Ensures performance reviews are completed on a timely basis for supervisors and non-management employees.
Maintaining Fice and Accounting Goals
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Ensures profits and losses are documented accurately
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Interacts with kitchen staff, vendors and Executive Chef.
- Uses existing computer programs effectively to post invoices, update items and costs.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
- Provide direction and assistance to other organizational units regarding accounting and budgeting policies and procedures, and efficient control and utilization of ficial resources.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Managing Discipline Work, Projects, and Policies
- Coordinates and implements accounting work and projects as assigned.
- Coordinates, implements, and follows up on audits for all areas of property operations.
- Complies with Federal and State laws applying to operations procedures.
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Compiles, codes, categorizes, calculates, tabulates, audits, or verifies information or data.
- Balances ledgers.
Supporting Property Operations
- Works with operations teams to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Evaluates if discipline teams are meeting service needs and provides feedback to teams.
- Participates in walk-throughs on property to ensure that all areas are well maintained and preventative maintece processes are in place.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
- Reviews findings from comment cards and guest satisfaction results with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.
- Works with team to put sustainable work processes and systems in place that support the execution of the strategy.
- Reviews reports and ficial statements to determine operations performance against budget.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.
Managing and Monitoring Activities that Affect the Customer and Guest Experience
- Provides excellent customer service by being readily available/approachable for all customers and guests.
- Takes proactive approaches when dealing with customers and guest concerns.
- Extends professionalism and courtesy to customers and guests at all times.
- Responds timely to customer service department request.
- Ensures all team members meet or exceed all hospitality requirements.
Supporting Profitability
- Supports annual quality audits.
- Reviews ficial statements, sales and activity reports, and other performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.
Supporting Safety Standards and Work Procedures
- Implements property emergency plan.
- Provides a safe working environment in compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration/MSDS.
- Implements and sustains property accident prevention programs.
- Follows property-specific recovery plans.

- Demonstrates self confidence, energy and enthusiasm.
- Manages group or interpersonal conflict.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Manages time and possesses organizational skills.
- Presents ideas, expectations and information in a concise, organized manner.
- Uses problem solving methodology for decision making and follow up.
- Makes calls if necessary.

This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Description:
Job Responsibilities VAPT Engineer
Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, networks, and IT infrastructure.
Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.
Execute manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities and assess their exploitability.
Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Identify and validate security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and common network security weaknesses.
Prepare detailed VAPT reports covering identified vulnerabilities, severity levels, technical evidence, risk impact, and remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to support vulnerability remediation.
Perform retesting after remediation and verify vulnerability closure.
Support secure code review and application security assessments.
Maintain VAPT documentation, testing procedures, and assessment records.
Support security compliance audits and assessments in accordance with applicable security standards and organizational policies.
Ensure all penetration testing activities are conducted within the approved scope and follow established security testing methodologies.
Required Technical Skills
Hands-on experience in VAPT and manual penetration testing.
Knowledge of web application, API, network, and infrastructure security testing.
Experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
Ability to prepare technical VAPT reports and recommend remediation measures.
Experience with vulnerability validation, remediation tracking, and retesting.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with practical experience executing penetration tests, validating vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and conducting remediation retesting are preferred. Candidates with experience limited to GRC, compliance, or reviewing third-party VAPT reports may not be suitable for this hands-on role.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Position responsible for the execution of meetings and events and ensuring the implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
Ensures that meetings and events meet customer needs and focuses on growing event revenues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the event management, food and beverage, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the event management, food and beverage, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Meetings and Special Events Operations and Budgets
Researches and analyzes new products, pricing and services of competition.
Reviews scheduled events and troubleshoot potential challenges/conflicts.
Ensures the property is apprised of all groups that will impact property operations.
Ensures meeting space and corresponding heart of the house areas are cleaned and maintained.
Ensures furniture and equipment are maintained and inventory levels are kept in accordance to corporate guidelines.
Leads the execution of brand service initiatives in event management areas.
Develops an event management strategy that is aligned with the company s business strategy and leads its execution.
Conduct daily walk-through of banquet floor to ensure client satisfaction and quality standards.
Managing Profitability
Encourages calculated risk-taking to generate incremental revenue and deliver excellent guest service.
Develops working relationships with outside vendors and establishes prices and service agreements to enhance the event experience and to increase additional revenue opportunities for the property.
Creates and achieves the annual banquet budget.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Creates an atmosphere in all event management operations areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations.
Consult with customers in order to determine objectives and requirements for events such as meetings, conferences, and conventions.

Description:
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding ficial goals.
Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations.
Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all ficial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand ficial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Attendant Operator to join our team at Tagros Chemicals India Ltd., responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our chemical plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment, including reactors, distillation columns, and centrifuges.

Monitor and control chemical processes to ensure product quality and safety.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance personnel to troubleshoot issues and optimize performance.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify potential hazards or defects.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Diploma or degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as an operator in a chemical plant setting.

Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations, including safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation is desirable.

Must pass a pre-employment physical and drug-alcohol screening.

Description:
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced and student-focused Radiology Medical Imaging Technology who will be responsible for delivering engaging and conceptually strong academic sessions for undergraduate students. The candidate will facilitate classroom learning through effective teaching methods, discussions, demonstrations, and practical activities while ensuring alignment with the prescribed curriculum.
The ideal candidate should be organised, proactive, and passionate about student learning, with the ability to track learner progress, conduct assessments, and provide constructive academic feedback. They will also maintain academic records, collaborate with the Campus Academics team, and actively incorporate feedback to continuously improve teaching effectiveness and ensure a positive learning experience for students.


What you ll be responsible for
Studying the material which needs to be taught.
Train the young students by using technology.
Take Lectures as per the scheduled format and within the given timeline.
Regularly mentoring your students.
Conducting examinations and distribution of results.
Collecting doubts and addressing them.
Organizing extracurricular activities.
Report and document student progress.
Work with the team on any other assigned task from time to time.


An ideal candidate should have:
Master's degree in MRIT with a strong understanding of hospital operations, patient-facing processes, healthcare documentation, and healthcare-management practices.
Excellent classroom facilitation skills with the ability to keep learners engaged, motivated, and focused. Prior experience in teaching, facilitation, academic training, or mentoring students will be preferred.
Openness to feedback and a growth mindset toward teaching methods, student learning outcomes, and academic processes.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to connect with students and collaborate effectively with campus teams.
Organized and responsible in order to manage sessions, assessments, documentation, and learner.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.
3. Required Skills & Competencies
Hands-on experience in XRF analysis in a cement manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cement chemistry and quality control.
Good understanding of raw mix, clinker and cement chemical parameters.
Knowledge of laboratory testing procedures and quality standards.
Ability to interpret XRF results and identify quality deviations.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

AboutCompany:
Waaree Energies Limited is a leading Indian renewable energy company and India's largest manufacturer of solar PV modules. Founded in 1989 by Hitesh Doshi and headquartered in Mumbai, the company has grown into a major global player in the solar and green energy sectors.

Key Business Highlights:
Core Offerings: The company manufactures solar modules, solar cells, inverters, and energy storage systems. They also provide comprehensive turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services for solar projects, as well as operations and maintenance.
Manufacturing Scale: Waaree boasts immense manufacturing capabilities, with large-scale plants in Gujarat (including Chikhli, Surat, and Umbergaon) and an expanding international footprint, including a manufacturing facility in the United States.
Vertical Integration: The company operates a vertically integrated business model, expanding backward from solar modules into the manufacturing of solar cells, wafers, and ingots.
Recent Milestones: Waaree Energies successfully went public, listing on the BSE and NSE in October 2024. The company is also actively expanding its portfolio into emerging sustainable technologies like green hydrogen.

Today, Waaree operates in over 20 countries, playing a strategic role in India's renewable energy transition and global solar supply chains

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Hospital Revenue Cycle Management (RCM): Practical exposure to IPD and OPD billing cycles, multi-tier tariff plans, cash/credit billing audits, and plug of revenue leakages.

Hospital Information System (HIS): Working knowledge of specialized hospital ERP modules (e.g., SAP, TallyPrime, Oracle, Meditech, or custom HIS).
Advanced Microsoft Excel: Strong skills in VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, handling large hospital billing data dumps.
Statutory Compliance: Thorough understanding of TDS deductions (specifically 194J on doctor fees, 194C on contractor invoices) and GST applicability in healthcare.
Audit Support: Prior experience in assisting internal audits, statutory financial audits, and insurance regulatory reconciliations

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Operations Manager - The Vanda Hotel
Position: Operations Manager
Location: The Vanda Hotel
Reporting To: General Manager
Experience Required: 7-10 Years in the Hospitality Industry
Salary Package: 75,000 - 80,000 per month
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
The Vanda Hotel is seeking a dynamic and experienced Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day hotel operations, ensure exceptional guest experiences, optimize operational efficiency, and support business growth. The incumbent will work closely with the General Manager and lead all operational departments to maintain high standards of service, profitability, and compliance.
______________
Key Responsibilities
Hotel Operations Management
Oversee daily operations of all hotel departments including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, Security, and Guest Relations.
Ensure smooth functioning of hotel operations while maintaining service excellence.
Monitor occupancy levels, guest satisfaction scores, and operational performance.
Guest Experience & Service Quality
Ensure superior guest service standards and prompt resolution of guest complaints.
Develop and implement service improvement initiatives.
Maintain high hospitality standards aligned with the hotel's brand image.
Team Leadership & People Management
Supervise, mentor, and motivate department heads and operational staff.
Conduct regular staff meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
Ensure adequate staffing and efficient workforce utilization.
Financial & Business Performance
Assist the General Manager in achieving revenue and profitability targets.
Monitor departmental budgets, operational costs, and inventory controls.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue enhancement.


Compliance & Safety
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, statutory regulations, health & safety standards, and hospitality industry guidelines.
Conduct regular inspections and audits of hotel facilities and operations.
Maintain proper documentation and operational records.
Vendor & Facility Management
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Ensure proper maintenance of hotel infrastructure and equipment.
Monitor procurement activities and stock management.
______________
Required Qualifications & Skills
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism Management, or a related field.
Professional hospitality certifications will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 7-10 years of experience in the hospitality industry.
At least 3-5 years in a managerial or operational leadership role within hotels, resorts, or hospitality establishments.
Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Sound knowledge of hotel operations and hospitality standards.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Financial acumen and budget management expertise.
Proficiency in hotel management systems and MS Office.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
______________
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Guest Satisfaction Scores
Occupancy and Revenue Performance
Service Quality Standards
Cost Control and Budget Adherence
Employee Productivity and Retention
Compliance and Safety Standards
______________
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly Salary: 75,000 - 80,000

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Skills: Pharma Sales Business Development, Dealer Distributor Management, Retail/Local Market Visits, Brand Product Promotion, Channel Sales Market Development, Sales Target Achievement, Candidate Profile, The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets., Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.
Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.
